topic: Computers are often argued to be the most important invention of the last hundred years. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Nowadays, the computer becomes an indispensable thing in our lives. There are many people think that these machines are the most crucial developments of the last centuries. I strongly agree with that statement, and this essay will support my view.

Firstly, computers help us work much faster and easier. This is because computer has the ability to communicate quickly throughout the email service, that leads to a lot of information can be delivered in a very short time. Moreover, the invention of laptops, which can be carried lightly between every place, enables us to work at anywhere. In addition, the appearance of some softwares which support the video call function assists people can work from home with their partners. To take one example, in some scenarios like Covid-19 pandemic, people just need to stay at home and use their computers to work instead of moving to the company.

Secondly, those computers give the community a great way to learn. In fact, there are many study resources on the internet which can be found by using the computers, that creates a big chance for everyone who pursues self-study. Furthermore, thanks to some online learning systems, teachers and their student can correspond better, as a result, the education quality will be improved. For example, when students have some questions, they can use the computer to search for the problems, or directly ask their tutors via the online system.

In the conclusion, there are many important inventions which extremely help us in many aspects of our lives. However, with those aforementioned benefits, computers can be supposed to be the best inventions over centuries.

topic: In many countries, paying for things using mobile phone (cellphone) apps is becoming increasingly common. Ċ Does this development have more advantages or disadvantages?
essay:
In several nations, citizens are utilising apps in their phones more and more frequently to pay bills or products. Even though this advancement is not always suitable for seniles and can make people vulnerable to frauds, I believe that the positives sides far outweigh the drawbacks.

There are plenty of advantages of using cell phones to pay for a wide variety of things. First and foremost, using apps Verify preposition usage onIt appears that there is a missing preposition after the word apps. Consider adding the preposition.

show exampleswhether to pay bills or buy goods is extremely convenient because the person does not have to leave their home. For instance, I always pay all my household bills through a bank app, resulting in a huge amount of time spared. Furthermore, these gadgets allow people who suffer from physical disabilities to pay their bills without having to experience the distress of going out. Therefore, mobile phone apps are an excellent way to provide a service more accessible and inclusive.

However, there are a few disadvantages which have to be taken into consideration. Firstly, many citizens are victims of fraud when they use apps with payment purposes which can result in stressful situations and financial loss. As an illustration of this, my mother had her credit card cloned last year while using an app designed for buying grocery products. Moreover, older people are not used to these devices which can make this experience seems like an absolute nightmare for them. For example, I have taught my grandmother how to use her bank app several times, but she never really understood it.

topic: The world has seen an enormous increase in flights for leisure, business and commercial purposes around the world over recent years.  what do you think are the main advantages and disadvantages of such flights?  do you think flights should be taxed more?
essay:
In the twentieth century, the global has shown a rise significantly in aviation services for various kinds of people lives like holiday, business and trade purposes in around the world. I deeply agree with this statement related to increasing level of using airplane. However, while flights have great profits for supporting people's requirements, there are many drawbacks of it according to welfare, cost, and even pollution.

To begin with, present of aircraft services have contributed to the inhabitant's lives more dynamic and efficient. Utilizing the airplane has allowed businesses and meets up with other colleagues or family members to easily cross over territorial boundary lines. For instance, in the last two decades the aviation corporation in Singapore reveals that predominantly people there using airplane for traveling that is approximately seventy percent. Consequently, demand of flights is becoming more advances in which people tend to shift consider the aircraft is primary transport to assist their daily activities.

However, beside that there are several advantages of flights. First of all, airplane are still become one of dangerous transportation due to increasing rate of flight accidents in the world annually which cause hundreds of people die. Secondly, burning fossil fuel of plane like avtur conclude it become the most pricey transportation and it also can lead to serious pollution in air which impact to dilute the ozone layers. Also, lack of facilities for supporting flights is not adequate and become an obstacle like aerodrome nowadays is still unavailable in rural areas.

In conclusion, presence of aviation conveyance has rendered some advantages for society regards on save time and effectiveness matters. But, in my notion, the airplane can cause serious problem such threatening accidents and damaging of environment.

topic: Parents, usually mothers, stay at home to look after their family. People believe they should receive a salary from the government for that. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
A mother’s role in the upbringing of the child is very crucial and often it has been seen, that they have to sacrifice their professional career and become housewives for the well being of their family. It is often debated, that they should be paid by the government authorities for doing so. I firmly believe that yes, housewives should receive compensation for the mentioned rationales in this essay below.

First and foremost, due to the high cost of living, both parents are forced to go out and earn their living. In case of a child, it is very unlikely that one of the parents has to let go of their professional dreams and embark full-time availability for the growth and nourishment of the family. In most of the cases, it is the mother, who takes the responsibility to nurture the family to the best of her abilities. As a result, the families may start facing financial crisis and the running the house alone may feel like overburdening for her partner. Therefore, any financial assistance provided by the government, can add enable her to take care of her basic necessities and amenities like groceries and other household items without being dependent on her husband.

In Addition to it, of all the jobs in the world, a homemaker's job is least appreciated in the society. One cannot deny the fact that the selfless contributions made by the mother's in running a family cannot be compared with any other job in the world. However, it is quite depressing to see that this job is the most underrated. As per a survey conducted by the World health organization, 75% of the husbands working overtime, believe that their housewives are leading a hassle-free lavish life with no sense of responsibility and are unaware of the struggle to keep the house running. This mindset is only because, out of all the amazing things that a woman can offer, she is unable to offer a financial aid as she is taking care of the family. Hence an upper income by the governing bodies can help them stand on their feet with a sense of respect and pride.

To summarize it all, I believe that mothers spent half of their life channelizing her time and energy for the well being of the family and she deserves utmost respect for that in society. If due to financial crises her integrity and sacrifice are questioned, then I firmly support the idea of government providing a salary toSuggestionfor them is quite justified.

topic: Modern technology is changing our world. This has advantages such as bringing people closer together through communication. It also has disadvantages such as destroying the differences between cultures. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Technological advances have brought our life to become easier and simpler, particularly in communication that these improvements make us getting closer to everyone. However, its drawback is able to destroy the differences between communities. This essay disagrees with the notion since declining people's basic ability to socialize with each other and helping to prevent destruction of cultures.

To begin with, an enormous of people highlights the positive impact that modern technology might bring a convenient way to make communication, especially abroad, is undemanding. However, as far as I concerned that this way does not involve the same interaction likewise with human beings. It is evidence that decreasing people's proficiency to speak and listen is getting worse, and it may continue to grow for forthcoming decades as predicted by Mark Gilbert, a psychologist from Cambridge University. He estimates that 23% of young people will be difficult to state their personal opinion due to less social skills, and it leads into less confident as a consequent.

On the other hand, deliberating about destroying of differences between communities, I opine that this serve can be avoided since technology is able to prevent different cultures by keep promoting it on several websites. For example, Indonesia rely on technological development to share its beliefs, traditions, and customs through accessing the internet. As a result, a large number of people around the worlds are able to grasp its cultures without physically visit in Indonesia.

In conclusion, I would totally disagree that technology brings advantage for our communication as it reduces our fundamental skills. However, modern technology can contribute to share our latest activity in terms of our unique cultures towards foreign people on the website. (279)

topic: The use of corporal punishment (physical hitting students) in schools is in decline, yet it should be used to improve behavior. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Nowadays, schools have lessened the usage of physical punishments, but some people believe that it should be there to teach the students lesson about behaving properly. In my conviction, this punishment must be stopped completely because it affects children mentally and increases accidental risks for them.

Firstly, physical abuse is a brutal way to make children understand their mistakes and it can affect them mentally in a longer run. Punishing kids with physical hitting increases fear in them and consequently, they can suffer from mental disorders in the future. Also, some children develop introvert personality due to the fear of getting hit by the teachers. For instance, one of my classmates in the school is suffering from the mental illness where he is not able to talk to anyone but himself because he was tortured with this kind of punishment in his childhood.

Secondly, there are risks of accidents to occur while hitting a child with any of the objects.Such as hitting a student with a scale or a stick can hurt some of his veins accidentally and can damage their blood vessels or may damage any bone which can cause a fracture. For all these accidents, teachers and schools are responsible for that and can end up going through the legal process. For example, there was an incident on the news a few years back that a teacher slapped a kid to punish him and it hit hard on the back of his ear that he lost the ability to hear since then. This shows that it is such an absurd way to treat children.

In conclusion, I completely disagree with the idea of corporal punishment as it can traumatize children mentally as well as it can be detrimental physically. In my view, there are other hurtless punishments to improve their behaviour and children know the language of love better than an aggressive one.

topic: Scientists and technology experts seem to be more valued by modern society than musicians and artist. To what extent do you agree?
essay:
Science and art are the two strong pillars of the modern society. While scientists and technology experts are thought to be more appreciated by the people nowadays, I believe that musicians and other artists are equally valued in our society.

On the one hand, the innovations and the discoveries of scientists have brought convenience in human lives. In other words, science and technology have changed the lifestyle of people like never before. Technology has made the earth as a global village with all modern amenities. For instance, developments in transport industry have considerably reduced the amount of time taken to travel from one place to another. Also, a team of scientists is continuously working on giving new dimensions to the medical science, thereby developing more vaccines and medicines to curb diseases and increasing the average lifespan of humans. Therefore, scientists and experts seem to be of greater importance to society as they have revolutionized an individual’s life.

On the other hand, musicians and artists are no less valued by the society. topic: STAY at the same work place OR CHANGE JOBS frequently? Some people prefer to stay in the same type of work all their life, and others prefer to change their jobs from time to time. Discuss both sides and state your own opinion
essay:
Career choices have become more flexible in modern life when everyone have the same opportunities, so different trends have appeared : earn a living with their current jobs forever or change them in many times in their life. Two trends have created argument among society and influenced more generations.

On one hand, people who prefer to keep on their job tend to live stable lives but dangerous ones. This helps them keep their own incomes, relationships, professional skills and life skills, which make them feel safer and help them avoid ventures and risky problems. They can have opportunities to get pay raise when all their life are spent to improve job skills and cement internal relationships. Moreover, people who decide to stay same job for a long time will have chance to enjoy the rest of life and spend time to accomplish their different activities such as: take care of family, go travel or play favourite sports.

On the other hand, others who prefer to change their jobs will not get rewarded in work like people who choose to stay in the same job. They must deal with many unexpected problems such as changed environments, colleagues, bosses,... even are constrained to change their own life to follow their new jobs, which prevents families who cope with financial problems. But in contrary, they get opportunities to challenge and expand themselves by confronting with various circumstances like deadline pressure, professional skills challenges and adaptability. So, they will get more experiences and can be confident in solving different difficulties.

In conclusion, I appreciate who can take risks in choosing jobs because of their stuff and adventure passion so I believe that they will get the market values in the future by their own diverse experiences and have colorful lives than others.

topic: As global trade increase, many goods including those we use in daily basis are produced in another country and have to be transport long distance. Ċ Do benefit of this trend outweigh disadvantages?
essay:
Nowadays, as a result of climbing relationships between countries, from an economic standpoint, there are countless products that are imported from overseas. These goods that are utilized by people daily have to transport long distances. While there are some negatives associated with that, I believe the main advantages are more substantial.

On the one hand, a potential disadvantage of importing from other countries could be unbalanced supply and demand that have some adverse effects on domestic producers. For example, two years ago, owing to the lack of sufficient amount of water, the price of agricultural commodities was raised suddenly. Consequently, people trended towards foreign goods and our producers went bankrupt. Another perceived downside is that long-distance make companies use some additives in their products. In addition, research findings confirm that the chemical compositions have adverse effects on people’s health

On the other hand, a primary advantage of utilizing commodities that are produced in other nations is that individuals have access to widespread use of goods in different levels of quality. For instance, electrical gadgets that play a vital role in our daily lives are not produced in numerous countries. A further benefit is a fair competition that causes our companies to try to boost the quality of their products. Balancing supply and demand make producers provide their consumers with lower price. Furthermore, if our companies are able to compete at the highest standard of the world, we will benefit from more export.

To conclude, it is true that utilizing other countries’ goods seem disadvantageous under certain circumstances. However, I believe its positive effects in terms of a fair contest between companies and accessibility to widespread products override disadvantages.

topic: Task 2: Nowadays it is not only large companies that can be able to make films. Digital technology enables anyone to produce films. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?

In the modern society of today, digital technology does not just allow big companies to do movies that small businesses have possible to make, and this trend has lots of benefits and drawbacks. In my opinion, this growth is an advantage when anyone can also be possible to create movies.

On the one hand, there are many benefits from individuals who can shoot films because of reasons. Firstly, this trend creates opportunities to work for citizens. Obviously, it opens a new door for movie industries is that everyone can make films when they do not have funding. To illustrates, more and more people do movies and posts on Youtube, and it attracts a huge number of viewers; therefore, makers earn money. Secondly, shooting movies now do not seem as complex as in the past. Thanks to the development of high-tech that people can make products easily. For example, many films are produced through smartphones, and it brings plenty of quality movies.

Turning to another perspective, this fact poses plenty of disadvantages due to causes. First of all, movies of individuals have shared on the internet maybe unsafety. If any product was posted on the internet and it was not censored strictly, it would affect negatively people. For instance, many videos contain bad content such as teach young people to use violence on the internet. Secondly, some movies which are produced by individuals can affect the living of other people. It is clear that a lot of people become victims of critical films. For example, the life of inhabitants who belong to the LGBT community is influenced by negative movies.

In conclusion, movies now are not just produced by big companies that anyone can make films through intelligent technology; however, it has several cons namely many films do not ensure safety as well as affect to the life of private people.

topic: An American film actor John Wayne once said "Tomorrow is the most important thing in life". How important it is for individual and government to think about the future rather than focus on the present?
essay:
Some people believe that thinking about the future is more important than focusing on the present, I agree entirely with the word that tomorrow is the most important thing in life.

Thinking about the future can help individuals hold positive attitude toward their life. People, especially adults who are pay more attention on the present, usually surrounding with high pressure like unfinished work and variety bills, under these pressure day and night may lose their temper easily and eventually leads to mental diseases someday. If someone can ignore these problems and make blue plans for the light future, they are encouraged, and thus they will work enthusiastically and energetically. This is because once people planed their future and clearly know what they really want to do, they will not feel confused anymore and it easier to find the main goal of live and work. This means that they are likely to do work in a more effective way.

Planning plays a significant role in governments' administration, it is necessary for leaders to think with a long term sight. This is likely to help authorities on predicting problems they may meet in someday and taking actions to handle these risks in advance. For instance, many governments are investing in the exploring of environmental-friendly resources and preserving the stock of flues, in order to ensure the development when fossil flues are use up in decades. When the crisis of energies come true, these governments with future sight are unlikely to be shocked compare with others who are indicated in temporary benefits.

In conclusion, thinking about the future is more important than focusing on present, it not only can help individuals developing positive attitude but can also help governments escaping from crisis.

topic: Some people think that being able to communicate with others online is breaking down geographical barriers and enabling people, who would normally never have the chance to meet, to communicate. What are the advantages of international communication online? Are there any disadvantages to this?
essay:
Nowadays, some people claim that the online communication has offered the opportunity for people to interact with others from various countries around the globe, whereas in the past, they rarely had the chance to meet with individuals outside their local immediate circle. This essay will discuss the pros and cons of international online communication accordingly.

On one hand, the significant advancements in the field of technology have maintained an effective way of communication between people. Firstly, many companies that established branches in its world widely rely on internet revolution tremendously to manage their businesses effortlessly. Also, students and ordinary workers that study and work abroad use mobile phones and internet facilities to stay connected to their families. Secondly, social networking sites such as Facebook and Instagram have social groups, through which people can participate and meet with others that share common interests. Lastly, such sites have empowered people to showcase talents. This was evidenced in an article publish in the famous journal “The International Press”, ensuring that social media played a crucial role in communicating the talents of adolescents.

On the other hand, communication technology has resulted in some drawbacks. To begin with, people in present times are no more performing live conversations, and thus there are no more strong and supportive relationships. Furthermore, societies become in complete isolations because they are boarded to the virtual communication. To illustrate, a government report has stated that in cosmopolitan countries, people become less sociable and the pivotal factor leading to this phenomenon is the detrimental effect of online communication.

In conclusion, it is indisputable that internet interaction has made the Earth a global country, where people can easily stay in touch. Nevertheless, one should not neglect the dark side of this technological revolution.

topic: The expansion of multinational companies and increase in globalization produces positive effects to everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement.
essay:
The development of megacorporation around the world is enhancing the trend of international business to provide benefits to communities. In my opinion, having trade between corporations globally has positive impacts on everyone. Initially, this essay will argue that consumers satisfaction and then more employment opportunity are major benefits of opting for the globalization trend.

To begin with, the predominant advantage of global trade is the product's quality and variety. These corporations produce plenty of things which could help to give satisfaction to their customers. The quality and price of these products may vary but to get success at the international level these organizations give priority to their users. As a result, the annual profit would also be increased for these businesses. For instance, a survey conducted recently by BBC News has revealed that due to multinational enterprise 85% of the world population tends to use high-quality international brands rather than made by local industries. Therefore, this activity returns back the original value of the product's price to their customers.

Besides, these organizations and global business decrease the rate of unemployment. While opening and expanding more industries employers hire the relevant skills and qualified employees for their companies from around the world. These workers also attain opportunities to demonstrate their abilities globally instead of spending whole life in small scale factories. Consequently, they sustain their living standard with sufficient income sources. For example, thousands of people migrate to other cities or countries each year to explore their talent and achieve success in their lives. Hence, the availability of employment in multinational organization for people imparts prosperity to societies.

To conclude, this essay argued that international business by major corporations deliver several adequate products with reasonable cost and reduce the percentage of jobless crowd internationally. Thus, I strongly believe that governments of each nation should support and encourage globalization trend.

essay:
Nowadays, the world environmental problem is in a serious situation and getting worse, is included deforestation. This problem has to tackle with each country and has to prevent to increasing a deforestation.

Basically, the role of forest is residence of animal or flora, purifying water and a photosynthesis. Moreover, the leaf of tree work as a photosynthesis, this function is inhaling CO2 and exhaling O2. Despite the atmosphere is cleaned of leaves, the trees are cut and increasing a pollution. It is affected to a global warming.

Deforestation is caused by a variety of reasons, for example, for building a house as resources, making a paper or magazine and a toilet paper, the most reason is spent for papers. We consume plenty amount of paper in daily life. However, I can suggest two possible solutions to this problem. Firstly, we could choose renewable paper intentionally and after use, the paper will be recycled again. Secondly, the government should regulate a law about the limit of extent deforest. Otherwise, it will be over deforested by the illegal deforestation. What is more, the government could be supported a program that to plant trees.

As a conclusion, we should recognize individual what we can do and what we can solve for preventing deforestation. I believe that solutions would be effective and helpful.

topic: Many museums charge for admission while others are free. Do you think the advantages of charging people for admission outweighthe diadvantages ?
essay:
Entrance to museums are either free or have an admission fee, there are advantages of having it that could outweigh the disadvantages. I believe that there are more benefits of enabling a tariff for visitors.

Museums are institutions that provide knowledge to the society and add value to it, due to which it is important that they are maintained well and kept in good condition for visitors to have a good experience. Having an entrance charge, would allow the management to have enough funds to maintain and keep up with the quality of experience that is expected by visitors. In addition, having a menial charge would also help them bring more artefacts. For example, all heritage spots have a tariff, which assists in the restoration of the site, as these structures are probably 1000's of years old.

On the contrary, when museums have free entry, it provides access to all strata of people, which would have a higher educational value, giving equal opportunity to all. As museums provide information on heritage, it would be beneficial for people to have free access, although this would mean the museum would be maintained by the Government. The Government would be using the tax received from citizens to fund the museum, which may or may not be acceptable due to varied interests by locals. Due to which, the Government would eventually have to introduce an entry charge for maintenance of facilities. For instance, some of the heritage sites, that were managed by the Government was handed over to private companies, as they were not being maintained and falling apart. These private companies then added an entry tariff, which reduced the number of visitors.

To conclude, having an entrance payment, which is menial, would support the Government and Management to maintain the museum while also allow visitors of all strata to afford it. In addition, providing special discounts to students and locals would encourage more people to visit, widening the opportunity for education.

  Premise: The introduction of fees led to a reduction in visitor numbers.

  A minimal entrance fee supports sustainable museum management while remaining accessible.
  Premise: A small entrance payment helps support both the government and museum management in maintaining the museum.

abstractive_summary: Charging a modest entrance fee for museums offers greater benefits than free admission by ensuring sustainable maintenance and preservation of cultural institutions. Since museums provide significant societal and educational value, adequate funding through visitor contributions supports both upkeep and the acquisition of new artifacts, similar to the model used successfully at heritage sites. While free entry could enhance accessibility and equalize cultural access, relying solely on taxpayer funding may prove impractical and unsustainable, especially given past failures in government management. Introducing a minimal, affordable fee—supplemented by discounts for students and locals—balances financial sustainability with continued public access, promoting long-term educational and cultural engagement without excluding any socioeconomic group.

topic: Nowadays , many people are spending less and less time at home , What are the causes of it? What are the effects of this on individuals as well as on the society?
essay:
People are now spending more time outside the home. Various reasons behind the behaviour and it brings both negative and positive influences personally and socially.

Several causes lead to outside-home behaviour. Firstly, there are many dual-income families, meaning that both adults are breadwinners and have to leave home for a long period to earn bread and butter. They work hard for not only perks, bonuses and other financial rewards, but also career progression by attending training or day release programmes. Secondly, with the abundance of amenities in modern cities, people have more places to go in their leisure time. For example, citizens are accessible to a range of cultural attractions including theatres, museums even sporting events, all of which are located outside the home. Finally, with the expansion of the urban areas, city dwellers have to commute quite a long time for work, leaving less time for home.

The influences are seen on both sides. People could benefit from being away from the sedentary lifestyle, which is possibly caused by staying at home all the time. They tend to have more active lifestyles by going outdoors. Furthermore, public places are expected to be visited by more tourists, leading to an increase in revenues. However, objections could also be seen as inevitable congestion caused by substantial vehicles and excessive use of road networks. What's more, the scarcity of companionship may lead to mental health problems among teenagers. Lacking role models at home, kids are less likely to learn codes of conduct and conventional rules and they may also be the victims of crimes. For instance, many youth behaviours like abduction, bullying and peer threats happen to adolescents whose family members are usually away from home.

To sum up, load and distance of work and abundant ways of amusement make populations go out of home, leading to themselves a healthy life and rich social incomes while traffic strains and mental problems on teenagers should not be neglected either.

topic: Some people think that a sense of competition in children should be encouraged. Others believe that children who are taught to co-operate rather than compete become more useful adults.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
The intense of competition in the graduate job markets has prompted many educators to emphasis the importance of competition rather than co-operation between students. But is such a competitive skill the basis of being a useful adult?

The advantages of being competitive in the modern society are apparent. People who have such abilities are believed more likely to gain competitive jobs, win in a business and become the leaders of the masses. The capacity of competitiveness and individualism cultivated in an early age, admittedly, do help the person to win in some circumstances.

On the other hand, even though such person may success to some extent, it is hard for them to maintain their achievements in a long term basis. The fundamental reason for this is, I believe, they are more easily to be an enemy of team workers, business partners and even their bosses due to their personality of being selfish and individualism. Without cooperating and collaborating with others, they would encounter many barriers from different aspects and would not be able to achieve any success.

Apart from that, children, specifically, with over-strong ambitious to be a winner are more likely to suffer failure psychologically due to their emotional immature. It is the educators' responsibility to enhance the children's ability comprehending what is team work, why it is essential to be a good team-player, and how to win through cooperating with others. With those in mind, they will hold positive attitudes with the supports from their teams to face challenges and failure during any competitions.

In conclusion, it is advantageous to have ability to compete with others, while learning to be a good team player and compete in a positive way is the fundament to be a success adult in a long-term basis. Thus, educators must emphasis the importance of co-operation rather than competition in children's education.

topic: Full title: Soon people who cannot work with computers will be disadvantaged. To what extend do you agree or disagree with this idea?
essay:
Computers are indispensable part of modern life. Not only they play essential role in workplaces around the world, also the Internet, biggest invention since font, is directly connected to them. One who does not possess basic skills to use computer, is at modern workplace only redundant worker.

To begin with, almost 107 million units of computer were sold last year in Asia-Pacific region. This number clearly presents the demand buyers have. Bus stations, restaurants, groceries, ZOOs, even Alpine huts, they all have various forms of computer. Computerizing has already stepped over the brink to where one could decline it.

Furthermore, E-tax, social networks, up-to-date news, live broadcast, they are all part of our social interactions. To access those medias, you have to have a computer. Next, many traditional processes are being replaced (or updated) by computer. For example, buying a plane ticket, changing your primary address, paying bills, even entering for an examination is now done solely with computer.

Obviously, when applying for a job in office, you ought to have basic computer skills. Secretaries are entailed to handle harder tasks, such as using printer or various office applications.

To sum up, one who does not possess basic skills for using computer is disadvantaged. No matter the occurrence, with technology nowadays, sooner or later an occasion will appear that will require some knowledge of computers.

topic: Many people believe that formal "pen and paper' examinations are not the best method of assessing educational achievement. What is your view of examinations?
essay:
Many people state traditional written examns are not the best method to meassure a person's profit from education. In my opinion, these pen and paper exams are a fair way to evaluate a student as will be expounded below.

People who think exams are useless when assessing adwuired knowledge argue this doesn't put the studient in a real situation, therefore, onely continous learning should be considered to say whether a student pass a subject or not. But in my opinion written final task shoulnd't be excluded as far as they give a fair result of the general achievement obtaiden along the academic year.

Other evidence used against written exams is the possibility of cheating it offers to a group of students performing the same examn at the same moment. It makes them to consider better alternatives such as oral examination or group assingments. The first option breaks the condition of equallity for every student, moreover, it may be a very subjective evaluation method. In the other hand, working in groups doesn't solve the problem of cheating, and doens't offer a sample of individual effort.

Some of the detractors of final examns think is wrongful to put a student under such a preassure to weigh up if they deserve to pas a whole subject only by their rendering in a certain moment. But I think they can find this situation in their everyday as a proffessional when all their efforts are reduced to the ability they demonstrate in an instant: as surgeons, lawyers, teachers or engineers,...just a decission can change everything.

To conclude, there must be a lot of aspect to evaluate in a student, but all of them meet in the point of a global examination, that makes much easier the work of putting a mark in a subject.

Major claim:
  Traditional written exams are a fair way to evaluate a student.

Claim 1:
  Written final tasks should not be excluded.
  Premise: Written final tasks provide a fair result of the general achievement obtained over the academic year.
  Counterargument: Some argue that written exams do not place students in real-life situations and therefore only continuous learning should determine passing.
  Rebuttal: None

Claim 2:
  There must be multiple aspects to evaluate in a student.
  Premise: All evaluation aspects converge in a global examination.
  Premise: A global examination makes it much easier to assign a subject grade.
  Counterargument: Some argue that written exams create excessive pressure by judging a whole subject on performance at a single moment.
  Rebuttal: Professionals in fields like surgery, law, teaching, and engineering also face critical decisions hinging on momentary performance, making such pressure realistic.
  Counterargument: Written exams allow cheating when administered simultaneously to groups.
  Rebuttal: Oral examinations are not equitable and may be subjective.
  Premise: Oral examinations may be a very subjective evaluation method.
  Rebuttal: Group assignments do not prevent cheating and do not reflect individual effort.
  Premise: Group assignments do not offer a sample of individual effort.
abstractive_summary: Traditional written exams are a fair method for evaluating student achievement, as they reflect the overall knowledge gained throughout the academic year and should not be discarded. While some argue that such exams lack real-world relevance and favor continuous assessment, written finals remain a valid measure of cumulative learning. A comprehensive evaluation should consider multiple aspects, best captured through a global examination that simplifies grading. Although concerns exist about the pressure of single-moment performance and risks of cheating, high-stakes decision-making is common in professions like medicine and law, making such pressure realistic. Alternative methods like oral exams or group work introduce subjectivity and fail to ensure individual accountability.

pro_keypoints: Examinations provide a standardized measure of student knowledge and performance.
Timed written tests encourage students to develop discipline and time-management skills.
Formal assessments ensure accountability in education for students, teachers, and institutions.
con_keypoints: Exams often prioritize memorization over deep understanding and critical thinking.
High-stakes testing may increase student anxiety and hinder authentic learning.
Alternative assessments can better evaluate creativity, problem-solving, and practical skills.

topic: some people say that government should not put money into building theatre's and sports stadium, they should focus on medical care and education. To what extent do you agree or disgree?
essay:
Nowadays , many individuals believe that governments are constructing public entertainment places like sports stadiums and theatres rather than building hospitals and schools . In my opinion , I partly agree with this view and I will explain more details in the following paragraphs .

On the one hand , building some theatres or stadiums could bring some positive benefits to that particular community.For example , many jobs opportunities can be available during and after the construction and people can join more sports-related activities or entertainment concerts when their leisure time .In addition , governments can be hosted to celebrate national or international level competitions based on those infrastructures.However , if governments are trying to build those kinds of buildings more than the requirements , they will not be able to contribute their budget to other sectors like health care or education .Consequently , people will not obtain proper health and education systems .

On the other hand , there is no doubt that people should obtain sophisticated medical facilities and education systems . For instance , one survey from social science organization shows that people who lived in rural areas require good hospitals and schools in their regions rather than huge football grounds or opera houses . Moreover , some authorities are implementing unnecessary buildings like sports complexes or huge theatres to attract their citizens' attention and some political reasons. As a result , those infrastructures are not useful for their people and maintenance costs are higher than they expected .

Taking everything into consideration , governments should balance their construction for their people . They have to think about profits and drawbacks before doing any projects like building schools or sports grounds . Otherwise , all the consequences will be suffered by their next generations.

topic: Nowadays, the way many people interact with each other has changed because of technology. In what ways has technology affected the types of relationships people make? Has this become a positive or negative development?
essay:
It is true that nowadays technology rules the world. Undoubtedly, human interaction has been influenced through introduction of new technological devices. Obviously, there are positive and negative impacts on people communicaton, that technology is responsible for.

First of all, absolute advantage is that technology makes the world move faster. To support, speed of daily business interactions increasing all the time. Internet, mobile phones, online conferences significantly saves time on solving any business issues such as contract agreement, recruitment procedures or client attraction. Introduction of new software or modified machines boosts volumes of production as well as it saves time. Moreover, technology overcomes distance obstacle tremendously. For instance, use of mobile phones, internet provides people with the opportunity to find new friends all over the world, without leaving own apartment and stay connected with relatives while studying or working abroad.

On the other hand, introduction and popularity of new technological devices may have harmful impact on human interaction. It is mentioned that people prefer spending their time using personal gadgets over real face to face communication. This problem has already become global issue. Many governmental bodies introduce social advertising campaign in order to attract attention to the problem of declining rate of face-to-face communication.Additionally, it is known that more and more people at work are now being replaced by machines. As a result working environment of a regular employee is changed, and common area of interaction is limited to number of machines instead of coworkers.

Technology, like two sided coin, has positive and negative impacts on people communication. However, undoubtedly, negative side of the issue is being overweighed by positive one. Because development of new technology is a result of mankind evolution. Updated technology provide greater opportunities in any field will it be personal or business.

In general, technology positively and negatively affects human interaction. However positive impacts overweight negative ones.

topic: In spite of the advances made in agriculture, many people around the world still go hungry. Ċ Why is this the case? Ċ What can be done about this problem?
essay:
Nowadays the agricultural industry has been revolutionized expansively. For this reason, there are tremendous transformations have been made to support our societies. However, those phenomena might not lead to prosper our communities; many people still struggle for their hunger matters. This essay therefore will elaborate on some causes of that problem and several solutions will be proposed briefly.

Firstly, in terms of the supply chain process, not only is the production of crops important but also the distribution. For instance, while infrastructures are not well prepared, it might be challenging to supply the produces to communities there. While perishable produce, moreover, need more specific handling such as refrigerators to keep them fresh, it would add more difficulties for habitants to distribute them properly. Thus, this makes it clear that many people still starving and suffer malnutrition worldwide.

One effective solution that can be done to solve this problem is improving our distribution system. For example, the government could initiate funding for constructing roads and other transport features to enhance connectivity and accessibility around there. In addition, they could strategically create several masterplans, which could be associated with infrastructure or the health-and-nutrition sector, to project some programs for their better future. The better they could plan structurally, the more losses they could lessen. Consequently, we could solve, or at least reduce, this starving problem worldwide.

To conclude, the agricultural revolution has not solved our world’s hunger condition yet; insufficiencies of the distribution system might be the cause. Hence, we could carefully create masterplans to build better connectivity and accessibility for poor areas. After a thorough analysis of this subject, it is then recommended to engage private sectors for solving these issues conjointly.

abstractive_summary: Despite the advancements of the agricultural revolution, global hunger persists due to critical flaws in food distribution rather than insufficient crop production. Effective food security depends not only on growing food but also on efficiently delivering it, particularly to vulnerable communities. Poor infrastructure, especially the lack of refrigeration and transportation networks, hampers the delivery of perishable goods and contributes to widespread food loss. These systemic distribution challenges are a major cause of ongoing malnutrition and starvation. To address this, governments and private sectors must collaborate to develop strategic masterplans, invest in roads and logistics, and improve structural planning, thereby enhancing connectivity, reducing food waste, and ultimately alleviating global food insecurity.

topic: It is neither possible nor useful to provide university places for a high proportion of young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In this knowledge-based society, more and more people need to have an university degree to gain a better life, especially in young adults. However, it is both impossible and unuseful to provide almost all young people to university places. Therefore, I totslly agree with this point of view.

Firstly, having an university degree no longer has a vital role in the future of young people even in competitive society. In many countries, especially Germany, vocational training has been more popular because it enhances the ability of students to not only gain life skills and practical experience but also open the door to better job opportunities in later life. Furthermore, if every young adults are accepted for university, this factor would cause the imbalance of economical situation and damage the development of a country. This is because there is a little employees who choose a blue-collar jobs such as worker in a factory, farmers and so on.

Secondly, it is impossible to provide almost all young people with access to tertiary education. In Vietnam, for example, the population has increased significantly, nearly 100 million people, and ypung people accounted for the highest propportion. Therefore, it is simply unrealistic for university to accommodate almost young adults . Moreover, the demand for entering college never ceases to grow. This leads to a problem that the poor suffer from their finance due to exorbitant education costs in many financially independent universities such as National Economics University. I think that nearly all young people continue to study tertiary education is impossible.

In conclusion, for the reasons mentioned above, I would argue that the idea of pursuing university education for a high proportion of young people is completely unrealistic.

topic: Unhealthy eating has a negative effect on both individuals and the society in which Ċ they live. Some people think that the government should tax unhealthy foods while Ċ others believe that a ‘fat tax’ is unfair and unnecessary. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion
essay:
Increasing preference towards fast food is the leading cause of unhealthy nations.Few are of the opinion that imposing taxation on transfat cuisine discourage the public from buying it,while others believe that the public like to eat irrespective of the additional cost.This essay will discuss both views including my opinion on the positive benefits of additional taxation .

To begin with,fast food culture is one of the leading causes of systemic illness in the people,leading to an increased burden on the healthcare of a society.Taxation by the authorities will discourage citizens from spending on unhealthy food.Even if they spend,they make sure to buy in small quantities.Moreover, the revenue generated from the tax can be used to create awareness among people about the bad effects of consuming unhealthy food on the organs of the body.For instance,recently to curb the increasing number of obese cases in the city,local authorities imposed taxes,which proved successful in deterring people from buying it.Therefore,imposing taxes is one way to wake people up from bad dietary habits.

On the other hand,increased taxes will not deter fast food lovers.They consume it irrespective of the cost and is not a feasible solution in the long run.Additionally,high taxes may result in the losses of these businesses,who are forced to wind up their operations affecting the revenue for local government.For example,a recent survey by Deccan Chronicle showed that the government was running on a deficit budget due to the winding up of fast-food restaurants.These are the reasons why critics feel that taxation is not a viable solution.

To conclude,fast- food culture is a health hazard for modern society.Although people prefer to eat it irrespective of the cost;however,in my opinion ,increased taxes will discourage people from buying it in large quantities.

topic: Present a written argument or case to an educated reader with no special knowledge of the following topic: The idea of having a single career is becoming an old fashioned one. The new fashion might be to have several careers or ways of earning money and further education will be something that continues throughout life.
essay:
Nowadays, many people think that pursuing several careers or ways of earning money and further education is better than having a single career. In my opinion, I would argue that both cases also have their own advantages and disadvantages and the most important thing are our choices.

On the one hand, having one work might be appropriate for a large number of people. Firstly, focusing on only one long-term work might help people to obtain high promotions with higher income than other. The fact is that employees or officers might improve significantly their qualifications and experiences that make their considerable advantages compared to others who do not focusing on works. Secondly, not everyone might have ability to pursuit several works or way of earning money and further education. Instead of wasting their health to do many works at the same time or further studying, they should focus on their current work and spend the free time for relaxing or taking care of their family.

On the other hand, pursuing several careers or ways of earning money or further education also bring a large amount of advantages. Firstly, through experiencing several careers, people might choose the most proper career that they feel satisfies and happiest. Secondly, by doing several works at the same time, employees might earn extra money that might be spent for their family, travelling. Thirdly, higher education might have people have a good profile that might make significant advantage when they apply for higher position in the future compared to others.

In conclusion, I would argue that having a single career or pursuing several works or ways of earning money and higher education also has their own advantages. People should carefully consider before choosing which one is most proper to them.

topic: It has been said that people who read for pleasure have more developed imaginations and better language skills than people who prefer to watch TV. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Children can create some skills when they read real books. Research had been found that words can cultivate more thinking than animations or movies. I totally do agree with this and I’m going to discuss both why is it and what benefits can it have.

Firstly, since you are reading, you have to know what it means. Which conveys that you have an input to your brain. Afterwards, you need to convert a single vocabulary into sentences in order to understand it. This process can truly develop language skills and contribute various vocabularies. Although it may be accumulated slowly, this kind of ability can actually improve one’s literacy. For example, one study in the USA had been studied that those people who love literature have more achievements than those who don’t.

Secondly, words can provide a variety of imaginations. We can say that when you are processing those articles, you are trying to dream about what is going on in the books. In addition, it can surely boost imagining techniques. An experiment has shown that reading does have more brain’s activations than watching films. Subsequently, it does have more outcomes after these actions. For instance, some elementary schools ask students to read further books in their school’s lives. This can not only establish their habitats in studying but also make their databases more luxurious.

To conclude, I consider that people who read do have more developed imaginations and better language skills whereas those who watch do not have those benefits. Also, I do believe that children should have more chances to read than using their mobile phones.

topic: Popular events like the football World Cup and other international sporting occasions are essential in easing international tensions and releasing patriotic emotions in a safe way. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Peeking back at the history of mankind, sports and games are devised to spend the leisure time. Sports not only make an individual healthy and disciplined physically but also if played in groups it creates an atmosphere of friendship and tolerance.

Now days in this twenty first century, where we are living in a global village sports is inevitable for the people of a nation to enjoy. The international sporting events like foot ball world cup, cricket, hockey or Olympics so on so forth, such events are organized to promote beneficial relationships between countries.

In such international events teams from different parts of the world compete for a title .Firstly, such competitions help a lot in easing up the tensions between nations because before starting any such events team players not only stand face to face but also shake hands before and after the match and stand respectfully for their and other country's national anthem that depicts their respect for each other.These events brings the entrepreneurs of the countries together and helps them to boost economically as well for example if any such event is going to take place in a country so that host country will build or renovate their fields as Bejing(China) made an exquisite nest shape for the Olympics 2008 and lots of people or engineers get employed for that .Hence ,organizing such events improves the revenue not only of the host country's but the participants countries as well.

Secondly,looking at the other side of the picture ,some countries ,are somewhat become belligerent while competing against their popular competitors. At times it becomes difficult for them to conceal their emotions.

However ,we should always try to take things in a rather productive perspective as Michael Jordan say and I quote: Just play. Have fun. Enjoy the game.

topic: Many people join distance-learning programs (study material, post, TV, Internet) and study at home, but some people think that it cannot bring the same benefit as attending colleges or universities does. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Distance learning, a modern phenomenon, has become widely popular, especially after the invention of the internet.While there are many students who study at home using technology, some people believe that it is not as beneficial as physically attending a university. I completely agree with this view because attending college has a direct influence on the overall development and intellect of a student.

Nowadays, it is true that paper-based study is an old method. In this regard, modern people are keen to replace it with internet resources, as it will be affordable for many citizens. In other words, they should not pay a huge amount of money for their universities and colleges.Furthermore, online learning is comfortable for housewives, as they will get knowledge if the authorities provide them with such kinds of opportunities.For instance, many housewives have duties at home, and this is the main reason why they do have not a diploma or certificate.

On the other hand, educational institution education is not restricted to some textbook lessons as it also focuses on creating an enlightened generation through a favourable environment where students learn to interact with each other, discover the diversity of cultures, and learn to face real-life challenges. Some video scripts and printed documents cannot teach them how to use those in the practical world.Taking an online course to learn to play the guitar could be a classic example. A recent study by the University of Sussex reveals that nine out of ten online guitar learners fail to master it due to the lack of motivation and this is where the formal education comes in - motivating students.

To conclude, we attend educational institutes to learn and become enlightened citizens, not to memorize lessons and pass exams. While distance learning can be a bonus to our already enlightened mind, it can never be the same as studying at a college or academy.

topic: formal academic qualification is not enough Topic: Nowadays, some employers think that formal academic qualifications are more important than life experience or personal qualities when they look for new employees. Why is in this case? Is a positive or negative development?
essay:
In these modern days, recruiters tend to prefer employees with formal academic qualifications than those with life experience and personal qualities. I personally believe that this is a negative development.

There are certain reasons for the changing criteria in recruitment nowadays. The first and perhaps most important reason is that academic qualifications are often a reliable proof of one's ability, which helps the employers to save time testing their employees' quality. Moreover, some jobs such as researchers and professors require technical knowledge which can probably be provided better in higher education. Also, it will improve the reputation of the company whose employees are all formally qualified. For instance, there are several law firms that only employ graduates from prestigious schools like Harvard so that their clients would have faith in their lawyers.

However, I believe that overestimating qualifications could lead to numerous negative impacts. First, this development might prompt job-seekers to fake their qualifications in order to avoid being unemployed. In addition, not all qualifications are reliable, in Vietnam some people even earned a Master degree through an online course after a few months. Finally, it is highly likely that a wide range of potential workers could be overlooked as they do not have high qualification, which is a huge loss for a company.

To conclude, it is some employers' belief that formal academic qualification are more important than life experience or personal qualities of employees due to several reasons. In my opinion, this development has negative effects on both companies and job-seekers.

topic: More children in developed countries are becoming overweight. This is a serious problem for wealthy countries. Ċ Discuss some causes and effects of this problem. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
One of the most conspicuous trends in today's world is obesity in rich nations. Modern lifestyles and eating habits are having a huge impact on teenagers in gaining weight. On the other hand, medical experts suggest that to avoid the inevitable parents should interfere in fast food intake and encourage traditional healthy diet for better living. In my view, there are many factors that are involved and this essay will explain the pros and cons in detail.

topic: Some people prefer to work for a large company. Ċ Others prefer to work for a small company. Which would you prefer? Ċ Use specific reasons and examples to support your choice.
essay:
Nowadays, job seekers have a wide variety of companies to choose from. Some prefer a more home-like atmosphere of small organizations, while others like a corporate approach that is used in bigger companies. Some may provide more spiritual values, and the competitor - more tangibles.

Large business brings more money than the smaller one, therefore employees can have a bigger income, so it is understandable why people would like to work there. Furthermore, having such employer on the resume can be more beneficial to one's career. For instance, tech companies, most likely, would like to hire a candidate who has experience working in Google, rather than the one who worked in a small organization for the same period of time.

On the contrary, smaller firms may not be able to offer the same salary level as large conglomerates, however, they can offer a much more friendly environment. Usually, in smaller places, people tend to know each other better, hence forming an atmosphere that feels more like home, where every member is valued. For example, having a small chat on the kitchen with the CEO can be a common thing in these places, which is not the case is large firms. Some may consider it as a trade-off for a smaller wage.

In conclusion, although places like Google or Loblaw will always have candidates for every job opening, as they can offer bigger salary, there always will be a candidate for small business job posting, that is willing to dump money from the equation in favour a more friendly place.

topic: "When people succeed, it is because hard work. Luck has nothing to do with this success." Do you agree or disagree with the quotation above? Use specific reasons and examples to explain your position.
essay:
There is a proverb that goes "genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration". Although some people spend their whole lives waiting for a miracle to make their dreams come true. I have always believed that hard work is the key to success, especially for people who want to achieve an academic success or to be wealthy.

To begin with, People must work hard in order to succeed at school. Success can be achieved by trying several times, no matter what difficulties people face. They must not let themselves defeated by previous failures. For example, even though I got seventeen in the writing section last time I took the TOEFL test, which was the first time I take it, I did not stop practicing hard to improve my score in this section.

topic: Scientists predict in the near future cars will be driven by computers, not people. Ċ Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
essay:
In the world of computer science, it is believed that in the near future, machines will take control of futuristic vehicles, instead of humanity. Even though this situation creates certain drawbacks, there will also be some benefits, and this essay will address both of these aspects.

On the one hand, there are several reasons why this has disadvantages. To begin with, one of the most significant features is they are afraid that the machinery will lose control of the vehicles. To be more specific, if some means of transport have issues about their engine or their A.I control, it can have some massive damage to the road systems. For instance, some software may cause delays or be hacked, which causes troubles to the users. As a result, computers will be out of control and the cars will crash into other transports or the road system, causing mayhem to other drivers. Another factor is the loss of employment since the ones who depend on their job as a taxi driver or carpooler will be in difficulty.

On the other hand, a number of advantages of this trend still exist that people should take into consideration. Initially,robots are more able to constantly focus on the road than humans. In particular, computers, which have no emotions, do not have the feeling of humanity such as tired, drunk or sleepy, they can stare on the road for a long time, even days, while people need time to relax or get some rest. Consequently, they will be able to travel a long distance on the road without stopping, unless the vehicle is out of gas. One more thing is that computers always follow the traffic rules, like what to do on the junction, the beltway, the overpass, etc, which sometimes individuals ignore.

To sum up, both the positive and negative of this trend will always co-exist. However, in the future, it is predicted that computers will be upgraded and enhanced to the point where they will make people’s life more efficient.

topic: Some people believe that teenagers should be required to do unpaid community work in their free time. This can benefit teenagers and the community as well. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree.
essay:
offspring are the backbone of every country. So, there are communities who tend to believe that youngsters should be encouraged to initiate social work as it will result in flourished society and individualistic growth of youngsters themselves. I, too believe that this motivation has more benefits than its drawbacks.

To begin with, social work by children can be easily associated with personality development because, during this drive, they tend to communicate with a variety of people, which leads to polished verbal skills. For example, if they start convincing rural people to send their children to school they have to be such a convincing attitude along with developed verbal skills to deal with diverse kinds of people there. This improved skill will help them lifelong in every arena. Apart from this, the true values of life like tolerance, patience, team spirit, cooperation can be learned. Besides that, the young minds serve the country with full enthusiasm that gives the feeling of fulfilment and self-satisfaction. This worthiness for themselves brims them with self-confidence and patriotic feeling. Moreover, going and experiencing multiple cultures and traditions make their horizon so broad that add one more feather to their cap.

However, It is truly said, no rose without thrones. Can the drawbacks of this initiation be ignored? Children go to school, participate in different curriculum activities, endure the pressure of peers, parents, and teachers and in the competitive world, they should not be expected to serve society without their self-benefits. This kind of pressure might bring resentment to their mind.

In conclusion, I believe, the notion of a teenager doing unpaid work is indeed good but proper monitoring and care should be given to avoid untoward consequences.

topic: In many countries, women and men are working full time, therefore logical for women and men to share household tasks. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Gone were the day when women were supposed to stay at home, and men were meant to work outside. Nowadays, with the rising gender equality, both male and female can be full-time workers. Hence, to follow the egalitarian mindset, it is logical for both of them to share the housework. Therefore, in my opinion, I completely agree with the above statement.

Someone may believe that it is better to follow the traditional way of the division of labour; that is, women take care of the home, while men earn money outside. Because of the general perceptions that women are more attentive than her partner, thus, they are more capable of housework. For instance, in traditional Chinese society, girls were trained to cook or to perform cleansing works. As a result, the discrepancy in personalities between two genders leads to an unbalanced distribution of household tasks, where females take most of the job.

However, despite the conventional stereotype, it is indeed more beneficial for women and men to share household tasks. As they have different strengths and weaknesses, it is more effective for them to collaborate and finish those tasks together. For example, men, supposedly, are stronger. So, they are more suitable to repair light bulbs or move the furniture. While for women, they may take up the housework which requires less physical strength, such as cookings. In this way, both men and women can work together with a higher efficiency.

To conclude, men and women will get a greater benefit if they allocate the household jobs in a logical sense. In light of the above, it is my conviction that they should share this work accordingly. Be it for achieving equality or be it for attaining greater effectiveness, sharing is a better way.

topic: Happiness is considered very important in life. Why is it difficult to define? What factors are important in achieving happiness? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Happiness is something that we all desire, but not many achieve. Mostly people linked happiness with wealth and material success or emotions and charming personal relationship. However, I do understand that some people may not agree with this opinion. This essay will address to define the happiness and what are the factors that are important to achieve happiness.

First of all, happiness can be interpreted in different ways. It usually depends on the ages. For instance, children feel happiness when they get an ice-cream or chocolate; teenagers feel happiness when they have a game device on hand; adults feel happiness when they have a good relationship and wealthy life; elderly people feel happiness when they are having meal with their children. In this case, it can be said that there are different definitions of happiness in every stages of age. However, there can be an exception such as some children feel that chocolate and ice-cream are disgusting.

On the other hand, there are several factors that are important in achieving happiness. But I think the crucial part is you need to clarify that what is important to you and what is not important to you. So, you can find contentment in living a simple life. For example, I think it is important for me to have a complete family so I feel happiness because I have a lovely family.

On the whole, the best way to achieve happiness is satisfied all the things are gifted to us. Sometimes, we even forget the things that make us happier but keep reminding the things that sadden us. So we should have a positive attitude towards life to achieve happiness.

topic: In many countries schools have severe problems with student behavior. What do you think are the causes of this? What solutions can you suggest?
essay:
Education is essential in modern societies. Students develop various skills and gain knowledge in their school lives. However, many schools are now facing students' lack of discipline, such as disrespectful to the teachers, skipping classes, vandalize public property, to name a few.

I believe that the increasing number of students' misbehaviors is the result of lack of parenting and low fertility rate. In most families, both parents have a job in order to provide for their children. Long hours of work replace the quality time that was cherished few decades ago. Children often feel neglected, and might therefore try to do something mischievous to get the parents' attention. Furthermore, to compensate for the time they spent working, and also due to the fact that they have only one or two children, parents spoil them by agreeing to everything their babies ask. This results in misbehaviors in schools.

To tackle the problem, I believe that the most efficient way is by government funding, which is providing public day-care centers and workshops with volunteered tutors (from local universities) that can provide one-on-one attention where children can complete their assignments and work on extra projects. That way, students have places to go to after school instead of wandering off the streets or watching television at home by themselves. Since there are adults in the centers to supervise them, help them, or listen to them, youngsters can feel a sense of belonging and that there is someone to go to when encountering difficulties.

Children are our future, and it is crucial that we address this issue as early as possible.

topic: Production of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases has a heating effect on the atmosphere and results in global warming. Ċ Why global warming is considered one of the most serious issues nowadays? Ċ How can this problem be solved?
essay:
Global warming is the topic of all the discussions these days. Emissions of greenhouse gases made the temperature of the planet go up. The rise in overall heat of the planet will result in melting of water resources rapidly and the hotter climate will not be suitable for mankind’s survival. One and only ecologically efficient solution of this will be the trees. In this essay, the effects of global warming and its solution will be discussed.

To begin with, global warming is dangerous because the trapped heat in the atmosphere will eat up the water sources. Retained heat increases the overall temperature of the globe causing the rapid meltdown of glaciers. If this continued, mankind will face scarcity of water which is essential for human’s survival. For example, in the last decade,15% of glaciers melted owning to rise in temperatures. Hence, the surge in the planet’s heat is a serious consequence of the greenhouse effect.

On the other hand, growing more will be the solution to reducing carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases so that the heating effect on the atmosphere is reduced. Trees are the natural converter of Carbon Dioxide to Oxygen. Therefore, reducing the carbon footprint. If more flora is on the job of converting the smaller the footprint. For instance, in a report concluded by Oxford University, London states that 0.5% of emission is brought down just by planting trees in 5 acres of land. Thus, growing more and more trees will cool down the planet.

In summary, global warming is a serious threat to the survival of humans because the hotter climate is not suitable for man’s survival. Growing more trees will alleviate greenhouse emissions.
