topic: Some people say that the best way to improve public health is by increasing the number of sports facilities. Others, however, say that this would have little effect on public health and that other measures are required. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
Improvement in health is one of the primary objectives of most countries in the present world. While many individuals believe that this can be attained by constructing additional sports centres, a sizable group thinks that this solely might not have much impact unless other measures are also taken. In my opinion, public health can be improved if the other measures, such as awareness and participation are encouraged together with more sports facilities. This essay will discuss both views and provide further details to substantiate my view.

To commence with, an increased number of sports facilities give opportunities for a healthier lifestyle. Due to extreme workload and busy schedules, individuals tend to neglect their basic fitness, resulting in deterioration of their well-being. This can be managed if the establishments are available locally and accessible offering convenience. Society can deem it easier to dedicate their time towards fitness improvement. Several nations, for instance, have started initiatives to spend a considerable part of their funds on this particular aspect aiming towards a healthier world.

Conversely, focussing on the construction of new sites might not encourage society to prioritize their health. This can be acquired by an initiative to spread awareness of the detrimental effects of the sedentary lifestyle either through local advertisements or having a spokesperson deliver the message. In addition to this, the other method is to organize various events and competitions, for example, marathons and an event with a well-known celebrity which allows individuals to participate in various physical activities. This can be one of the effective regimens and take us a step closer to the objective of public health.

To conclude, although introducing a large number of sites offering games and activities is one of the ways to improve physical activities, it fails to show an impact unless people are educated about the negative impacts of their non-active life and provide opportunities to participate in the means of attaining fitness. After a thorough analysis of the topic, I think that if the public is made aware of the situation and offered services in the form of activities establishments, which are convenient as well as events encouraging participation, we might witness a health-oriented foreseeable future.

topic: In future nobody will buy printed newspapers or books because they will be able to read everything they want online without paying Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
In recent years, by improving technology, people tend to read books and newspapers on the Internet, and the proportion of purchasing paper goods will reduce in the future. I wholeheartedly agree with this matter. And personally would rather read everything online. And in the essay below, I will mention the reasons.

To begin with, the main positive reason for the issue is that it is an eco-friendly way to read texts and news. Because instead of cutting and using trees for providing readers and newspapers, individuals can use online research engines. Thus, there is no need to eliminate the forests. To illustrate, in Balk city, for producing 10000 pages, they must cut over 1 hectare of woods.

In addition, fewer transportation vehicles will be needed and due to this fewer fossil fuels will be consumed. Hence, the method helps to reduce air and noise pollution and in the long- term overcome the crisis and serious problems such as global warming. For example, for producing a book with 100 pages, we have to cut a tree and consume 100-litre oil, but with the contemporary reading, we can save thousands of trees and decrease the amount of CO2 emission in the atmosphere.

Moreover, reading online information is the best convenient and economical way and also time-efficient. Since we can purchase everywhere and at any moment a book and read it immediately, there is no need to go out and spend hours to buy it. Therefore, individuals have a chance to utilize the saved time to read more articles on the Internet. For instance, for buying a newspaper people have to utilize transportation and spend too many hours on traffic congestion, but this method is a worthwhile remedy.

In conclusion, although reading printed books and newspapers is a traditional and beautiful habit, for dealing with occurring predicament situations namely, climate change and time consumption, it is better that folks use alternative strategies like online reading. And in my view, it is a viable and feasible solution.

topic: Topic:  Studying the English language in an English-Speaking country is the best but not the only way to learn language. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Studying a language is a grate advantage for our lives. If we can learn language like English, it is better to learn in a country such as Britain, Australia etc., but there are another ways for learn English. Hence, Studying English in a native speaking country is better, but it is not only way to learn English.

In native English speaking countries, they have been organizing their all academic activities in English. Therefore, they have a chance to learn grammatical patterns, habits etc., during their primary, secondary and higher studies. Furthermore, they have an experiences, about their societies and culture also. When I was doing my masters, in Britain, I met lots of British friends and families, then I got valuable experiences of handling of my English language. Also, they have high slandered language proficiency, than non-English speaking country person.

On the other hand, all around the world, many English language programs are conducting. Most of their higher studies programs are conducted in English, such as undergraduate programs, masters, etc., Now a days, as a optional, many countries of the world, conducting their primary and secondary education in English. Hence, there are many other ways for learn English with good slandered. These non-native English speaking contries, conduct the international recognized exams, which evaluate the English language such as IELTS, TOFEL, etc.,

In conclusion, it is important to visit English speaking country, then we can learn English language in high standard way, but that is not only the way for learn English. If some one need to study English from non-English speaking country, there are many other recognized ways for study English such as exams, academic programs etc., then they can improve their language proficiency for their future prosperity.

topic: People nowadays prefer to interact online (e.g. do shopping, chat with friends) rather than talking to other people face-to-face. Ċ What are the reasons for this? Ċ Is this a positive or negative development? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It can be easily recognized that communicating through the internet is becoming more and more engaging to people, in comparison with face-to-face interaction. There are several factors that account for this trend, which leads to my belief that this change is for the better.

Firstly, online communication is not as time and cost consuming as the real one. The amount of time used to get dressed, travel, etc. is minimized, which also helps reduce the relating expenses. There is no need to pay for the transportation, or the foods and drinks if somebody decides to meet up at the cafe, or a restaurant, for instance. Moreover, when it comes to online shopping, in no way do we have to walk from place to place or stand in queues in cash counters. Instead, we can enter the key words in the search engine and take a look at all of the items on display without having to touch them one by one.

Secondly, online interaction secures a higher possibility of attendees’ involvement. Those obstacles that occur in the real world, such as: traffic congestion, hearing or seeing difficulty in open spaces or large rooms, etc. are not of concern anymore. Everybody has the equal opportunity to get access to the information, therefore leaving no excuses for delaying or procrastination. All of the working process is clearly recorded by AI, which intensify the fairness and objectivity. For example, in online learning, the due date for every assignment or homework is clearly informed, as well as the time you submitted it and the scoring as well. This helps raise people’s awareness and sense of responsibility.

In conclusion, online interaction has proved to be a superior invention. In believe its potential benefits can definitely make up for the problems that face-to-face communication confronts.

topic: Some people believe that nowadays we have too many choices. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
It is indeed that the advancement in the technology has changed our life predominantly. Many people perceive that people have a number of alternatives available in all the walks of life, as compared to the past. I strongly agree that momentarily, the people have both a better the standard of living and the amount the choices.

To begin with, the exorbitant change in the way of living of the mankind. Previously, people were more self-reliant due to scarcity of the commercial products. While, in this digital era, all the products and services are available at a figure tips, using online applications. For instance, the modern consumer has a wide range of choices for shopping, such as grocery and cloths, using different online softwares and mega-malls. Moreover, the exchange of goods is changing dramatically with innumerable options of online money transfer, cash, credit card, cheque and demand draft. As a result, the people are enjoying the status of privileged customer.

Furthermore, a century ago, the transportation was supposed to be the most expensive and time consuming service due to limited mode of transits. However, the innovations in the mode of transport and competitive market have deteriorated the price of the privet vehicles and fares of the public transport; the people are utilizing it for the prosperity of their lives with multiple options. For example, the cars were thought to be a luxury goods for the people in the past; whereas, it is the basic necessary element of a layman. This revolutionary development in the modern society has improved the standard of living of an individual.

In conclusion, the availability of the ample choices in this contemporary world is due to the enhancement of the technology; where, the earlier people were lagging. In my opinion, this is not only a lucrative sign of the developed society, but also assurance of a prosperous future.

topic: growing influence of artificial intelligence on our life Some people believe that developments in the field of artificial intelligence will have a positive impact on our lives in the near future. Others, by contrast, are worried that we are not prepared for a world in which computers are more intelligent than humans. Discuss both of these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Artificial intelligence is on the rise in recent years. While some people believe that it would bring considerable benefits to humans, others argue that great risks could be posed by this kind of intelligence. Personally, I am persuaded that artificial intelligence would be more beneficial rather than detrimental.

On the one hand, the fact that AI is processing rapidly could be seen as a threat to humankind. Due to its outstanding capacity of working, robots are likely to outperform humans at any cognitive tasks. Many people could, consequently, be at hazard for unemployment. For instance, doctors could lose their job as robots are more accurate and prudent at doing surgery and caring patients. Furthermore, if humans are no longer the smartest on the planet, we could not be sure whether we can continue to control the world or not.

On the other hand, Artificial Intelligence could definitely enhance humans' quality of life due to a noticeable number of advantages it offers. Firstly, it makes our life much convenient by automating everything. For example, while sitting in a self-driving car, people can either accomplish their work or take relaxation. Secondly, as AI has the ability to work ceaselessly and tirelessly with incredible speed, it can certainly boost the productivity in any field it works on. Finally, if humans are threatened with losing our occupations, they will be likely to work doggedly and thus improve their qualifications to compete with AI.

In conclusion, I believe that the positive effects offered by AI in terms of upgrading humans' living standard outweigh the disadvantages.

topic: Obesity in children is a serious problem in a number of countries. Ċ What are the causes of obesity in children? Ċ Discuss the possible alarming effects of this problem in the future.
essay:
Obesity is perceived as an unhealthy over weight condition occurs only in adult life. However, in recent years the number of children suffering from obesity has grown significantly all across the globe. This essay sheds some lights on various agents behind the obesity in adolescents and their weighty effects.

To begin with, it is medically proven that imbalanced diet and a sedentary lifestyle are two major factors that causes fatness in the minors. First of all, children, enjoys consuming unhealthy high calorie fast foods and aerated drinks, which are full of harmful lipids, amino acids and sugar. With the ease of availability, they tend to repeatedly consume such junk food and become stout. Additionally, most of the youngsters have a very lethargic lifestyle unlike earlier days. For instance, they spend most of their time on computer games or indoor activities than sports or any physical exercise.

As a consequence, they suffer from numerous physical and mental health problems which should be addressed the earliest possible. Firstly, obesity results due to incorrect functioning of the human body and contribute to the risk of developing some chronic illnesses. For example, as body fat percentage increases, the person’s metabolism worsens, which in turn may result in diabetes or heart diseases. Secondly, overweight children are very unhealthy and often suffer from stress and tiredness. This lessens their work efficiency and results in lower productivity. To illustrate, an obese needs to put more effort to complete a task than a person with normal BMI.

To summarize, obesity is a chronic health issue that affects a large youngster nowadays. It’s mainly caused by an inactive lifestyle and eating disorders and results in acute health problems and loss of productivity.

topic: Government spending on restoration of old buildings in cities should be stopped. Instead they should spend the money for housing and road development. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Ancient buildings are considered as a part the of culture of the nation. It is a controversial issue these days that whether the authority should expand the money to restore to those antique edifices or they provide money for constructing new houses and streets. From my point of view, government must take care of heritage sites as well as contribute to the advancement on new residents and lanes.

To begin with, it is really significant to protect out cultural sites which are a source of economic growth of a country. For example, in Bangladesh, there are myriads of old buildings such as ‘Lalbug Kella’, ‘Tara Masjid’, and so on, to name but a few. If these heritage sites are not repaired, the tourists will not visit these sites. Hence, the finance comes from tourism would be halted and eventually, the GDP growth could be slow down. Moreover, if the bureaucrats of the region could financially invest money on rebuilding these ancient sites, this could pave the way of earning money and fame of the country.

On the other hand, the government must invest money on building new roads and house beside reconstructing the ancient building. The reason is that if they only vouchsafe money on ancient building, general people, who live in that area would be suffering. For instance, if roads are not repaired properly ,Accept space, they could not move and run the vehicles on the road. Furthermore, authority should also invest money on building new residential areas, since it enhances the security of general people. Therefore, concentrating on building new lines and multistory building is pivotal for the leader of the society.

In conclusion, I think that the government must divide their revenue for both reconstructing of the ancient building as well as road and building in general public. This is because, if the leader of the society focus on erecting the houses of general people than country could confront to a huge loss in the economic growth of the sector of tourism.

topic: Some people say that advertising is extremely successful at persuading us to buy things. Other people think that advertising is so common that we no longer pay attention to it. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Whether advertisements are a powerful means to stimulate consumers’ desire to purchase or not is a today topic in which people are interested. In terms of this, this essay will discuss both perspectives and argue in favour of the latter in conclusion.

On the one hand, adverts still noticeably impact the public’s choice of goods. Marketing strategies have been evolving depending on the change of customer trends, the advancement of technologies, and the popularization of new media platforms. For instance, product placement is a well-known commercial method in which corporations tell their products naturally and unconsciously influence people’s minds. Appropriate product placement effectively affects a product’s sales and a corporation’s image more than traditional advertising. Likewise, nowadays, it is a powerful and popular promotion way that influential YouTubers and influencers advertise on their social media platform and their unique way, among subscribers and the young generation.

On the other hand, many people these days think that advertisements are just an unnecessary thing. Unlike in the past, adverts are no longer an efficient means of information delivery or attractive watching sources. Due to the development of the internet, we can easily find more useful and precise information than from commercial advertisements. Moreover, numerous people feel like too many commercials interrupt their watching activity. Hence, the substantial public prefers to pay for watching platforms without ads or options to remove ads.

In conclusion, although advertising is striving to alter from various aspects in line with the change of the times, I do not think advertisements affect consumers’ purchases as much as before due to the development of the internet and excessive commercials.

topic: Some people think that parents should teach children how to be good members of society. Others, however, believe that school is the place to learn this. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
People have different views about the place to cultivate kids to be worthwhile members of society. While school play an important role in influencing students' moral and emotional development, I strongly believe that family education is more fundamental and essential in the formation of children's character .

On one hand, school as a microcosm of society is the first place for the young to get to know the real world. Although learning knowledge is the key task for them, the value of personal socialization growing is the same as what they gain inside the classroom. For example, kids will make friends, and have arguments with mates. So how to deal with conflicts is a basic social skill they need to practice.Of course, they shall also know how to corporate with others. Hence, they shall understand social responsibility and how to contribute to their surroundings by combination through what they acquire from their tutors and schoolmates.

On the other hand, parents are the initial teachers and first friends of a child. Furthermore, they accompany each other on a lifelong journey studying a lot of things together. That's why fathers and mothers have a higher chance to be their first models as well. For instance, my daughter’s high interest in humanities and good behaviour in reading since 3 years old are attributed to the demonstration that her father often reads many history books at home. Therefore, she gets to know the view of the world much deeper than the girls of the same girls. According to my personal experience, I would argue that the importance of family education is obvious, it is long time support for youngsters to truly achieve their value through their whole life.

In conclusion, I believe that both educational institutions and parents play significant roles in training boys and girls to be useful members of society. However, the influence of home education matters more in the long run.

topic: 28. These days many families move to other countries for work. Some people believe that the children in these families benefit from this move. However, others believe that it makes life more difficult for the children. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
It is trendy for many families to move to another country these days. Some people believe that immigration will bring many positives to children in these families, while other people think that these young immigrants will meet many difficulties in their life. This essay will discuss why children can not avoid facing difficulties in their new life abroad but why they could gain many significant life experiences from it. In my opinion, the positives of living in a new country for the young generations overweight its negatives.

It is true that children who immigrate to other countries with their families will meet many barriers like social and language barriers. For example, many new immigrants feel that it is not easy for them to make new friends after they have moved to a new environment. Children who are lack of life experiences will be more likely to struggle with this situation because they might not know how to tackle these problems. As a result, these children might suffer from this move.

On the other hand, there are many benefits of moving to a new country for the young generations. One of the benefits is that they will have life experiences that will improve themselves as people that would have been, otherwise impossible if they had had only lived in their own countries. Living in another country requires people to push themselves beyond the norm into an unusually difficult experience. For instance, many young students should learn how to interact with people having various cultures and backgrounds. Therefore, these ultra-challenging experiences are particularly the main advantage of living and studying in a new country as they could make these young people grow as a person.

In conclusion, more and more families tend to immigrate to other countries for better living. Some people think that children in these families can obtain many vital experiences from this move, whereas others maintain that these children will be facing many tough problems in their life abroad. This essay discussed why children who move to a new country will no doubt experience many difficulties but why these difficulties lead to the main advantage of living in another country. In my view, it is far better for these young immigrants to live and study in a different country despite the challenges that they will inevitably face.

topic: Topic: There are many different types of music in the world today. Why do we need music? Is the traditional music of a country more important than the International music that is heard everywhere nowadays?
essay:
Music is a well-received art form whose basic elements are sound and silence. Originated from prehistoric eras, it now has evolved into a great variety of genres and subgenres, which is by no means a coincidence.

Though generally perceived as a means of emotional expression, music has far more functional uses beyond that. Music therapy is now widely used by psychologists to deal with sensory impairment, cognitive disorders, and communication disabilities, to name only a few. Farmers nowadays are using music to enhance the production of agricultural products, which is cheap, clean and easy to implement. Still another aspect worth mentioning is the music industry itself. With the development of compact disc, digital devices and the Internet, music nowadays comprises a large proportion of people's daily entertainment, therefore giving birth to a new industry in modern society. No instances other than the prosperity of Apple's iPod and iTunes could demonstrate that more tellingly.

Some may argue since the trend of globalization is getting accelerated, traditional music of a country will gradually diminish, citing as evidence that International music can be heard almost everywhere nowadays. Such prediction is unfounded. Music by itself is a certain output of one's thoughts, which is inevitably influenced by ancestors' cultural heritage. Because of such a character, no music will be genuinely accepted without sharing a common cultural recognition with its people.

As to conclude, it is foreseeable that music will continue to play an important role in modern society, not only giving people mental soothing and releasing, but also providing solution to a variety of problems. And despite the pace of cultural integration, the importance of traditional music will remain its statue.

topic: Every year several languages die out. Some people think this is not important because life will be easier if there are a fewer languages in the world. To what extend do you agree with this opinion?
essay:
From the entire fields of the human endeavor, we can consider the language as the most important achievement we made. However, as many places the human race has occupied and lived in all around the globe, as many languages have been developed .each language has its society and culture flavor. Some people want to take those flavors out and replace them by a mono flavor .although, they argue that the communication between people shall be easier, I shall disagree with that opinion and I prefer to keep our earth as spicy as it is.

Firstly, the most influenced area with language is art .The presence of many languages gives art a lot of diversity. In other words and for example, poets shall describe nature, moon, rivers and even women in different ways, because each language has its unique style .this Variety shall rich our life instead of the mono language which may colored our life into a single boring mono color.

Furthermore, our presence on earth is depending on our understanding and analyzing to the ancient civilizations especially how they accommodated themselves with earth. Generation after generation, language played an essential rule in transferring the human knowledge and sciences to the next era .thereby any language die out we lose a part of this accumulative experiences . For example the ancient Egyptians have developed a tremendous number of sciences. But nowadays, and as their language has died out, most of their science are mysteries for us.

In conclusion, many language presence is serving a useful purpose .As it help us to keep knowledge continues improvement .also it contribute on art diversity which riches our life and breaks our routine.

topic: Many employees may work at home with the modern technology. Some people claim that it can benefit only the worker, not the employers. To what extend do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Advanced technology comes to make everything easier to be finished. In cutting-edge era, the modern technology tends to give a novel option for many employees to work at their own home, although some people argue that it cannot give benefits for the employers. Personally, I immensely disagree with that view as it is beneficial for employers also in some aspects.

Needless to say, generating sophisticated technology in work can give more profit for employers. This is because the technology can reduce the cost of workers when they work at home. For instance, since the employees finish their work at home, employers have no need to provide additional cost related to daily use and facilities such as lighting, parking place for their car, and water. Hence, the employers can save a lot of expenditure budget in their workplace.

More broadly, working at home provides the workers to work efficiently. They do not need to waste more time on waiting for the bus or traffic jam. They can get more extraordinary ideas to support their job when they work in ideal and creative environment. This means that the employers can take positive impacts on the result of their work. For example, graphic designers can create fantastic design as they feel so fresh and avoid any distractions when they work at their own home. As a result, the employers can acquire maximal performance from their employees.

All in all, personally I do believe that employers can get more benefits when they allow their employees to work at their home. It not only save their budget but also provide the employees to work in a comfortable place so that they can improve their work productivity.

topic: Question: Some suggest that young people should take a job for a few years between school and university. Discuss what the advantages and disadvantages might be for people who do this
essay:
Most people believe that work experience is the crucial factor for adolescent before continuing their higher education. I regard that it will convey positive consequences although there are several drawbacks could be occurred.

it has negative consequences such as lack of academic knowledge and negative psychological effect. Consequently, there is a big possibility that they will not be enthusiastic to continue study at university. Furthermore, they will have mental disorder since they must achieve the target and finish it based on the deadline. Although they can accomplish the tasks to be in order, they work under pressure and are stressful. It will be a harmful factor for their psychological development.

topic: The media pay too much attention to the lives and relationships of celebrities such as actors, singers or footballers. They should spend more time reporting the lives of ordinary people instead.  To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In this era, the media tend to report much information about public figures' lives and their relationship. It is believed that they have to pay more attention to people who are not famous. I strongly agree with this statement since focusing on reporting celebrities' lives may influence adolescents' behaviour and ordinary people can be an inspiration for human being.

To begin, exposing too much information about famous people's lives may bring negative implication for teenagers' attitude. Celebrities such as actors or singers have many huge teenager fans that adore and regard them as their role models. To illustrate, some actors or actresses are likely to have hedonistic lifestyle. They often go to party, get drunk and even use drugs. As a consequence, these may lead adolescents to imitate such way of living as their behaviour.

In addition, the media is required to often report about ordinary people since there are some positive sides that can inspire the society. For instance, there were some students in Java Island, Indonesia who invented new technology that was used for alternative fuel. Interesting news like that should be revealed in order to inform public so they will know and can use it. It is also expected that such information can motivate other students to be more creative. On the other hand, it is acceptable if the media publish some news about popular actors' private live in order to get profit but the proportion of the news should be restricted and consider about negative contents on that.

To sum up, instead of paying much attention to famous people, the media should focus on exposing ordinary people since it will bring beneficial effect for humans' lives.

topic: Many people believe that scientific research should be carried out and controlled by the governments rather than private companies. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? government protection over scientific research
essay:
The given idea argues that research in science should be implemented and monitored by the governments instead of private companies. I do not agree with that opinion. Generally, there are two main advantages when the private companies manipulated a study, being finance resource and discovery motivation.

First of all, the government's budget is limited because they must share for all public activities over the nation. While the companies usually build up funds to invest in research and development for creating and improving products. As the fact that study projects in advanced countries have the trend using money from private organisation based on a cooperative agreement. So that, the financial burden on the national budget associated with science is reduced. Recently, the Asian developing countries have been applying this model in the national strategy of science.

In addition, this cooperation is the important motivation for studying and applying into reality. Authorities must concentrate on their projects and ensure quality of outcomes because they have commitment to sponsors about applicability of these study. By contrast, if government covers all budget for researchers, they can become neglect and lack motivation because of no strict constraints. Formerly, scientific research in Vietnam mainly depend on government budget. Scientists can be approved easily to finish their project through a science council without concerning applicability. Therefore, individual sponsorship constraints is the suitable motivation for research and development.

Consequently, I totally think that research in science should be operated independently by individual companies to boost applicability of scientific research.

topic: Countries are becoming more and more similar because people are able to buy the same products anywhere in the world. Ċ Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Nowadays, the same products are available for purchase anywhere in the world, causing increasing similarities among countries. I believe this should be seen as a negative development for the entire world because it is making the world’s cultures less diverse and could also be detrimental to the travel industry.

The availability of the same products all over the world is leading to cultural loss since a product is part of a culture. For instance, fifty years ago, most Indian people wore clothing like saris and dhotis. However, the expansion of global brands such as Nike and Addidas into the Indian Market has led to a rise in the wearing of western-style clothing among young people. As traditional Indian clothing is being replaced by western fashions, some of the longstanding values of that country are being lost.

In addition, countries becoming more alike could affect the tourism industry. Many people pay a visit to another place to experience something unique to that culture. For example, a survey shows that Thai cuisine is the feature of Thailand that is most attractive to international tourists. However, now authentic Thai restaurants can be found all over the world, which means people no longer need to fly to Thailand to have a taste of real Thai food. This could result in a decrease in the number of foreign visitors to that country.

In conclusion, I believe it is a negative trend that countries are becoming less different. For one thing, it is threatening cultural diversity and, for another, it harms the tourism sector.

essay:
The world is full of exceptional talent that is why there has always been a considerable discussion about natural talent and training whenever people enthralled by a great performance from an artist or player.

These are players whose indelible performance always make people believe that they are blessed with skills. These exceptional players always find it easy to perform which seems very difficult for other players especially in fields like sports, music and art. Good examples are Roger Federer who is a born tennis legend, belated Michael Jackson who will always rule our heart as king of pop music.

However, there is a strong belief in our education system that with continued teaching and guided practice, any skill can be mastered. There are plenty of such examples of players who have proved time and again with their commitment towards training and practice that they are good in their field of work. For instance, one of the great cricket player Sachin Tendulkar is not always at its best in all his games but has always learned from his mistakes and achieved great milestones in cricketing world.

In my opinion, to a certain extent this is true that some people are born or blessed with unmatched skills which makes them perfectionist in their job especially when we consider areas like sports, music and art. But it is always said " Practice makes a man perfect " , which is undoubtedly lot of people's formula of success who are focused and have desire to perform.

topic: Governments should spend money on railways rather than roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement
essay:
Nowadays, a lot of people seem to think that train is a more effective way to travel compared to driving yourself, especially for long journeys. As a result, governments are being pushed to break the bank and invest more in the railways rather than improving the roads. I agree partially with this but the benefit of developing the roads should not be overlooked either.

First of all, I have to disagree partly, as land travel by cars, buses, and trucks are still needed. For an instance, opening highways and roads will help the people around those main roads economically. They will be able to set up shops and open places such as restaurants or merchandise stores that still attract passerby. On top of that, travelling by car is preferable when we are accessing more remote areas that are not reachable by trains.

On the other hand, putting our money on enhancing the railways will help to create a more connected urban planning between cities. The ones who will profit the most are the passengers that move around frequently and needed to be somewhere else far as fast as possible. This will also leverage the logistic companies that look to move their goods in a more cost-efficient way as trains can carry a lot more weight compared to trucks with a cheaper budget.

All things considered, I believe we need to improve both ends. Railways and roads are essential for every stakeholder present and we don't have to just choose one. I advise the people in control of the budget to allocate accordingly to make sure both can still serve the customers in the long run.

topic: Planting trees is very important for the environment. Some people says trees should be planted in the vacant areas of metropolitan while others says housing facilities should be build instead. Do you agree of disagree?
essay:
Oxygen is an essential element for the survival of the human race. One section of the society thinks that more plantations should be there in unoccupied places, on the contrary; some individuals believe that accommodations should be made over there. I will express my views on both opinions in this essay.

Firstly, human beings are surviving on the earth due to air. As we already know that metropolitan cities are already struggling with the issues of air pollution. Consequently, planting trees in vacant areas can help to combat this issue. Pupils need a fresh breeze to breathe as they don’t want to be the major victim of breathing problems like asthma. Every individual in the town required parks for their benefit. For example, older people want them so that they do their walk, yoga and can sit over there to have a chit chat with other members of the locality. And, children need these gardens to play.

Secondly, population rise up is a major concern for the urban areas as adults in the need of jobs or better education facilities migrate over here. For instance, in 2020, the municipal corporation issued an article that states a 10% increase in residents every year. Therefore, housing facilities should be built over the vacant areas for them.

In conclusion, we have two schools of thought regarding the empty spaces whether saplings should be grown or colonies to be made over there. topic: In theie advertising, businesses nowadays usually emphasise that their products are new in some way. Ċ Why is this? Do you think it is a positive or negative development?
essay:
Currently, business owners often claim that their products are new in some aspects in their advertisements. This is mainly because they want to draw attention from their customers. From my perspective, this phenomenon should be seen as a negative development as individuals will generally focus on new goods and forget many traditional valuable items.

The primary reason that a great number of new innovations are spotlighted in the advertisements is that it is a marketing strategy to allure more customers. In other words, every time when new products with new features are launched, people are always fascinated by that brand. Not only a particular item becomes popular but also other products under that brand attract more consumers. This is evident according to Diamon Grains, a food company, pointing out that when new flavours of snacks are introduced, other types of snacks under its brand receive more recognition as well.

Nevertheless, emphasizing new characteristics of commodities in ads should be considered a negative development. This is because, in the long run, there will be no original products left to be seen since they are substituted by the latest developed items. Consequently, societies lost several precious goods. For instance, it is difficult to find traditional Thai desserts to eat in Bangkok. In contrast, boba tea, chocolate cake and Italian pudding are prevalent.

In conclusion, numerous companies are trying to represent new features of their commodities in order to acquire consumers’ concentration. This action can cause catastrophic losses in cultural products. Thus, I believe that this is definitely a negative development.

topic: Some people think that parents should teach children how to be good members of society. Others, however, believe that school is the place to learn this. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Values are definitely important to help shape future generations. It is often thought that the parents are responsible for developing their children to eventually contribute to a better society. Conversely, others argue that these should be taught in school. In this essay, I will be discussing both sides before giving out my opinion.

On the one hand, it is a fact that parents are our first teachers. They have complete access to our time as well as control over who we should be interacting with. In the Philippines, for instance, family is regarded as the most precious treasure in life because the younger generations obtain their learnings from them. Consequently, the older ones serve as the role models of the young because they teach them how to treat others with respect.

On the other hand, schools have the ability to standardize moral characteristics that would benefit not only the students but also the society. If there were differences in the upbringing of the children, they will still find common characteristics if they will include them in the curriculum. In addition, they would serve as guides for the youth who do not have the access to a traditional family. For example, a 7-year old boy, whose family are working overseas, is somehow deprived of learning the importance of values. Because of this, it becomes the duty of the school to instil in him characteristics that will make him a better individual.

In summary, people believe that, whereas others think that these can be included in school. Family can immediately control how a child should grow. However, learning centres have the proper resources to improve the social morals of their learners. In my opinion, it is the obligation of the parents since they are indeed the first ones who develop the upbringing of their children.

topic: Stress in now major problem in many countries around the world. What are some of the factors in modern society that cause this stress and how can we reduce it.
essay:
One of the most important issues in society today is stress. Stress is a problem that can give negative effects on many human's lives. There are many factors in modern society responsible for this. However, there are ways to make small the potential impacts. In this essay, I will discuss the factors and how we can reduce it.

To begin with, in our society, everybody wants to get what we want. For getting that is not easy, we must try to compete each other. When students in Senior High School want to graduate of school, they must follow many tests only in four days. Then, it can conclude the students will be graduated or not. As a result, students are facing great tension and depression because be afraid to be unsuccessful. Furthermore, some people think that happiness is related to money, luxurious houses or car, and branded clothes. Ultimately, people are working every day and every night to find much money. Because of they are continuous work; they do not have time for relaxation and their families, so they are feeling stress level very high.

Nevertheless, solving such problem will not easy, but there are actions that can be taken. Better time management is often considered to be the key to organize with time pressure without be stress. Time management includes setting priorities what needs to be done most importantly. For example, students can prepare their study for long time before they follow test. Moreover, individual also can take the various steps to reduce the stress, such as take good time for sleeping and spend time with their families.

To conclude, it seems likely that many factors which may cause stress but we must have solution to overcome with this potential problem.

topic: Some people think that sense of competition in children should be encouraged. Others believe that children who are taught to cooperate rather than compete become more successful adults. Give your views.
essay:
Few people are of the view that introducing contention to the young generation from an early age will encourage them to achieve success in your life. However, other members of society have a different opinion of teaching cooperation than the competition to them. I agree with the former viewpoint and, I will discuss that in the impending paragraphs.

On the other hand, modernisation has created a variety of opportunities for everyone and at the same time,it has developed competition to grasp the same. And, the community nowadays want their children to learn how to meet the demands in any given situation by boosting them to understand the true meaning of contention. As, this will result in making them grab the better job opportunities, develop new skills to face the globalised environment, how to do hard work to fulfil desired goals and how to improve their personality to become self-confident. For instance, an individual will not wish to accomplish more, if there is no level of challenge involved in it. Hence, a society can improve in a myriad of ways by making its adolescents competitive.

On the other hand, people who think that kids should be taught how to cooperate rather than being competitive among each other. However, this will lead to numerous problems such as losing the desired workplace, if he is so generous to give it to others. Moreover, a person will not attain mores knowledge, if he is dropping his chances of getting involved in new challenges. Along with that, a human not indulging himself in new activities will isolate oneself and loose motivation to face the upcoming trends in society. For example, a child who is scared to face difficult situations and instead leaves it for others to grab the opportunity will lack behind in life. Therefore, one must always have a sense of competition to meet the targets.

To conclude, I would say opting difficulties makes a man more successful than being cooperative and not indulging himself in new challenges.

topic: Some people say the government should pay for the health care and education, but others say that it is not the government's responsibility. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Despite the development of modern society, the health care and education still remain the basic rights of citizens. And a much debated issue these days is whether or not the government should be responsible for citizens' health care and education.

Some people argue that it is the government that should be obligated to fund the health care and education for citizens. This is because citizens enjoy the right to live in a harmonious and stable environment, which should be enabled by the government, the leader of the society. If citizens had no access to health care and education, their physical health and psychological soundness would be at risk. As a result, such people might fail to get cured in time, thus influencing their working efficiency, which would destabilize the production of the industry. Also, without sufficient guidance of teachers, these citizens might misbehave or even commit crimes, posing a threat to other citizens' security. Therefore, the government should be accountable for citizens' health care and education to keep society safe and stable.

On the other hand, some people oppose the argument, saying it is a waste of public money for the government to subsidize health care and education of each citizen in society, since a great number of people, in fact, have had the capacity to pay for the both privately. Instead, the government should give priority to more pressing problems related to social members' wellbeing, such as soaring crime rate, AIDS epidemic or the shortage of infrastructure, which are requiring financial resources from the government to address.

Personally, I think the government should fund the deprived for their health care and education, who are the group in real need for the authority's help. At the same time, citizens available for the both should encourage the government to allocate money to more urgent areas. After all, the harmonious society calls for the joint efforts of the government and citizens.

The government should fund health care and education for deprived citizens while citizens who can afford these services should support redirecting public funds to more urgent societal needs.

Claim 1:  
The government should be responsible for funding citizens' health care and education.

Counterargument: It is wasteful for the government to subsidize health care and education for all citizens because many can afford these services privately.

Counterargument: None  
Rebuttal: None

abstractive_summary: The government should fund health care and education for deprived citizens to ensure a stable and harmonious society, as access to these services safeguards individual well-being and prevents broader social instability, including reduced productivity and increased crime. However, since many citizens can afford these services independently, it is inefficient to allocate public funds universally. Instead, the government should prioritize urgent societal challenges like crime, the AIDS epidemic, and infrastructure deficits. Those capable of paying for health care and education should support redirecting resources toward these critical needs, reflecting a shared responsibility in fostering societal well-being.

pro_keypoints: The government has a duty to ensure basic human rights, including access to healthcare and education.
Universal access to essential services promotes social equity and reduces economic disparities.

topic: Topic: After leaving school or university, young people should choose a job or career that they love, rather than one that pays the best salary. To what extent do you agree with this statement?
essay:
In the present society,there are majority of people think that youngster should choose their career by interest, while others hold the opposite view. In my opinion, I stand on the side of the former one.

There is no denying that salary is a top priority when people looking for the job. Most youngster start to responsible for their cost of living since they left school, and thereby, it is vital to consider to find a job with higher salary. For instance, sales provide higher salary and require lower standard (no need to have relevant experience). Although working hours might be longer than other occupations. But be a sales can help youngster earn more money than their peers.

On the other hand, I believe that youngster ought to choose their career by interest. For one thing that, engaged the job you love can let you work in a pleasure atmosphere in order to enhance your work efficiency. For another thing, people can gain more satisfaction once they achieve their goal. For example, being a designer have to endure a long term trial, with low pay and unsteady working hour at the beginning. But once they success in this field, all the skills and experience they acquire in this area are beneficial to them. Most important of all, if youngster choose the job by salary instead of interest, they will change their job once they get bored in the current one, result in they don't have the related experience in one field. On contrary, interest can maintain people enthusiastic in their job, and meanwhile, accumulated their experience in the same area.

All in all, from the above mentioned analysis, we can therefore draw a conclusion that it is crucial for young people to choose their career by interest, because it is major to be an expert in a specific field you love.

topic: Some people think it would be a good idea for schools to teach every young person how to be a good parent. Do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Describe the skills a person needs to be a good parent.
essay:
Many consider that it could be an amazing idea to study parenting to adolescent at academics. I disagree with this notion and I will discuss it in the following paragraphs along with skills needed to be a good parent.

The academic study must be a priority for children and teaching parenting is unreasonable as It needs more patience and maturity to understand that deep relation. For instance, The depth of relation will not be understood by a youngster whose priority is different at that age. Although, For accepting and fulfilling their future responsibility one has to be successful in his life which needs full concentration on academics rather than future relationship study. Moreover, a child must not be overstressed about future responsibilities. However, no one can teach how to become a good mother and father, it only learns by self when someone being a real parent and practice the new experience daily.

According to my viewpoint, there are some skills which make a person a good parent. First and foremost is an abundance of love and care. Secondly, a person should be responsible. Thirdly, they should be strict for discipline life. Last but not least, they are mature and financial strength so that they can easily provide them with some basic needs such as food, shelter, education to their offspring.

To conclude, school is not the right place to educate people about parenthood. The person only learns to be a good human being in school that help them to become a role model and inspiration for others.

topic: Prompt: In some countries the average weight of people is increasing and their levels of health and fitness are decreasing. What do you think are the causes of these problems and what measures could be taken to solve them?
essay:
The growing number of overweight people is becoming a major problem in many countries however many solutions are introduced. In my opinion, this results from the fact that people these days do not get enough exercise and to deal with, I support the approach of educating residents with the aim of altering their life style.

More specifically, it is no doubt that we are increasingly abusing automatic device, which causes to spend a lot less physical strength than former generations. An excellent example of this is potatoes on the sofa, who sit in front of a television all the day as a result that the vast majority of housework is automatically conducted by modern electronic equipments such as washing machines. Being completely different from such potatoes, by the time I went to my secondary school, children have been taught to attend numerous physical activities on their own ranging from the simplest stuff like cleaning a floor to the more complicated ones including clearing grass and planting trees in the garden. It is largely due to that people in the past could keep themselves healthier and fitter.

To solve this problem, a more active life style should be promoted via many campaigns of authorities, in which raising public awareness of getting as plenty of exercise as possible. For instance, pupils should be encouraged or even forced to attend health education courses where they have opportunities to get advice on how beneficial physical exercises are. Not only do young people have to learn about keeping their health, but also elders should be aware of they are never to old to get exercise.

In brief, people are getting fatter and weaker due to lack of doing enough physical activities and one of the most feasible solutions is to educate them how they can have a better life.

topic: Topic: Convenience foods will become increasingly prevalent and eventually replace traditional foods and traditional methods of food preparation. To waht extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Without a doubt, our diet has been significantly changed as the technological age has advanced. In our modern life we often look for quick solutions to our problems and diet is not an exception. Infact, some people have predicted that with advances in food technology, our traditional foods and the traditional methods of food preparation will disapear. In my view, people are unlikely to compeletely leave their traditional meals behind.

It is true that nowadays many people do not have wnough time for cooking and , therefore, convenience foods present an attractive option. These foods have improved significantly in terms of quality and availability. Almost every food can be found in supermarkets as ready-prepared microwavable food.

However, there are factors showing that people continue to value traditional ways of preparing foods. To begin with, cooking is considered a fun activity and in more professional levels an art. The growing popularity of television programmes and cook books proves that people enjoy cooking. Hence, they will put some time and effort to that. Needless to say, home-cooked meals are healthier than processed food. They are not only healthier ,but also more delicious. It is worth noting that eating gives people pleasure, so the more delicious the better.

Moreover, foods and food preparation methods are closely related to culture. In many countries , take Turkey for example, food are counted as a tourist attraction and it is a big industry. Also, there are many occasions like; wedding ceremonies, Thanksgiving, New year ceremonies, that are marked by especial foods,

In spite of improved quality of convenience foods and the fact that they are easily available, it is hard to imagine a work where people abandon their traditions and stop practicing their traditional food preparation methods.

topic: Some people say that history is one of the most important subjects. Other people think that, in today’s world, subjects like science and technology are more important than history. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
It is said that history is one of the essential subjects, but others disagree with that and think that science is more important in this modern world. Although history gives us the opportunity to learn what happened in the past, science allows us to advance forward which I believe is more crucial.

Through history, we get to learn a lot of things that occurred way before we were born. Knowing what happened in the past helps us in knowing why we are at where we are which, in turn, helps us decide what to do next. Furthermore, we get to know what went wrong in the past, what to avoid or what to follow to make things work at the present and how to improve further. For example, in the past, there were infectious diseases that killed thousands of people. Based on the data from the past, we know what caused them and we have developed vaccines to prevent some of them.

Science, no doubt, plays an extremely crucial role in our daily lives. Science has helped us advance in many fields such as engineering, medicine and transportation, and as a result, we now live convenient and comfortable lives. For instance, people had to travel overseas by trains and ships which took them days to reach their destination. Passenger-carrying aeroplanes were then developed, thanks to the advanced technologies, and they let us travel from one place to another comfortably in a very short time.

In conclusion, while history gives us a lot of information, it is due to science that we have come thus far. Therefore, I believe science is a more important topic to be learnt.

topic: In the past people thought that education was only for young people. Now it is believed that education is for a person's whole life. Do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
In recent years, there has been a growing tendency that individuals tend to conduct post-qualification studies continuously. Therefore, many appear to believe that education is no longer the young's privilege. Personally speaking, this is true in today's society.

Admittedly, in the past, some given circumstances make people rarely carry out future learnings after the graduation. One possible circumstance is that there is relatively slower growth in both knowledge and technology fields half century ago. In this case, the academic skills which the younger job seekers have acquired from text is sufficiently and satisfactorily for them to achieve the general practices in the workplace. Secondly, in the past, the labor force was crucial for families who have suffered the economic hardship in many poverty regions. As a result, minors have to bear the household burdens such as making money for their families to acquire food, shelter and medicine soon after they have completed their studies at school.

However, in the modern society, conducting a series further studies after university is always a necessity. Firstly, it enhances juniors' survival ability in today's competitive labour market. This is because the new information and knowledge are frequently updated and released nowadays. In order to obtain a sense of security of their career perspectives, the academic knowledge bases should be checked and renewed regularly by an ongoing study. Moreover, undertaking a series of post-qualification learning and training develops the employees' confidence in their area of expertise. In other words, these types of learning progression strengthen their professional competence within their industry and makes their career prospect brighter in the future.

In conclusion, it is convincing that learning knowledge and skills continuously is often valuable and useful for individuals to retain their employment opportunities and firm their speciality in a long run.

topic: Many people now undertake extreme activities, from hang-gliding to mountain climbing.TWhy do people risk their lives in this way, and do you think this is a good trend? Give reasons for your answer, and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
There is no doubt that the popularity of the adventure sports has been increasing, in the recent years. The enjoyment which would get from the activities encourage more and more young sports men participate in this. In my opinion, even though there are some risks involve in this, this is a great way of relaxation.

First and foremost reason to participate such game is that to experience the adrenaline rush. In other words, active involvement in dangerous sports helps us to realise our potentials as the sports person comes out of his comfort zone and push his limit. For instance, some studies suggested that engaging in these kinds of sports, namely, bungee jumping and para gliding, enhances self esteem and morale in depressive patients. Eventually, they would feel energetic and motivated. Alternatively, the usual type of games may able to motivate their players for a longer period, but adventurous sporting does it.

It is true that the sports often involves certain level of danger as well. However, this can be effectively managed, these days by using various kinds of safety equipment and training to the members of the activity. For instance, safety kit, helmet, life jackets has often given as a protective measure. As a result, the risk level can be effectively reduced and this has been practiced in many sporting events. Avoiding such games from our life, would prevent us from having an unforgettable movement.

In conclusion, the extreme activities would seem that inappropriate by some due to the risks involved in this. I, personally, think that, despite the difficulties and hurdles, this game is a one of best the activity.

topic: In the future, student may have the choice of studying at home by using technology such as computers or television instead of studying at school. Which would you prefer use reasons and specific detail to explain your choice.
essay:
This issue of selecting is not only extremely controversial but also very challenging. However, with my final analysis, I believe that studying at home by using technology is much better than studying at school and there are a number of reason I feel this way.

There can be no denying good material and lessons can receive from studying at school, nevertheless there also have different standard among each school. When you study at school you never know how skillful your teacher is, and material or lessons for teaching may be out-of-date. If you study at home, you will always have new and up-to-date data, good quality materials and expert support which are one standard all over the world. Accordingly, I prefer to studying at home.

It can be strongly argued that freedom in time is very important. Studying at home can let you organize your time freely therefore you can learn in your own time. Furthermore, if you study at home, you will not waste time for transporting to the school. Consequently, I favor to studying at home.

I strongly believe that working while studying gain more experience and more self-raliant. You don't have to quit your job since you study at home, You can learn, earn money and improve your working skill at the same time. Unfortunately, studying at school can't earn any money or gain any working experience. Hence, I prefer to studying at home.

Studying at school may be motivate to learn, but motivation is not everything. The biggest advantage is that your lecture will always mordernized. In addition, you can manage your own time as well as undergo with your career. So studying at home is my preference.

topic: Topic: In some countries people's weight has significantly increased while their levels of health have decreased. What do you think may be the causes of this problem and what solutions can you suggest solving them?
essay:
Recently, in many countries around the world, people have faced with the situation of increasing weight and serious health problems. In this essay, I will discuss some reason and propose several solutions to this issue.

There are many explanations of why citizens' weight has significantly risen while the quality of health has been worse and worse. Firstly, in modern life, people tend to consume excessive junk food such as hamburgers, chips or gas drinks; which is highly available in the present day but less nutritious; thus, this can raise the risk of overweight and digestive disorders. Secondly, in sedentary life, the shortage of physical activities can lead to severe diseases such as heart stroke, diabetes and obesity as well. An evidence can be given is that many people, especially youngsters, now would rather play computer games or chat online with friends than do outdoor activities and sports. As a result, they have become heavier but more lethargic. Finally, negative thoughts caused by suffering from stress also make levels of health decrease.

To tackle these problems mentioned above, several measures should be done. Primarily, everyone ought to concern about their portion and ensure they eat a healthy diet. It means people must cut down on junk food and cigarettes and have a fully nourishing meal. Another justification is that we should participate in outdoor sports, and do exercises regularly. For example swimming not only allow our body to burn calories to lose weight but also make us more dynamic and more energetic. Besides it, attempting to think positively is essential in order to be wholesome. This can help us keep fit and alleviate health problems.

In conclusion, I believe that although the situation of overweight and poor health quality has occurred in many countries; we can still solve the problems by the solutions that I have suggested.

topic: Some people prefer to spend their lives doing the same things and avoiding change. Others, however, think that change is always a good thing. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Currently, there are different attitudes on changes. While some people consider that it does not worth attention, others have the opposite point of view. In this essay, I will discuss both opinions and give my own view on this subject.

To begin with, there are possible reasons why some citizens prefer stability to constant changes. Firstly, this phenomenon may concern the work field, where the stable conditions and salary contribute to calmness and confidence. For example, if a person does not worry about money and can afford to buy many things he wants, it will probably lead to harmony in his life. Secondly, some people buy the same products over a long time period. This is because they know the quality of such things and do not want to change their habitats. As an example, my grandparents buy clothes in one store for 20 years and always are happy with their purchases.

On the other hand, stable activities are not acceptable among those who like a wide range of responsibilities at their work and changes in surroundings. In other words, a monotonous job is not for everyone because it can be boring and demotivating. For instance, I was not inspired by working as a cashier because my work duties did not change. As a result, I lost my motivation and felt distressed. Besides, it is quite common that some citizens decided to see the world and expand their horizons. In this case, they will change their surroundings constantly, as well as try new food and observe places that they have never seen before.

In conclusion, in the modern world, there are people who avoid changing in their life, whereas others see more benefits in changing habitats and conditions. In my opinion, despite the positive aspects that stability has, diversity is a good way to have a more eventful life.

topic: Increasing the price of petrol is the best way to solve growing traffic and pollution problems. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree? Ċ What other measures do you think might be effective?
essay:
Many countries have seen a steep rise in the price of petrol in recent years. Some experts opine that it is the most effective solution to solve the problems related to growing traffic and pollution. Personally, I am not in favour of the aforementioned notion and the following paragraphs will expatiate certain other measures with lucid examples.

To begin, it has been seen that augmentation in price petrol gives rise to myriad vexing problems rather than helping in the receding of pollution. To elucidate, many business vendors have to bear the burden of this increase because transportation tends to become costly and thereby, increasing the prices of goods and commodities. For example, in,Delhi the prices of petrol touched a new height which led to a rise in the cost of vegetables and dairy products. As a result , it becomes onerous for the folks to survive in such conditions ,especially those who live below the poverty line.

Nevertheless, there are some other efficient solutions that can cater to the decimation of the traffic gridlocks and pollution. The foremost way is to control the population from drifting towards the urban areas because it puts pressure on a confined area and its resources. In other words,Better amenities and job opportunities should be provided in the towns, so that people refrain from moving to a city to earn their livelihood. As an instance, although Delhi has wider roads and many pollution control projects in place, still the city is struggling with these two problems due to its high-density population. Therefore, it is imperative to elevate the status of small towns to reduce the burgeoning pollution and traffic in the urban areas. Moreover, public transport has to be made more strong by improving the frequency and connectivity to all parts of the city, so that people opt for this in lieu of using their own vehicles for less number of travellers.

To sum up, the government should look for several other viable solutions for these issues as they can be more justified and would not create a subsequent problem for the public. It is apparent that the traffic and pollution are increasing but one must also notice that it is only some part of the country that suffers from it, hence the above solutions can be considered to get rid of these problems.

topic: Task2:  Many people believe that an effective public transport system is a key component of a modern city. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of public transport. pros and cons of public transport
essay:
Some people think that public transportation services play a role key in contributing to the development of a smart city. This essay will discuss both pros and cros of this view.

There are several advantages of effective public transport. To begin with, the traffic issue would be controlled if public transport, like bus or subway, runned effectively, representing a symbol of civilized and modern society. On a large scale, traveling easily enhances the economic growth as people would not waste time on traffic jam. For example, a businessman could save his time up to one and half hour to go to his workplace every morning on time by subway instead of being stuck in traffic jam in his private car. Moreover, the tourist industry in a city is also promoted when foreigner visitors no longer run the risk of being victimized by the fraud by passenger motorcycle. Last but not least, public transport help people save money since most of them costs much cheaper than taxi or private car.

Despite the advantages, public transportation has its various disadvantages. It is undeniable that public transport is unlikely to reach anywhere as they find it difficult to access the remote or isolated areas. Buses in Ha Noi city, for example, are unable to bring all passengers to anywhere they want, given that the Hanoi's infrastructure is so complicated. In addition, as the number of public transport is limited, they fall short of people's traveling needs. Finally, the quality of public transport services also needs to be improved because this would encourage citizens to use public transport instead of driving a car.

In conclusion, although there are some disadvantages of public transport existed, the demand of advancing and expanding public transport is inevitable for a modern city.

topic: Some people say that in all level of education, from primary schools to universities, too much time is spent on learning facts and not enough on learning practical skills. Ċ Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that students are thought only from textbooks and do not get hands-on experience on the subjects from lower school grades till they acquire degree education. I completely agree with this opinion and believe that the pupils should be allowed to learn through practice by performing experiments on the facts thought.

First of all, the academic subjects should be designed in a manner that serves both factual and practical purposes. This can be achieved if the institution teaches the class and then accompany them to perform the real-time projects outside the institute to give illustrations of how a particular topic actually works. For instance, as a teacher teaching marketing discipline, I took my class to the companies to reveal how marketing techniques are utilised to increase sales. This is necessary to inculcate practical learning habits in students since the commencement of their education.

Secondly, the learners by-heart the content thought in order to answer the exams and tend to forget the important concept once clearing the particular level. This is usually because they don't actually understand the matter and just spill on the answer sheets whatever they have memorised. A survey conducted in Canada revealed that the children who learnt in Canadian institutions are much more intelligent than learners from Asian schools as these schools include practicals in the curriculum. It is clear that it's possible to learn facts even without going to the faculty, as a result applying what is learnt is essential for better results.

To conclude, it is quite evident that a lot of schools expend huge time on learning factual material and have ignored developing practical skills. I strongly think that seeing things and doing them makes a person perfect. Therefore, the education system should devote equal time for students in teaching facts and giving practical knowledge.
