topic: Individuals can do nothing to improve the environment; only governments and large companies can make a difference. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
It is undeniable that the ecosystem requires enormous attention at the present time. It is stated by some of the population that the common public should not be engaged in improving the atmosphere, and it is the duty of the constitution and large-scale industries to bring the change. However, I completely disagree with the above given statement. The following essay will highlight the reasons for the disagreement.

The first and foremost reason is the protection of the human species from serious contagious diseases. It cannot be ignored that nowadays the mother earth is getting consumed by the pollution in air, water and soil. Undoubtedly, each person is a fundamental aspect of eco-biological system. Therefore, there is a necessity for self-consciousness which will lead to self-improvement. Moreover, it is their birthright to have clean air, food and shelter to breathe, eat and live respectively. For instance, a recent study done by students of Oxford university shows that 88 percent people are getting more conscious about the cleanliness of the surroundings, whereas, the percentage was 74% from last year.

In addition to this, the urgency of passing down the clean living environment further to the future generations adds to another reason. This could only be done by taking the measures such as the use of the diminished number of automobiles, use of Compressed Natural Gas and the charging vehicles. This is because the fuels emit harmful smoke and end products from the exhausts everyday. Furthermore, the use of plastic needs to be reduced and throwing away the rubbish in the water resources must be avoided. For example, this year, the members of my family started using only biodegradable substances and avoided using the excess of plastic, paper and wood to preserve the beautiful nature.

In conclusion, the reasons explained above illustrate that the initiatives ought to be taken on the personal level in order to protect our precious environment, as well as, our upcoming generations ultimately. This can be undertaken along with the assistance of large companies like non-profit organizations and the government. Living in such furbished ambience will keep our body and mind healthy and nourished.

  The ecosystem requires urgent personal and collective action to ensure environmental protection and human well-being.

Claim 1:
  Individual responsibility is essential to protect human health from pollution-related diseases.

Though institutional leadership is important, lasting change requires personal initiatives supported by governments and organizations to ensure a sustainable future for generations to come.

topic: Scientists believe that the world is in danger due to environmental changes .Some people say that personal lifestyle should be made to reduce the damage to environment, while others think that the government should do something to help. Discuss both the views and give your opinion.
essay:
With the world suffering greatly from the destruction of nature, some say changes must be implemented at an individual level whereas others think states have a greater role to play in obliterating the conundrum. This essay discusses both viewpoints with my opinion outlined in the conclusion.

First, the general populace can do so much to limit environmental damage and their efforts cannot be overlooked. Things like leaving the car at home or using electricity instead of firewood clearly help to reduce challenges like pollution. For example, Germans are very particular about the products they buy in shops; they only purchase organic products since these are supportive of the greater plea by the United Nations for people to protect the environment. However, such efforts are only small and usually isolated.

On the other hand, it is believed governments stand a better chance to produce sustainable impact. Their roles as legislators, adjudicators or enforcers and their financial clout can come in handy in saving the world's natural ecosystem. For instance, most states globally use the popular "polluters must pay principle" when dealing with offenders. Secondly, governing bodies have proved to be more effective in dealing with more serious crimes such as poaching in places like Africa after dedicating enough funding to police and military activities. This shows the magnitude of their role.

In conclusion, therefore, I argue that while individuals are important stakeholders in finding lasting solutions to environmental problems, the state can do so much more to help as I indicated in the second paragraph. These issues have been discussed in this essay.

topic: The cost of flying has decreased significantly over the last decade. This has made overseas travel much more accessible. Ċ Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.
essay:
There is no doubt that people are flying more these days. Airline ticket prices have fallen drastically and individuals are flying frequently. This essay will discuss some benefits and drawbacks of this trend.

On the one hand, the two main advantages of this are time saving and increase tourism. The flight between New York and London is reduced to 8 hours, due to the super-sonic commercial aircraft Concord. This saves a lot of time for people. Tourism is booming due to this trend. For example, 50 years ago families used to take local vacations, but now the flights the so inexpensive that everybody prefers travelling abroad. Countries such as Dubai has their whole economy, build around tourism. Furthermore, local vendors are also benefiting. This is because when individuals travel in other countries, they tend to buy local items. Which as a result helps the local economy.

On the other hand, there are a few disadvantages also. With increasing competition in airlines, they are struggling to make a profit. Hence customers' comfort is generally neglected. To illustrate, some companies are buying overused aircrafts. Because of this, the customers' safety is directly at risk. In addition, the modern planes are so packed to increase seating, they are lacking in basic safety gears. One more side-effect of cheap flights is over-tourism. For instance, some of the cities in Italy have become so polluted because of this, and all the famous tourist attractions have over five hour wait time.

To conclude, although flying has become accessible and beneficial, it has some negatives. If it's helping a country grow by improving the economy, there are harmful effects like over-tourism.

abstractive_summary: Flying has become more accessible and offers significant benefits, though it also brings notable drawbacks. The advent of faster air travel, exemplified by the Concorde, saves considerable time on routes like New York to London, enhancing global connectivity. Cheaper flights have also fueled a tourism boom, enabling families to travel abroad and allowing countries like Dubai to build entire economies around tourism, benefiting local vendors and economies. Over-tourism, driven by inexpensive travel, has overwhelmed cities, particularly in Italy, causing pollution and long waits at attractions. While cheap flights stimulate economic growth, they simultaneously contribute to harmful effects such as over-tourism, highlighting a complex trade-off between economic benefits and sustainable travel practices.

topic: The world of work is rapidly changing and employees cannot depend on having the same job or the same working conditions for life. Discuss the possible causes and suggest ways to prepare people to work in the future labor market volatility
essay:
Working environment and the workers are changing constantly and evolving to meet the demands of modern society. This essay will discuss possible reasons for these changes and ways that people can better prepare for their future career.

There are two main reasons that lead to this phenomenon. Firstly, the internet offer workers many job opportunities. Consequently, people are not financially depend on their company and having the chance to improve their living conditions. Secondly, there is an increase in the usage of modern technology in companies' daily work. Those workers, who find it difficult to learn and incorporate technology into their work, will be left behind. For example, factories have been applying modern AI technology into their process which will replace traditional workers.

However, there are a number of ways that people can prepare for their future occupation. Firstly, students in high schools should be well-prepared in order to have a clear vision in life. They will less likely to get lost and change jobs constantly. To illustrate, autonomous vehicles are predicted to replace most delivery and taxi driver jobs in the very near future, so this is not a job that someone should expect to have for a very long time. Thus, people will need to be able to keep up to date with these changes.

In conclusion, although there are many changes in the workplace these days, educating people to carefully choose their career and to keep up to date with modern technology, is the key to avoiding any major problems.

topic: Shopping online has various advantages for consumers but it may also have several disadvantages including the loss of individual privacy. Ċ Do the advantages of online shopping for consumers outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
It is thought that shopping online has several merits as well as drawbacks for consumers. I think the merits supersedes the demerits and will discuss the reasons in this essay.

Firstly, one of the reasons why I think shopping online is good is because it saves time and is easy for working people. That is to say, busy people might not really be able to go out to shop as their work takes most of their time but with online shopping, they can be at work and place their orders on what they want. For example, a survey showed that 90% of bankers buy their things online because of their busy work schedules. Therefore, for the tendency to save time and its simplicity, online shopping has more advantages.

Secondly, another reason that makes me believe buying online by consumers has more merits is because it is convenient and saves money. That is, at the comfort of people's homes and workplaces, they can actually purchase goods from anywhere in the world without being stressed with the burden of travelling there or even paying for transportation. For instance, in those days, businessmen from Nigeria travel to china to buy products and then import them back to the country which was very expensive but lately, retailers can easily buy them online and have them shipped to their destination. Hence, buying from the internet is stress-free and cheaper.

In conclusion, even though some folk think online shopping has various disadvantages such as loss of privacy, I believe the advantages are more because it is cheaper, saves time and is more convenient.

topic: Neighbors are the people who live near us. In your opinion, what are the qualities of a good neighbor? Use specific reasons and examples in your answer.
essay:
There is an Arabic proverb that goes "Choose the neighbor before you choose the house", which means, while choosing a house to buy, neighbors are more important than the house. In my opinion, a good neighbor must be respectful and thoughtful.

First of all, a good neighbor respects his neighbors. He does not make noise after midnight or when one of his neighbors is sick. He always greets the other neighbors whenever he sees them. For example, I remember one of my neighbors who was an old man, waters the plants of his front garden, every morning, and greets every passerby with a smile. One day, he did not show up as usual, everyone missed him. When they went to ask about him, they found out that he was sick.

Additionally, a good neighbor must be thoughtful. He cares about his neighbors and ready to help them in the times of need. He also has a sense of responsibility; whenever one of his neighbors has a trouble he rushes to give him a helping hand. Besides that, he remembers his neighbors in the special occasions and celebrations. For instance, the lady who lives next door likes cooking and always sends us dishes and cakes, especially in the religious occasions.

To sum up, a neighbor is not less important than the house. With respectful and thoughtful neighbors, anyone can live in peace and harmony in his neighborhood.

topic: In the future, students may have the choice of studying at home by using technology such as computers or television or of stuying at traditional schools. Which would you prefer?
essay:
In today's past-paced, driven society. We often talk about the convenience of technology it might bring. However, learning at home by using technology such as computer or television would have a negative effect in students' learning. It limits students' scocialization, eliminates leadership's role, and causes of poor academic performance.

Initially, going to traditional school, students not only learn lecture, but also learn how to socialize. They have a full oportunuity to build real friendship and companion in school. Also, students would have a chance to develop social and communication skills such as how to ask questions and get feedback from teachers and peers, which contribute a great academic success.

Furthermore, studying at home, students would have no chance to present in front of audience. They would have lack of presentation skills, which give them a hard time to express their feelings and speeches. Gradually, these disadvantages would lower students' confidence. Ultimately, they would have less chance to be in a leadership's roles.

Besides, home schooling by using technology would be a major distract since television provides varied channels that attract students to entertain rather than to study. At the same mean, computer could be a good tool for studying, but it also brings some negative effects. For instance, some students are addicted to online games and chatrooms on the computer. Therefore, they might not able to focus on study.

Those are the main factors of having students go to traditional schools. Maybe a few people would oppose, but going to traditional schools is makes sense, because it benefits students both in class and outside of academic.

topic: Some people argue that it is more important to have an enjoyable job than to earn a lot of money. Others disagree and think that a good salary leads to a better life.  Discuss both these views and give your own opinion
essay:
These days, money becomes an essential part of people's lives. As such, several people believe that people who have comfortable job are more important than to earn much money because they need enjoyable in their jobs when they work. However, others think that a good salary will give people a better life since they can buy anything that they want. Therefore, I would argue that those statements have an influence for people's live because people have right to choose their wish.

On the one hand, people nowadays tend to spend their time for working to earn a lot of money to gain a better life. For instance, many parents today are spending lot of time for their jobs than to their children. This is because they think when they can give enough money for their children, all the problems will be done because the important thing that they can earn much money and it can make their children happy. As a result, this action has no guarantee if people have much money and then they can achieve a better life.

On the other hand, people also need to have an enjoyable job than to earn a lot of money. Firstly, when people are feeling happy in their jobs, it will result a good effect on their lives especially in their workplace without think about money. Also, people can feel free, it means they do not think that it is more important for people when they work base on their heart.

To sum up, it is evident than both trends have value itself, so people should be careful for their choices. It is imperative that people also should know about the impact of their choices when they make a decision in their lives.

topic: The internet has greatly increased our access to information. To what extent do you think this is a good thing? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
After technology had been well-developed for worldwide citizens, the internet started playing a pivotal role as an online database for all different professions. In my perspective, this is a great opportunity we receive from being able to reach our target within the fingertip. This essay completely agrees with the statement and states two reasons why the situation is considered a positive effect on humankind.

The first reason is that it provides convenience in approaching the information from all around the world. Simply put, access to textbooks and academic studies will become at ease for every professional field. The online platform, such as Academia, and Wikipedia, can be an obvious instance to elaborate this point with their acts as an enormous library for all users. Moreover, worldwide individuals are brought together via social media platforms which provide more convenient modes of communication among those in the same profession. Therefore, the needed knowledge can be interchanged much more easily.

Another reason that benefits our daily life is that plagiarism will be easily detected. With the ability of online websites, the number of plagiarised typologies tends to show a significant decrease. For example, online application, like Grammarly, allows paid users to check whether they are duplicating others or they are being replicated with a feature so-called plagiarism detector. This positive will encourage the organisation to produce more beneficial research and promote transparency in academic area.

In summary, there might be some disadvantages of online access to information, however, the advantages, especially the convenience for information approach, completely outweigh those. In my opinion, the use of the internet as an online platform for collecting business and academic data is considered a useful condition.

topic: Having more money and less free time is better than earning less money and having more free time. Ċ Discuss both views and state your opinion?
essay:
The more you earn, the less you value other activities which keeps you and your family happy is a norm accepted by most of the earning people of the world. But is it an acceptable strategy or the opposite will be better to spend our lives. I personally assume that a balance is required between the two. This essay will analyse this situation using the examples of Oxford University research and Time magazine survey in order to demonstrate points and support claims.

On the one hand, people concentrate more on earning livelihood therefore compromising on themselves, their friends or family members. Additionally, such kind of people think that become rich is the ultimate goal of their life so that they can purchase every happiness of the world. For example, when people looked at the lives of superstars and analyse their earnings, they idealize that the only way to achieve such fame is to get wealthy. So, it is clear from this that people believe in the power of wealth rather than keeping in touch with the family members or friends which they consider a useless activity.

On the other hand, there are some who criticize the above mentioned view by saying that leisure moments are preferable, and would not be compromised in any scenario. Furthermore, they think that we are here in this world to enjoy its beauties and comforts and we can’t purchase everything especially our families or precious friends. For instance, it is commonly seen that people who become more workaholic easily get diseases like high blood pressure or diabetes as compared to those who realize the importance of other activities. From this survey, it is clear that we can buy properties but wealth of love is not purchasable by any worldly resources until or unless you don’t show interest in them.

To conclude, I personally believe that leisure and earning both are important factors to live a balanced life and we cannot ignore any factor as it is explained in both examples. So if a person does justice in between spare activities and business deals, he will live a more balanced life.

structured_summary:
Major claim:
  A balance between earning and leisure is necessary for a fulfilling life.

Claim 1:
  People prioritize earning a livelihood.
  Premise: This leads to compromising on themselves, their friends, or family members.

Claim 2:
  Some people believe becoming rich is life's ultimate goal.
  Premise: They assume wealth can purchase all forms of happiness.
  Premise: People often idealize the lives of superstars and associate their fame with high earnings.
  Premise: This shows a widespread belief in the power of wealth.
  Premise: Family and friendships are often seen as unimportant activities in comparison.

Counterargument:
  Some argue that leisure time should not be sacrificed under any circumstances.
  Rebuttal: They believe life is meant to enjoy the world's beauty and comforts.

Claim 3:
  People should value non-material aspects of life.
  Premise: Certain experiences, such as family and close friendships, cannot be bought.
  Premise: Workaholics are more prone to health issues like high blood pressure or diabetes compared to those who value other activities.
  Premise: Properties can be purchased, but emotional wealth like love requires active engagement.
  Premise: Both leisure and earning are essential for a balanced life, as demonstrated by the examples.
  Premise: A person who balances spare time and work commitments will lead a more balanced life.
abstractive_summary: A fulfilling life requires balancing earning with leisure, as excessive focus on income often leads to personal compromise and strained relationships. While many prioritize wealth, believing it guarantees happiness and emulating the lifestyles of the rich and famous, this mindset frequently diminishes the value of family and friendships. Some argue that leisure should never be sacrificed, emphasizing life’s purpose as enjoying its comforts and beauty. However, both work and leisure are essential. Non-material experiences like love and close relationships cannot be bought, and neglecting them harms well-being, as seen in the higher health risks among workaholics. Ultimately, a balanced life integrates both financial responsibility and meaningful personal engagement.

topic: A person’s worth nowadays seems to be judged according to social status and material possessions. Old-fashioned values, such as honour, kindness and trust, no longer seem important. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion? Ċ Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Today, some people believe that social status has become the most essential in some communities. In addition, honesty and gentleness have been losing importance although most societies still are rooted in those values. It can be agreed that economical reputation has rather lost power in the modern world.

At the outset, there are numerous reasons why humanity is unevaluating money, but the most conspicuous stems from the fact that houses or cars are losing space for experiences. Furthermore, friendship or family have skyrocketed people´s carelessness. For example, being trusted by whom you love today is the mindset for all mankind while having your own possessions is losing space for sharing properties, such as, cars or other transportation. For this reason, the importance of showing or bank account is no longer overwhelming.

Nevertheless, there are some drawbacks to being rich. However, quality of life, love , or inside peace far outweigh those old-fashioned thoughts. As an illustration, environmental friendliness has been the most ultimate and has overlooked over profit. Even millionaires choose to make less money if they will support nature, as a way of caring for future generations, so there is still kindness that overwhelms gold. Consequently, wealth becomes the least in people value, humans only want to have enough for comfortability housing, eating or other passions for them.

To summarize, even though some worry about having much more wealth, far more people worry about healthy relationships with others. Moreover, they want to be remembered for what they did not for what they have, so do I.

abstractive_summary: People now value meaningful relationships and experiences more than material wealth, as trust, love, and shared connections take precedence over ownership and financial status. There is a growing shift away from valuing money and possessions, with more individuals prioritizing experiences, environmental responsibility, and emotional well-being. Friendship and family have become central to personal identity, and resource sharing is replacing personal ownership. While social status and wealth still matter to some, the broader trend shows that people care more about being remembered for their actions and relationships than for their bank accounts. Even the wealthy increasingly favor purpose and kindness over profit, seeking only enough money for comfort and passion.

topic: In today's competitive world, many families find it necessary for both parents to go out to work. While some say the children in these families benefit from the additional income, others feel they lack support because of their parents' absence. Discuss both views and give your opinions.
essay:
Nowadays, many families have dual sources of income. Some people have argued that if both husbands and wives go out to work, that will be of benefit to their children, while others believe that children will be affected due to lack of parental support. This essay will discuss both sides and I believe this situation can affect children both positively and negatively.

Children will gain numerous benefits when both parents are income earners for a number of reasons. First, the extra income will amount to a better standard of living. For instance, children whose parents are high-income earners often attend the best educational environment. Also,they have access to a lot of educational devices that can help their learning. Another advantage of dual sources of income is that children from such homes are able to enjoy their life by travelling abroad, going on holidays and affording things they need.

On the other hand, some people believe that children are affected and may face some problems due to this kind of family. In fact, most parents are not usually available to their children. The busy workload at workplaces can cause adverse implications to parents’ emotional states and thus affects their families. For example, when parents are stressed with their work, they decide to ignore their children and let them do what they want, which may lead to an imbalance between the parents and children’s relationship. Children, as a result, without the care of parents, may get involved in crime easily or be alcoholic.

In conclusion, I believe that we cannot change the fact that parents have to work but if parents make time for their children in the evenings or at the weekends, then the children will not suffer emotionally. By both parents working, there will be an extra income and a much higher standard of living, which brings benefits to the whole family.

topic: Question Many people think that international travel will decrease in the future. Do you think this will be a positive development? Give examples from your experience. Answer
essay:
In today's modernized world, travel is something which each and everyone of us make. The amount of travel has been increasing over the last few years and the trend will continue. According to my opinion, this increase in travel is good for the individual and for the country.

Firstly, with the increasing impact of globalization international travel between countries has gone up. Companies set up business in different countries and this results in transportation of goods and services across countries. This will help in cultural exchange between countries. People travelling to different countries will learn new language, culture and tradition.

Secondly, tourism is one of the major source of income for any country. Many countries nowadays have policies which support tourism which result in the increase of international travel. This will improve the economy of the host country and improve associated business.

Thirdly, Information Technology is the most growing job market in the 21st century. Many countries outsource their business to different countries where it can be done at a cheaper rate. This will require support at the client site which results in increase of travel of software professionals to foreign countries. As part of my job, I had travelled to China. I was able to learn their culture, language and cutting edge technology.

To conclude, travel is inevitable in today's technology advanced world. Globalization, tourism, IT etc demand lot of international travel between countries. This is good for the country socially, politically and culturally.

topic: Some people believe if people are allowed to work after the age of 60, it will cause some problems. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Citizen’s aging problems become serious social issues, thus some governments issue some new policies to reduce the pressure on paying pensions, which the most common one is allowed people to work after the original retirement age. In my opinion, this measure might solve certain financial problems from governments, but will create other social problems.

Firstly, this phenomenon could take away numerous young people’s opportunities of work. The number of jobs which provided via the society is almost constant during a short-term period, because when old employees who delay retirement, which means these jobs will be available for fresh graduates in a few years later, especially, it would affect the high skills requirement kinds of jobs. For example, architectural design enterprises are often trying to hold their old employees as long as possible, because they accumulated a lot of knowledge and experience. Therefore, the unemployment rate of youth might rise and add some unstable elements to societies.

On the other hand, it could increase the operating cost of businesses. The length of service is an important factor for human resources setting a salary structure, so the old usual gain a much higher income than the new. For example, a worker might get $30 per hour on the first day of his career, and he could get $100 per hour after 30 years, that could be a big pressure on some manufacturer or service provider because there is no a big skill gap of jobs between the young and old. According to the reverses view that young people not only reduce the labour cost, but also become the new blood join to the group and develop the industries.

In conclusion, although a delay of retirement could transfer a part of financial problems from the government to individual and companies, it will create some new troubles to the society.

topic: Individuals can do nothing to improve the environment. Only governments and large companies can make a difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is considered that to ameliorate the current environmental condition, merely ruling authorities and big organizations can play a pivotal role and the general public is unable to contribute anything to it. However, in my perspective, collective efforts are the demand of the time as individuals, too, have the onus to minimize their practices which are denounced by the environmentalists.

First of all, since human activities such as deforestation, industrialization and urbanization are responsible for the contamination of natural surroundings, limiting these practices would be a pragmatic approach towards a clean environment. If individuals consider discontinuation of these activities, tainting can be controlled to a great extent. The demonstration of this was observed during the lockdown period of the COVID 19 pandemic when the lack of these acts contributed to a better environment. Additionally, the rule of 3Rs: reduce, reuse and recycle, can be added to a daily routine so that the responsibility of protecting nature is fulfilled.

Furthermore, along with a minor change in the present-day lifestyle of people, legislation and companies, too, have a prominent role to play in saving the surroundings from pollutants. The former, by imposing stringent environmental protection laws, can make masses obliged to follow an environment-friendly lifestyle in which they avoid single-use plastic and do not exploit natural energy resources. The latter can also assist in preserving nature by not only adequately disposing of venomous chemicals but also by using clean energy to run their factories, for instance, solar, wind and water so that no toxic waste is generated. These initiatives could be extremely beneficial to improve the overall quality of our surroundings.

To conclude, it can be asserted that alone government and entrepreneurs are not able to protect the environment from further degradation, and therefore individuals also have to add eco-friendly habits to preserve it.

topic: The best way to reduce the number of traffic accidents is to raise age limit for the younger drivers and to lower age limit for the aged ones. Do you agree?
essay:
We must acknowledge that the number of car accidents has been currently growing. Some people hold the opinion that the government should raise the age limit for young drivers as well as lowering the age limit of the aged ones.

Nevertheless, we cannot consider age as the main reason of accidents, because there are many young and aged drivers who are very fit for driving. However, many other factors lead to road accidents. For instance, drivers who are drunk and also those who take drugs, regardless of their ages, do not concentrate while driving as their minds are totally distracted because of the alcohol and the drugs effect.

Bad health conditions, also, play an important role in accidents, in particular eyes diseases such as weak sight or color blindness. Drivers who suffer from such illness do not usually have a clear vision for the road or the signs, and therefore they are more likely to make accidents.

In order to reduce this huge number of accidents, some effective steps must be taken in consideration. For example, an awareness campaign should be held by the media, that the people should not drive if they are drunk of under the effect of drugs even if they have all the other privileges that allow them to drive, explaining the consequences of such cases. Moreover, an accurate medical check should be done at least once every year for those who have a valid driving license especially the aged ones, so that any eye or heart diseases can be easily be discovered.

In conclusion, I believe that if we succeed in applying all these effective procedures to ensure the maximum safety for both drivers and pedestrians, we will not need to change the age limit of the drivers; hence we will have more aware people.

topic: Scientists believe that the world is in danger due to environmental changes. Some people say that personal lifestyle changes should be made to reduce the damage to environment, while others think that the government should do something to help. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Environmental problems are clearly an issue that is often discussed in today’s world. One part of society claims that individuals should change their habits and lifestyle to improve the ecological situation. Others, on the other hand, believe that this issue should be solved on the governmental level. This essay will discuss both sides of the argument and my perspective will be offered.

It is hard to deny that humankind is responsible for the current environmental situation, and it seems impossible to achieve any noticeable result in this field without the participation of a vast majority of individuals. For instance, a simple lifestyle change such as introducing the separation of household rubbish can make recycling projects more convenient and efficient. Moreover, consumers can reduce their usage of plastic items and, in turn, less plastic waste will contaminate the environment.

However, many people still feel that the government has more tools to prevent environmental changes. One option that the authorities have is to discourage citizens from using personal vehicles by charging high taxes and additional fees. Moreover, politicians usually have access to resources to educate people about environmental problems and promote the most important ecological projects on all levels, ranging from special courses at schools to TV shows and websites related to this topic. Furthermore, it is a key responsibility of the government to protect the environment by spending state funds on research and modern equipment. Countries where legislation protects the ecology, for example,a country like Norway, has achieved visible results and overcame most environmental problems.

In conclusion, I believe that a combined approach will work best to prevent or reverse environmental changes. A contribution of every individual is just as important as the intervention from the government in order to fix existing issues and save our planet for future generations.

topic: In many places, new homes are needed but the only space available for building them is in the countryside. Some people believe it is more important to protect the countryside and not build new homes there. What is your opinion about this?
essay:
In recent years, the lack of land for housing in urban areas has pushed developers to the rural for their projects. While some people think that it is a bad idea that will cause the reduction of greens, I tend to agree partially with it.

On one hand, population growth is crucial for the progress of a nation. In addition, it helps to grow the economy of the state. Proper accommodations are needed ensuring everyone has a place to stay and feel safe. A government needs to have proper planning on real estate in the city and countryside looking at the growth of their nation. This further allows real estate to be affordable and comfortable to live in. For instance, in some cities, a small apartment unit will be unaffordable for a normal class citizen which also provides a lower quality of life.

On the other hand, there needs to be proper control when planning to build houses out of the city. The authorities need to ensure that the developers play an important role in preserving nature when they are executing their plans. Improper planning might bring in issues such as traffic congestions, pollutions, and social issues. The beauty of the countryside needs to be preserved at all costs. Furthermore, some parts of the country have great heritage values, which will be lost due to the change. The government should include laws that ensure a balance of nature is included in any real estate development in rural areas.

In conclusion, a country needs to ensure that there is a proper blueprint which provides a balanced development in the city and countryside which I believe will be crucial to maintain the nature and provide a comfortable place to live.

topic: These days, many university courses are offered through the internet. Some people think that online teaching has more advantages than conventional classroom teaching or lectures, while others claim that there are significant disadvantages. Do the benefits of online teaching outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
In recent years, large numbers of online courses are available in many universities. It is often discussed as a controversial issue whether there are more benefits or more drawbacks to distance learning. From my point of view, I believe there are more disadvantages than advantages. In this essay, I will discuss both views in detail.

On the one hand, students can get large numbers of benefits by taking e-learning studies. Firstly, streaming web-based courses provides significant convenience for students. Since they do not need to be physically in schools, they can save their time and money. To give a clear example, a student does not have to pay for the transportation systems to attend the school which saves their transportation fees and commuting time. Secondly, it gives learners immediate access to the faculties. Learners can instantly reach out to the professors with questions and view class documents on the internet. For instance, if there is something they do not understand in the field of their study, they are able to ask through the internet which is difficult for students who attend in-person classes because they typically need to wait until the scheduled class time to meet a professor or peers.

On the other hand, there are some problems that emerge along with positive aspects. To begin with, there is no physical contact with classmates, and as a consequence, that may lead to miscommunication or isolation. For example, some research shows that 70% of pupils who take online courses find it more difficult to communicate with peers and find it hard to do some projects as a team. On top of that, they are more likely to encounter technical issues during class. Due to the large numbers of people attending the same platform at the same time, problems with network connections or servers may arise. From my experience, I had difficulties with network connections when I took a distance class. There was a delay between the sound and the visual.

To conclude, although there are some advantages to online courses such as convenience and immediate access to the faculties, there are less in-person interaction and technical issues as well. I personally believe the drawbacks outweigh the benefits.

topic: the threat of nuclear weapons maintains the world peace. nuclear power provides cheap and clean energy. the benefits of nuclear technology far out-weight the disadvantages. do you agree or disagree? beware of unimaginable negative effects
essay:
Many people said that the benefits of nuclear technology are more valuable than its disadvantages. The dangers of nuclear weapons keep the world peace and nuclear power is an alternative resource which is bet than other power sources that we are using. Personally, I strongly disagree with this statement due to the harm it causes.

First of all, we cannot deny that nuclear technology plays an important role in our lives. If we compare it to fossil fuel, we can see that nuclear power is cheaper, quicker, cleaner and one prominent thing that it is unlimited. It can solve the problem that we are running out of non-renewable natural resources. Furthermore, if nuclear weapons did not exist, world war 3 could happen anytime. Without the threat of them, many aggressive nations would not be scared of anything.

However, the positive benefits are not worth the risks to the earth. Besides the potential benefits of nuclear technology, we can see that if it was not handled carefully, an explosion could happen. As a result, not only a large of area would be destroyed but also none of living creatures could survive in the radius of that destructive explosion. Moreover, humanity could have incurable diseases because of the effects from that. The governments would have to spend a huge amount of money to rebuild everything and help the victims settle down.

In conclusion, the benefits of nuclear technology cannot compare to its unimaginable negative effects. If we can reduce the damage of it by decrease the number of nuclear weapons and factories, use other renewable natural resources such as the sun, wind, and water to stop making the environment polluted probably it still can be accepted.

topic: Nowadays anyone can post news on the internet. As a result, we cannot trust information we read there. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Recently with the great evolution of the wide web services, an uncontrolled number of people are publishing information without verifying their sources. From my perspective, I agree that individuals should not consider broadcasts published on the internet by anonymous as reliable sources for several reasons.

The first reason for my position is that the individuals publishing the statement mostly are unknown and they could have some personal motivations for fabricating news. This can be clearly seen not just for marketing purposes but also for politicians and anyone who has an interest in deceiving public opinion. For instance, there are numerous numbers of guided media persons, actors and idols with a huge base of fans who follow and trust them. Therefore, it is not safe to trust news from such a category of media personnel that can mislead followers over the internet.

Another reason for not accounting for internet news is that most of the website platforms are accessible to an unlimited number of people. Hence, the resources of the published news cannot be verified easily. Also, the speed of spreading information over the online sphere is incredible. For example, a car accident report in Japan can be uploaded and published before even making sure of the safety of the drivers and the information about it transmitted to a USA citizen. As a result, wrong information about a correct event could be published unintentionally.

To conclude, the amount of news found over the internet is extremely amazing. However, individuals must not trust all of it because there might be disseminated through untrusted people or wrongly being analyzed.

topic: People should be responsible for the pollution problems caused by transportation, while others think govt should be responsible. Discuss both sides and give opinion.
essay:
Although some crowd think they are responsible for pollution issues that are caused by car's wastes, others believe that government should take charge of these problems. In my opinion, I agree with the latter argument because these serious issues need an organization to deal with and people may not have adequate awareness. In this essay, I will discuss both views and support my opinion with examples.

Nowadays, some people argue they are capable of trimming the pollution problems that happened by transportation. To illustrate, they assume that they can reduce the number of used cars. for example, every four persons gather to move from one place to another by using one car instead of four cars. as a result, dangerous chemicals that are produced from vehicles will be decreased.

However, I would argue that the responsibility of solving these problems is lies in the state. this is because such big operations need an organization to handle and to put the laws that citizens should follow. in addition, campaigns must be led to raise the nation's awareness under governmental supervision. for instance, setting appropriate rules to tackle the air toxicity issue can be only done by the government. thus, lawbreakers will get the appropriate punishment whether it is paying a fine or another penalty.

To conclude, while some folks think they can take the blame for air toxicity, I tend to agree that the state should take charge of this dilemma because it can easily tackle this issue and motivate other people to get strict with the new rules.

topic: More and more people prefer to read ebooks rather than paper books. What are the reasons for this? Ċ What problems can this cause for libraries?
essay:
Nowadays, with the advancing of technologies, the Electronic libraries are becoming increasingly popular. For many students, ebooks are recommended than manual paper books. This essay will discuss why this is occurring and examine the consequences of this worrying trend.

To begin with, one of the key reasons behind the preference of ebooks is convenience. Firstly, it provides wide assistance or opportunity during travelling, staying at home along with any particular place throughout the life and can access more and numerous range of books in one device rather than a big bag, from where the books can be read at any time. Secondly, these are cheaper to buy that poor students can easily afford it as well as achieve effective results in their exams. Such as a mobile device, on which an academic material or any document is downloaded, similarly, he can comfortably get through any article or a topic, while revising during the journey to school. Consequently, ebooks offers broad spread of services at one time.

Nevertheless, this may raise the major troubles to sustain quality. Firstly, it will reduce the income, which may lose to remarkable budget along with significant loss of workers, by what especially; a particular level will be affected. For instance, considering the gradually reducing number of admissions in the library, if it gets short of earning, the number of employees shall be terminated to maintain a business and quality. Hence, the income includes the major contribution of the student’s fees.

Conclusion, the ebooks technology is offering wide variety of books in a single device along with conveniently. Therefore, libraries are at greater risk of losing specific level, quality, business and the employment.

topic: Task 2: Some people think that a huge amount of time and money is spent on the protection of wild animals, and that this money could be better spent on the human population. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Some people argue that time and money investments on wild animals are too large and these investments should be spent on humans. I completely disagree with this point of view.

Firstly, in my opinion it is absurd to argue the investment on wild animal protection is redundant. It is true that in recent years, we have been organized numerous campaigns to raise people 'awareness about the importance of wild animal protection and erected parks and animal conservation sites to protect animals, which can cost a fortune. However, it appears that there are several other areas which are burning money of human such as nuclear energy and space exploration. Take space exploration as an example, the budget of a rocket production is far higher than that of a zoo. Similarly, the training fee for a zoo keeper is nowhere near as expensive as that of an astronaut. Hence, the financial investment on wild animal protection is nothing comparing with that of other fields.

Secondly, wild animals play a crucial role in humans' lives. Protecting animals means protecting their habitats which are instrumental in balancing the ecosystem. If wild animals die out, the ecosystem is destroyed. As a result, humans are likely to face with extreme weather such as climate changes and other disasters. Besides, wild animals is a rich source of science research. Scientists usually do some observe and analyze the manners and behaviors of those species and their exploration after that can broaden the knowledge of human about nature even some of them are considered as foundation for human research.

In conclusion, in my opinion the investment we spent on animals is money-worthy and wild animals protection is always a matter of importance.

topic: Some people believe that success in life comes from taking risks or chances. Others believe that success results from careful planning. In your opinion, what does success come from? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay:
Life is like a race and we all are running in that race to win. To win this race, running is important. If we do planning only and don't run then, that will not help us to win the race. By this way, careful action in any work in life is important, only planning cannot help to success in life. Proper planning with careful action can help us to success in life.

Firstly, taking risk can teach us new lessons in our life. This will give us new experience of learning new things, where we can find our strength and weaknesses. We can find our interest in that work or activity. This will help us to improve our skills and work on our weaknesses. This will not always results success but, failure is the first step to success so, we should learn to take risk in our life to find our strength and weaknesses

Secondly, taking risks can help us to find new ideas and opportunities in life. We can also make a profit by taking risks. For example, in share market, people take risk and carefully invest their money and luckily they earn profit out of that. Second example, while playing, many times players have to take risk to win the match, even if he knows that he could not do that moves. No matter, whether they win the match or not, but they will have satisfaction that they tried. So, failure could also be the result of risks, but that does not mean, we should stop taking risk and keep ourselves away from new ideas and opportunities.

topic: The government should spend more money on medical research to protect citizens' health rather than on protecting the environment. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is argued that government should invest the country's budget on the healthcare system rather than the environmental issues. Undoubtedly, the health of the people should be the first priority of the authorities but I disagree with spending less money on the conversion of the environment.

Firstly, nature protection is completely vital because it has a direct impact on people's health levels. For example, if some measures are taken to prevent and decrease air pollution, it will lead to the prevention of various diseases, like cancers. Therefore, developing the city's infrastructures is mandatory, which requires the officials' attention, as well as, allocating adequate money to this field.

Secondly, there is a well-established link between nature and the resident's food. Attempting to save nature means prohibiting the consumption of fertilizer, which in turn makes agricultural products organic and chemical-free. For ,instance several lifestyle-related diseases such as diabetes and heart attack have been reported to take place as a result of the unhealthy diet and the use of processed food. This goal is not achievable unless governments support green growers by devoting enough money and infrastructures ,like sophisticated farming machinery. Thus it is another reason why the environment should be considered as a significant field by the officials.

Take everything into consideration, some prominent factors why the environment should be one of the substantial parts of the nation's budget have been mentioned, namely its importance to illness prevention and production of organic food. I cannot be convinced that high levels of health would be possible without the environmental protection program.

topic: Some people say that in all levels of education, from primary schools to university, too much time is spent on learning facts and not enough on learning practical skills. Do you agree or disagree ?
essay:
There is no doubt that theoretical knowledge plays a crucial role in building societies. While some people would argue that students have spent the majority of their school-life in learning Science and Math rather than focusing on skills, I reckon that both sides of studies are essential.

Firstly, the main reason why scientific subjects are vital is the improvement of society. This is because students who graduate as doctors and engineers have the responsibility to plan, create, and maintain city infrastructures. For instance, bridges and tunnels are highly advanced level projects, which need special experts to be functioning and stay in service for a long period. In contrast, if there were no theoretical curriculum in schools, society would struggle with the shortage of sufficient qualified professions. And in consequence, the ability to enhance their standard of living.

Nevertheless, learning business skills has become as important as another syllabus. The reason for that is the demand for communication skills and soft skills has increased largely in the market, and companies are likely to offer better opportunities for those how to have such skills. Marketing business, for example, is directly affected by the marketers' ability to convince customers and make them purchase their products, and ,thus, these skills would have an impact on the companies' revenue.Therefore, pupils would be ready for work-life should authorities pay more attention to provide them with the necessary potentials.

In conclusion, Although Science and Math have helped society to achieve higher standards of living, students need to be professionals in other aspects to enrol in their future jobs effectively.

topic: all sports bring great benefits Some people think that it is more beneficial to take part in sports which are played in teams, like football, while people think that taking part in individual sports, like tennis or swimming, is better. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Some people argue that team sports provide player with a wide range of benefits while others think that individual sports are much better. From my perspectives, I think both types of sports have their own benefits and it depends on what purpose people choose to play.

On the one hand, team sports give players opportunities to develop interpersonal skills such as teamwork and communication skills. These benefits not only help people in their day-to-day social interactions but also accelerate their career. Furthermore, team sports offer players the chance to strengthen sense of unity, friendship and sportsmanship between people in a team. In this sense, it really add value to people's live by making them feel a part of something.

On the other hand, individual sports have their own positive effects as well. Firstly, sports played by individuals like tennis or swimming have a profound impact on their personal skills. This means, through these kinds of sport, players are able to manage their emotions, cope with strains and build confidence and self-esteem. Secondly, people who play these sports tend to develop a strong mindset when they do their utmost and brainstorm in order to overcome any setbacks they may face. Finally, one-player sports provide better opportunity for people to challenge themselves by setting goal and achieve the payoff by their own efforts.

In conclusion, I believe that all sports bring great benefits for people's mental and physical health, and people should choose whatever sport they have passion for.

topic: Some people believe that developments in the field of artificial intelligence will have a positive impact on our lives in the near future. Others, by contrast, are worried that we are not prepared for a world in which computers are more intelligent than humans. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Artificial intelligence is an issue that has been discussed by many people nowadays. Some people may think that advances in technology won't be beneficial for society and that computers can't substitute the human workforce. However, others believe that it will have a positive impact on everyone's life. I strongly agree with this last opinion and the reasons will be explained in this essay.

On the one hand, the advances in technology can help and improve the outcome in many professions. For example, complex surgeries now can be performed by robots instead of human hands. This new feature brings more efficacy to the treatment and surgeries can be more precise with better results for the patients. In addition, with the introduction of robots performing surgeries, a surgeon can command the machine from abroad while the patient is in the operation room with robots. Consequently, the risk of infection during surgeries will decrease significantly besides the other benefits of the results.

On the other hand, when machines start substituting man workforce, some people will probably lose their jobs. For instance, machines are now used for self-checkout at grocery stores eliminating the need for humans at the checkout. Then, some employees will end up being fired and the rates of unemployment will grow. Furthermore, with this trend, poverty will also increase in societies, and governments will have to invest in new strategies to contain this wave.

In conclusion, in my opinion, artificial intelligence is being developed for our best intention. However, there are some deleterious consequences associated with it. So, society and governments should be aware of the risks implicated with it and try to build strategies to prevent future damage.

topic: Many museums and historical sites are mainly visited by tourists but not local people. Why is it the case? What can be done to attract local people to visit these places?
essay:
These days, the most frequent visitors in museums and historical sites are tourists rather than indigenous people. Myriads of factors work behind this situation, which could be resolved by governments and authorities of the cultural sites.

To begin with, the local visitors are indifferent to roam around their own historical places as well as museums or art galleries. This is because they find it quite unattractive, since they do not discover any new refurbishments. For example, in Lal Bag Kella, in Dhaka, in Bangladesh, all the sculptures and the ancient history inscribed on the walls have been collapsed due to the absence of modern restoration, which locals, eventually, might think as a waste of time visiting such a place. Furthermore, tourists who do not know about the historical fact of any monuments, they desire to see such buildings, which have historical interests but not the people of residential areas. Therefore, these are the factors which instigate tourists spend plenty of money on visiting ancient places and museums instead of local individuals.

In contrast, since local people have no interest in their local art and crafts, governments and authorities should take a necessary step to resolve this problem. Firstly, the bureaucrats of the country have to announce free entry in museums and historical sites in each special occasion. For instance, the national museum of Bangladesh opens the whole day in the holiday when disabled, young and older people come to visit this place so that they gain proper knowledge about history, art, and artistic design. Moreover, the historical places ought to be made an essential change which could, consequently, help to allure local visitors without thinking that they are squandering money. Thus, entrepreneurs can apply these methods to attract local people.

In conclusion, foreign people would love to visit the local museums and historical places in the native countries, while local people do not like visiting such places because of boredoms in looking same scenarios, which could be solved by not asking entry fee in parts of the year and restoring the ancient monuments.

topic: Many people strive to maintain a successful career and happy family life at the same time. What problems can this situation create? What are the possible solutions?
essay:
It is hard to be a successful person. As seen, this notion brings a big problem such as stress due to the difficulty to split their time between working and family. However, i believe some viable solutions should be taken to tackle this problem.

Keeping a successful career and having happy family at the same time seems to be impossible since there is a problem preventing this notion such as feeling stressful. Feeling stressful is when people are in the situation such having bad emotional and mentality. This results in people being unstable emotion which can give additional effect like household rift and the decline in the quality of work. A 2012 recent Oxford University study reveals that 80%of divorce cases happened since spouses were likely to have less quality time with their family so as that they felt extremely tired when they were arriving at home.

To tackle this problem, government should make a new regulation to set working hours effectively for people in order to prevent the danger of working for long hours. As a result, they will have enough time to spend with their own family and keep their career in the right path as well. A 2014 recent New York Times poll reveals that there was a decrease in the number of people got depressed and divorce since such a strategy was started by government  so as that they can manage their time much more easier.

In conclusion, it seems to me that the main problem of this issue is dealing with stress since the less hours they spend with family due to the high pressure at work. Where possible, possible the government should make a regulation to arrange office hours in order to resolve this problem.

topic: In some countries, an increasing number of people are suffering from health problems as a result of eating too much fast food. It is, therefore, necessary for governments to impose a higher tax on this kind of food. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
It is very much true that, number of health-related problems are causing due to junk food only. Therefore, a fair amount of people believes that processed food is not good for health and I strongly agree with this statement with imposing of higher tax on frozen and trash foods.

To embark on, eating more junk feed may lead to human unhealthy so that we will get sick and even our body immunity system will be failed soon. Firstly, there are many of the fast-food services around us, which we can have any junk meal item with fewer amount prices and quick delivery whenever we want to eat. Secondly, we are busy with our office's schedules and not able to prepare our home cuisine on daily basis, hence most of the employees are opting for junk foodstuff. On the other hand, promotional offers are highly motivating and attractive towards trash food. For example, Bugger King and KFC owners are tempting us like anything with their offers and discounted prices.

However, undoubtedly, there are huge damages to our human lives due to this trash snack. The local government has to come up with additional taxes and certain limitations would be necessary to keep control of these fast fare items and also it is very much required to have some sudden audits on the quality of foodstuff and their services too. As per recent Google survey findings, human body immunity levels are dropping by 5% every year due to the processed cooking.

topic: Topic: Some people believe that air travel should be restricted because it causes serious pollution and will use up fuel resources in the world. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
The prevalence of airplane made an impressive improvement to people's life; a public debate, however, has been ignited about whether to limit its use due to the associated environmental contamination and energy consumption. Personally, I believe that it is not unnecessary to slow down the expanding of civil aviation.

Beyond all doubt, flight does bring two main serious environmental concerns to the world. Initially, during flying, it generates large amount of noise, particulates, as well as greenhouse gas, thus, may lead to significant climate change issues such as global warming and ozone reduction. Secondly, it also causes local pollution given that on the one hand, the construction and maintenance of an airport requires intensive energy; while on the other, aircraft and relevant ground transportation would dramatically decrease air quality. As a consequence, in reality, many governments are encouraging passengers to take alternative vehicles, especially for traveling in short and medium distance. Advanced and swift train, for example, is recommended as an appropriate substitute and has been widely implemented around the world: Eurostar in Italy, Super Express in Japan, and High-Speed Railway in China.

Admittedly, in terms of long distance journey, the airplane still ranks the first place in the customers' preferred choice list. Compared to other means of transports, it provides maximum comfort and security with minimum traveling time and cost, which enables convenient global exchanging and trading. Therefore, the status of flight, to a certain extent, is irreplaceable at present.

In conclusion, the proposal of reducing the frequent use of airplane is worthy of consideration since its drawbacks outweigh the benefits. Gratifyingly, with the improvement of technology and environmental consciousness, air travel is likely to turn out to be environmental friendly in the foreseeable future.

topic: The only way to be successful in a business is being good at maths.To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is said that mathematic proficiency is the key feature to be successful in business. I disagree with this opinion because a company needs various skills as well as sufficient market knowledge to become a well-known firm. This essay will discuss reasons to support my idea.

There are several factors for measuring a company status and rank it as a prosperous one; hence, only maths cannot guarantee its fortune because intrinsic skills such as putting effort, teamwork attitude as well as practical talents regarding the specific demand of the business are required. A successful supermarket chain in the UK, for instance, described their struggling journey throughout the years in a journal and mentioned that they have succeeded because of their staff work commitment and teamwork attitude. Although accounting and mastering in maths require in this trade, it is not the only key factor in achieving prosperity.

Before establishing a profession, retail knowledge should be deemed to minimize the risks and failures; therefore, just a specific talent does not seem sufficient. One of my friends, for example, started a small cafe several years ago, and now it is known as one of the most popular ones in the town. This prosperity did not happen by depending on a single talent and, they did ample market research before starting to find the market gap. By recognizing the gap, they could focus on their potential and bright points like forming a creative menu or decorating the shop in a way that could attract more customers. They; also, predicted their target customer and managed to provide the best quality services based on their needs.

In conclusion, the idea of mastering at maths is the only way to be a successful trader, seems unrealistic. I believe other skills and market research can play crucial roles in a business to lead it through prosperity.

essay:

topic: Some people say that advertising encourages us to buy products that we really do not need. Others say that advertisements tell us about new products that may improve all our lives. Which viewpoint do you agree with? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
essay:
Every field has its own positive and negative aspects and advertising is not an exception. From my point of view, I partly agree that advertising is a bad industry in today's economy.

On the one hand, advertising can be good for humans as it is a key part of modern business. It is a way for companies to tell their customers about new products. By advertising, people are informed that they have many choices of goods. Besides, it is a creative industry because it employs a huge number of workforce. The result is that there would be lower unemployment. Therefore, advertising may help to advance our lives.

On the other hand, many companies take advantage of advertising to sell their unnecessary products. Advertisers only focus on selling a brand image. They use glamorous and successful people to promote their brands. Those famous people who should be listed are Katy Perry, Taylor Swift, Justin Bieber, Selena Gomez and many more. This leads to the fact that more costumers will buy their products which might be needless for them. What is more, children can easily be influenced by advertisements. When they watch attention-grabbing commercials on television, they will tell parents to buy them such things. This can put pressure on their families. Hence, advertising can have its own disadvantages also.

In conclusion, although advertising helps people to meet their fundamental needs, its bad effects on human can not be denied. Consequently, advertising should be regulated and people need to consider before buying things.

topic: Some people think that men and women have different qualities. Therefore, some certain jobs are suitable for men and some jobs are suitable for women.  To what extent do you agree or disagree? Gender Diversity in the Workplace
essay:
Due to the various characters of two genders, some people are inclined to the assumption that men and women have their own suitable jobs. However, I stand on the opposite toward this issue.

First of all, it cannot be denied that men and women certainly have some physical differences so as to cause some stereotype that men are much qualified than women to do the physical jobs or women are much proper than men to do the paper work. For instance, the secretaries are usually women and the construction workers are men. I suppose this kind of stereotype is just the statistical theory, and it doesn't present the reality. In real life, a man can be sensitive to handle the detailed work, and a woman can afford an energy occupation.

Secondly, I think that will be the genderism if a job has its gender restriction. In order to create a gender equality employment environment, most of countries legislated to deter the gender discrimination. A highlight of gender equality law is protecting people's right to pursue their career instead of being restricted by the gender limitation. Also, the law implies that there is not a job much appropriate to a gender than another.

To sum up, although some people think there are some jobs are suitable for specific gender, I still hold the against attitude that any gender could be capable of a job as he/she is willing to do it.

Men and women are equally capable of performing any job they choose, regardless of gender.

Claim 1:  
Gender-based job restrictions constitute gender discrimination.

Women can thrive in physically demanding roles, just as men can excel in detail-oriented or administrative work. Beliefs that men are naturally better suited for labor-intensive jobs or that women are inherently better at office tasks stem from generalizations, not actual ability.

topic: More and more people are relying on the private car as their major means of transportation. Ċ Describe some of the problems over-reliance on cars can cause, and suggest at least one possible solution.
essay:
Nowadays, more people are capable of owning private vehicles which reduce their dependency on public transportations. There are some major problems created for the over-dependency on cars and both the government and the people of the country should participate in the solutions to the problems.

Firstly, more private cars mean more vehicles on the roads which will cause traffic jam easily. In other words, as people own their personal cars, they will not be visiting from one place to another on public transports, thus the numbers of cars on the streets will be much more which will cause traffic congestion. Secondly, more poisonous fumes are emitted from these increasing amount of transportations that has some detrimental effects on the environment. For example, researches have shown that more than 40% of the air pollution is caused by these hazardous gases emitted from these vehicles.

Some necessary steps can be taken to mitigate these problems caused by more private cars. By creating more public transports such as buses, the number of cars can be minimized on the streets which is the main reason for traffic congestion. Moreover, the government and the people of the nation should plant more trees to make the environment pollution free from these fumes. To exemplify that, Japan is one of the pollution-free countries around the world because of the less use of public buses than any other countries.

To conclude, people are becoming private car-oriented nowadays which is creating some problems, however, these problems can be solved with the participation of the individuals and the government of a country.

topic: Many people believe it is better to study in a group rather than individually. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There are different preferences in studying. The majority of people think that studying in a group gives more advantage compared to studying alone. I agree with that standpoint. There are similar benefits when approaching studying in a similar manner. Nevertheless, studying alone also can sometimes provide positive outcomes, making me in favour of both study methods depending on the situation.

There are several advantages of a group class. Exchange of ideas is one positive example that is more likely to occur in a similar setting. It is preferable to use such an approach when working on complicated tasks or group-project assignments because this generates the opportunity to discuss multiple views and challenge different perspectives, collectively solving the given problem. Furthermore, this practice provides a positive effect, increasing our communication skills by learning to listen and also responding accordingly to other individuals' standpoints. Consequently, improving our social skills.

Studying individually, on the other hand, provides different types of benefits. One of the advantages of a quiet setting when studying is that it allows us to be more focused and think clearly. This particular environment is usually preferable at times when we need to write or read. Libraries, for instance, are designed to provide personal space and limit noise so that individuals can benefit from a peaceful environment. In addition, another plus from personal learning is that it can be more efficient by avoiding unnecessary discussion as people working in groups tend to talk about unrelated topics.

In summary, group and personal study have different merits. We have the option to choose which one that we need considering the purpose of the study and the positive benefit that we want to gain. As a result, I would recommend opening both options discussed above.
