topic: Many companies sponsor sports as a way for advertising themselves. Some people think it is good for the world of sports, while others think there are disadvantages to this. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
essay:
In the contemporary world, it is common for the numbers of companies to promote themselves by investing budgets in sports. While some people are of the opinion that this statement brings benefits, others argue that there are demerits. This essay will elaborate further on both sides of this discussion and also show my perspective.

On the first hand, there is a myriad of arguments in favour of the stance that the public supports corporations to use their funds to make them famous through sports games. One of the most conspicuous is that amount of money can be used for the purpose of developing infrastructure. Therefore, it not only helps players to have better environments to practice but also helps them be safer during matches. Besides, those athletes who are in disadvantage also get benefits that their training fees are covered fully or partly by companies. As a result, more and more potential sportspeople have a chance to follow their dreams, as well as try their best due to the motivation that those awards lead them to. Particularly, soccer players from the national team were awarded the valuable gifts from enterprises when they had ranked first in Sea Games, which has motivated them in later tournaments.

On the other hand, in terms of the disadvantages that sponsoring may cause, there are some reasons that make people have a bias about it. The first one is, the results of vital matches probably manipulated by private-enterprises. In other words, it directly affects fair inspiration in sports. Furthermore, although promoting through sports brings profit to companies, some distractions are possibly caused by those advertising activities. For example, advertisement videos shown between games can lead to some negative feedback from audiences that they are so bothering. In other situations, it likewise impacts athletes that they have to think about positive speech to talk about a brand, which makes them hardly focused on their affairs.

In conclusion, despite the fact that companies cannot deny that they can get a bunch of advantages from sponsoring in sports, there are both good and bad sides of it in the view of the world of sports. From my perspective, I contend that the participants of companies positively bring great deals for sports because it enhances qualities, as well as motivates sports players.

topic: It is generally believed that some people are born with certain talents, for instance for sport or music, and others are not. However, it is sometimes claimed that any child can be taught to become a good sports person or musician. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
While talking about talent, some people suggest that those who are gifted, for example, in sport or music can obtain higher achievement. Others nevertheless, claim that through an apprroprate education, any individual can gain specific abilities. Both sides are supported by good reasons.

Those who believe in talents have cogent reasons. First, it makes easier for talented men to learn specific subjects. They learn much quicker than others, thus plenty of time can be saved. That is to say, they have extra time to learn additional knowledges. Furthermore, talent person can be more creative than conformed. Their creativity, as a result, bring their career to a higher level. Finally, talented people are capable of breaking the laws, hence they will establish their own style and make contribution to the subject.

However, there are also some others who contend that training is more important to individual. To begin with, they assert that the loss of talent can be compensated by hardly training. It also narrows the gap between the low and high achievers. In the second place, a great tutor can adject materials and methods of instruction, which in order to dig out one's potential.

Admittedly, both sides are reasonable. As for me, talent is much more important than training. Diligent practicing do make efforts in training athletes and musical experts, for instrance. However, those who once achieved higher goals or composed immortal masterpieces are always that people get talent. "Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration." Perspiration may be acquired, but the inspiration is indispensable.

topic: Task 2 IELTS: Countries such as China and India have unsustainable population growths. In fact, many experts are of the opinion that the population explosion which is a very worrying concern, is the most serious threat to life in this planet. Give some suggestions to address this problem.
essay:
In this modern world, population growth has been a major problem. In some countries, there isn't a proper plan to address this problem.

In this piece of writing, I would like to express my personal views about the measures which countries like China and India could design to control their population growth.

There are many ways which people and government could take into consideration that help nations to control their population growth rate. Firstly, the most important suggestion is to educate people in the control of birth rate. Because people who specially live in underdeveloped countries, are not aware of the negative effect of this issue. So, enlightening people have direct impact on birth rate and then the population. Secondly, government should introduced new rules to confine people to have the minimum number of babies. For example, in my country, states have limited the amount of subsides given to families which have more than three babies. After applying this policy, birth rate reduced by 1 percent.

Finally, media could have an important role in this issue. As people involved with newspapers, TV, advertisement and other kinds of program during the day, media could help people in this way. For example, a good film, created by a famous director about the population growth and its effects on our lives would attract and affect large number of people.

Personally I think that the most effective measure to deal with population growth is the role of governments, because they have a great responsibilities in this issue. Besides, experiments show that their rules could have the best results in reducing the birth rate.

topic: Some people think that parents should teach children how to be good membes of society. Others, however, believe that school is the place to learn this. Discuss both views and give your own opinion..
essay:
Whether children should be guided by their parents to have appropriate manners in society later on is still a source of controversy. Some people, however, assert that this job is designated for schools. Two sides of this issue will be discussed as follows and I will illustrate my own point of view.

Parents are undeniably indispensable in forming the characteristics of children. Since youngsters spend the majority of their childhood being with their parents, their personality traits will be unavoidably affected by the parents’ behaviours. As a result, parents are automatically responsible for guiding children to become those who can positively contribute their value to society. This is a totally natural part in child-rearing which can be seen everywhere in the world. For example, Vietnamese parents are prone to teach their children by themselves rather than sending them to kindergarten. Therefore, they can have a closer and stronger connection with their children and a better communication among family members.

On the other hand, some do believe that schools are a more suitable approach to teach children how to become good citizens. To be more exact, at schools, children can learn from their teachers, who are also parents, the characteristics that are necessary for their adulthoods like hard-working or respecting others. In addition, as parents are increasingly busier for business nowadays, schools are continually changing the way they teach children basic qualities to help parents in up-bringing. For instance, by integrating unpaid community service activities into the schools’ curricula, American students have acquired responsibility as their core moral value.

To conclude, it is still disputable whether who should be responsible for guiding children to become well-behaved citizens. I personally think that parents and schools are of equal importance. Children are deserved to receive instruction from both sources, as this combination will greatly benefit them.

topic: Some people think that it is fine for professional sportsmen and sportswomen to misbehave on or off the field, as long as they are playing well. Ċ Do you agree or disagree wih this statement?
essay:
It is believed that it is right for sports people to lose their temper, whether on or off the field due to their ability to play well by some people. I utterly disagree with this statement because it is unfair towards other players and may serve as a bad example for younger sportsmen or sportswomen.

Putting skilled players over the other ones, and giving them a right to behave as they want, is, obviously, unfair notion, in my viewpoint. This is because, in all sports, there are the behavioural rules which players must follow. If some skilled sportsmen or sportswomen are given such freedom in their behaviour, it is highly likely that other players of the team or individual sports feel anxious. As an outcome, this may lead many further conflicts among them or even by the side of fans, I believe. For example, because of poor behaviour of one of the sportsmen from Austria during the match in the Olympic Games in Rio (2016), Olympic committee decided to stop the participation of the whole volleyball team. I think, it is a clear sign of such an unfair situation.

Moreover, valuable male and female players of the particular sport serve as an example in the eyes of youth. Thus, I guess, their inappropriate actions during the performance or out of it have a negative impact on prospective sportsmen and sportswomen. Because, youth tend to consider such players as their idol. So, giving them such behavioural exceptions may cause losing the real value of the any game in the future and to be overseen theirs` moral rules by young players, in my view. For instance, according to the famous news provider MARCA, during the end of the 20th century far more misbehaved sports people were grown in Germany after the prior sportsmen`s behaviour.

To conclude, I strongly refute the notion of the poor behaviour of talented sports people during the matches or off-matches. This is because, it emerges unfair attitude among others together with creating an inappropriate school for young sportsmen and sportswomen.

topic: Some people who have been in prison become good citizens later, and it is often argued that these are the best people to talk to teenagers about the dangers of committing a crime. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
The number of convicts who have been released from prison and have been living peaceful lives has increased over the past couple of years. For instance, the crime rate has significantly reduced all over the world in the past few years because of more awareness brought to the hazards of wrongdoing. In my opinion, previously convicted people are the most suitable to talk to juveniles about the dangers of committing a felony which is in contrast to the popular belief that felons tend to be a negative influence on children . In this essay, my point will be discussed thoroughly.

Firstly, criminals who have been released understand the true impact of their actions and have reflected heavily on their actions. The way they narrate their stories can prove to be realistic to youngsters and can instil fear in them into behaving well by abiding by the law . An article published by the New York Times in 2018 has claimed that betterment programs provided to the inmates in jail has helped more than 87% of them to lead a better life after they have been released. In addition, Some of the lessons learnt in these programs by the convicts were taught to the adolescents by the inmates themselves and the following is said to mitigate many teenagers from committing crimes. topic: Prompt: Many museums charge for admission while others are free. Do you think the advantages of charging people for admission to museums outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
In many countries, payment of entrance fee is a requisite for admission to museums. As a history fanatic, I suppose this place is for cultural and historical education. Therefore, I believe that asking for a charge here could bring more harm than good.

Understandably, museums need financial support to be fully operational. Businesses usually acknowledge that without a sufficient fund, they would not be able to pay for the renovation, preservation of expensive artefacts or just the employees working there. It is also true that many a time visitors come in groups, they tend to make noise, which can be disruptive to others inside. Because of this, a substantial amount of available budget might be shared for security services, and admission fee might supply that sum of money.

However, this should not be prioritized over the importance that museum attaches to the society. Firstly, it could be discouraging for low-income families to pay the required fee for entrance, and their children might not have access to witnessing history at hand, which might have helped for their education. This further raises the issue related to educational inequality. Moreover, it should be realized that taxpayers money can also suffice for the operation of museums. Later on, this amount can allow businesses to afford and enhance their security services, thus render museums more attractive and pleasing to visitors.

In conclusion, I am convinced that charging for entry to museum is more detrimental than beneficial. In other words, if admission is free of charge, it could somehow bridge the educational disparity. Even though museums might be cut off from a source of financial assistance, they can ask for funding from taxpayers and therefore, use it wisely to attract more visitors.

topic: Tests and examinations are a central feature of school systems in many countries. Do you think the educational benefits of testing outweigh any disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer, and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
There has been always an ongoing discussion between academics about accepting grading systems as an evaluation of students' work in schools. Both those who are in favor of these systems and the ones who oppose to this matter have pointed out pros and cons of testing students, which each one would be further described in following.

It is widely believed that checking student on their performance leads to more persuasion. Indeed, in populated societies, due to competitive situation of academic and business opportunities, it is the grading system that plays a vital role in selecting people for a job, which actually it is the only possible way. For instance, student with excellent history in mathematics would be probably the most suited candidate for an accountant position or a math teacher.

Nowadays, it has been proved that test and examination put a great deal of pressure on students. Students always claim that answering a variety of questions in an allotted time decrease their performance, while they would do the test much better in a less anxious situation, like taking the test at home. The supporters of this opinion often bring out the fact that the increase in number of teenager smokers is one of the tests' side-effect, and subsequently putting it among the threats to the health of individuals.

To put things together, governments should come up with new methods to check the achievements of student, in which it lessen disadvantages of previously developed ones and idealize the selection criteria for jobs opportunities.

topic: All education and healthcare should be funded by the government and free for everyone. To what extend do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Education and healthcare are the basic needs for every human beings. Some people believe that the government should spend more money to deliver unpaid education and healthcare for its inhabitants. On the other hand, I would argue that the government also has to focus on its public infrastructures.

Several people say that the government should give subsidy for citizens to meet their education and healthcare. This is because education is a basic provision for bright future, additionally, healthcare is a human right. To exemplify, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia gives free of charge for its citizens' education and healthcare. The Kingdom believes that great future of country starts from its quality of education and how healthy the populations. As a result, The Kingdom can take advantage from this, such as utilizing its natural resources by itself. There is no doubt that extending free education and healthcare deliver benefit for the country.

However, there is another field that the government should spend money. The government has to pay attention to the public facilities. The reason is that good infrastructure will be followed by great result of people's working. Take an example from Singapore, the government has built sophisticated facilities to the citizens, such as public transportation. As a result, the inhabitants are encouraged to work and this has risen economic level of the country. There is evidence that the government not only fund for education and healthcare, but also for public facilities.

In conclusion, it has proved that the government also should pay attention to the infrastructures for increasing the quality of country and its populations. I would say that I disagree if the government gives free of charge on education and healthcare for the citizens.

topic: Television has had a significant influence on the culture of many societies. To what extent would you say that television has positively or negatively affected the cultural development of your society?
essay:
Television has affected people's cultures in different countries. There are mixed views of this positively or negatively influence on cultures. Someone has positive idea about this effect and others have opposite idea.

Television can extend rich country cultures and custom. As wealthy countries have high level of economy and people's satisfaction, the big motivation exists to follow the cultures of these countries. So, television can help to extend some specific cultures in developed countries. Also, rich countries spend a lot of money on advertisement. High level of technology with luxuries equipments in modern countries encourage different people to follow these country cultures. For example, European tries to sell their products. So, by showing how much the routine house chores can be easy, people of poor countries can be affected by this products and follow this advertisement.

On the other hand, television should have wide range of programs to handle its financial support. The manger of television companies should provide programs for different culture and custom. If they want to have vast majority of audience, variety programs based on culture, custom, and religious should be paid attention. People not only get used to follow their cultures, but also do not like change them specially in the elderly age. So, different people can link with their own culture and keep it, which even is related to poor countries.

In conclusion, television can develop some developed country cultures and show the high level lifestyle of these countries. Therefore, people are motivated to follow these cultures. But, the television should provide different programs based on varieties cultures to have different audiences. By providing different programs, they have high level of grantee to be survived.

topic: Supermarkets should only sell food produced from within their own country rather than imports from overseas. Ċ What are your opinions on this?
essay:
Presently, supermarkets sell both local and imported foods and other products. It is argued by some that these shops should just sell products that are made in their own local areas and should not be selling foreign country foods. However, I both agree and disagree with this statement as super shops need to keep both imported and local-made foods to let the buyers choose.

Firstly, I agree with this because, while there are foods available from other countries, people tend to purchase those rather than purchasing country-made foods. In other words, almost everyone has the mentality of purchasing imported foods as they have many misconceptions about national production. Secondly, the population of the country are deprived of fresh foods as they buy imported foods more than their own. Furthermore, foreign foods use a lot of preservations to prevent those from deforming which have detrimental effects on human bodies.

On the other hand, I disagree with this issue because, if supermarkets keep the foreign products in the shops, people from all sectors will be able to avail their necessary foods very easily which would be impossible without the importation of foreign meals. Many foods can not be made in local areas for which one has to be dependent on these shops for buying those items. For example, although many fruits such as dragonfruit, orange, apple, strawberry etc. are not cultivated in Bangladesh, a large number of population of these countries purchase these from super shops. Moreover, by importing these food items the country helps it's inhabitants to know the food cultures of other countries which aids to gather knowledge about the outer world.

To conclude, it is helpful for the local beings to be able to have foreign foods available in their own motherland and taste the foods of other cultures. Therefore, local markets should sell foods that are imported from other countries around the world.

topic: Economic progress is often used to measure a country's success. However, some people believe that other factors are more important. What other factors should also be considered when measuring a country's success? Do you think one factor is more important than others?
essay:
It is certain that a country's success is built up by several factors. Some people believe that economic quality is a ruler which measures a country's development. However, the opposite opinions argue other elements play more essential roles in the success of a nation. From my point of view, education and healthcare service are also decisive factors which form a country's thriving.

First of all, no one can deny the importance of education. This is the reason why education always comes high in the priority of many countries in the world. To achieve a high quality of education, the government has to concentrate on investing the infrastructure as well as the quality of teaching and learning. These investments require a number of money and effort from the authority and citizens. This accounted for education is one of the vital issue to evaluate a country's advance.

Another crucial component to measure the growth of a country is health care. It is agreed that a country which owns the great economic and social potential is able to construct a stable and modern health care service. In some developing countries, especially poor ones, people are not approached the basic health care because the national budget is unable to pay for the cost of these service. It leads the number of countries such as Afghanistan, Pakistan always face the healthcare crisis.

In conclusion, the success of a country is appraised in not only the economic progress but also the education quality and health care. These factors are equal in measuring the growth of a nation. Therefore, it is advisable for the government to pay more attention to these elements for the promotion of a country.

topic: Advances in science and technology and other areas of society in the last 100 years have transformed the way we live as postponing the day we die. There is no better time to be alive than now. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
A commonly held belief is that 21’st century is the best possible time to live in, due to the fast pace of technological development. However, there is an opposing opinion that people in the past were happier.In this essay, I am going to elaborate on the topic and give reasons why I am content for living in this era.

To begin with, science and technology have contributed in so many ways to our lifestyle. Even though some people may consider modern devices, such as smartphones, tablets,etc. extremely addictive, there are numerous approaches in which we can help people around us by using them. For instance, a recent breakthrough in the medical sphere was done. Surgery through the 5-G network was performed with the assistance of robotic arms. This demonstrates one of the many applications of electronics and machinery. Apparently, those innovations couldn’t be possible a century ago.

Secondly, not only technologies have been developed throughout this period. Science and other areas have immensely improved. In those 100 years, people have learned a lot from constant research and theories in various scientific fields. For example, not long ago the first photo of a black hole was taken. This is an invaluable knowledge, which helps many scientists,and in particular physicists, in understanding the universe. As a result, they can find out more information about the galaxies as well as, eventually, solve mysteries no one, even the greatest geniuses, haven't.

To conclude, I firmly believe that this is the era of the greatest breakthroughs in all scientific and technological areas. The revolution of technologies and improvement of physics is one of the many benefits a person can notice in the 21’st century, which is what makes it unique.

topic: Wild animals have no place in the 21st century, so protecting them is a waste of resources. Ċ What is your opinion on this? To what extent to you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is believed that wild animals should not exist in today's world and it is pointless to spend money to protect them. I completely disagree with the view, and this essay will explain the reasons why the idea is totally absurd.

Firstly, the Earth has never been the living place for only human, and there is nothing particularly special about this century that people suddenly have the right to rule out the existence of other species. Moreover, there is no compelling reason why wild creatures should die out to make room for human civilization, as both mankind and other living organisms can share the environment and pursue symbiotic collaboration, the same as how it has happened throughout history. All in all, I believe that it should be our aim, and human should start to reconsider the damage we have caused to the wildlife's habitat, while they do nothing so significant to harm us.

Secondly, I also think that it is unwise to state that preserving the wildlife is not worth the expense. Biodiversity is one of the crucial elements to maintain the balance of the natural habitat, which directly links to human survival. For example, scientists have proven that the presence of other species, along with men, form the food cycle in which one is dependent on another as a food source. In other words, if we let other species die out, we could face the danger of having limited dietary supply, yet with today's technology, it is irreversible to bring the animals back from extinction. Therefore, in my opinion, it is better to spend money now, although the cost is exorbitant than not and later regret it.

In conclusion, we have no right to decide whether or not wild animals should exist, and I believe that we should do everything we can to protect them. It is not only a moral act but as well a way to protect our own living circumstance.

Earth has never been solely humanity’s domain, and there is no valid reason to drive wild species to extinction for the sake of human expansion. Humans have long coexisted symbiotically with other organisms, and preserving wildlife is both a moral and practical imperative. Wildlife poses little threat to humans, while biodiversity is crucial for ecological balance and human survival. Species interdependence in the food cycle means extinction could reduce food availability, and current technology cannot reverse such losses. Protecting wildlife now is a necessary investment to avoid irreversible consequences in the future.

topic: International tourism has brought enormous benefit to many places. At the same time, there is concern about the impact on local inhabitants and the environment.
essay:
It is undeniable that foreign travel is a growing industry these days and thus international tourism has brought many benefits to local places. However, various negative matters stem from this too. There are disadvantages and advantages on both sides which we will discuss here.

On the one hand, possibly one of the main negative majors is the increase in travel worldwide affects not only the natives but also the surroundings. For example, the more tourists in one place, the more populated in that area. It might not seem a massive issue but unfortunately, it is the locals who suffer the most. This is because ,in order to provide proper facilities to visitors, the residents get less basic needs of water and food. Furthermore, with the rise of population, the likelihood of public places being filled up with trash.

On the other hand, it helps in creating different employment opportunities for a wide range of people, for instance, hotel staff, tour guides, crafty shops and so on. For example, more travellers consequently result in an increase in the purchase of local art and goods which leads to a huge inflow of money. And the income from tourism supports the country’s financial needs which can be used to invest in infrastructure. In addition, the promotion of the local traditions and culture increase as the visitors take photos and post them on social media.

In conclusion, there are no doubt that foreign travelling gives a variety of positive benefits despite its many disadvantages .It can also seem that the number of advantages associated with tourism easily outweighs the other.

topic: Question : Do you agree that money is the only motivation at work why people prefer working in the same company for many years ?
essay:
People work in the same corporation for many years just for getting a money. I do not agree with this statement because feeling of comfort about the job environment and the probability to be the expertise in the company are the most reasons for this trend.

It is often said that people keep working in the same corporation because of comfortable feeling to working atmosphere. This means environment in the workplace would support them in dealing with their job. For example, I personally experience of having friend working in the same company for ages. A proper guidance from the boss and caring friends in workplace makes him did so. Therefore, it is true that being convenient is the reason why people are loyal in the same workplace.

In addition, workers getting higher position is another factor which should be taken into account. This means when a worker stay longer in one company, a probability to be an expert is huge. A study conducted in University of York in 2008 as an example revealed that 75% of employees staying for ages in the same organization have a willing to be an expert. It is true that chance to be the expertise in the company is getting higher as they have been many experience.

In conclusion, the comfortable feeling of working atmosphere become the other reason for employee to keep in the same corporation for many years. Moreover, a huge opportunity to be expertise also the reason from the worker. It is makes people not only think about the salary.

topic: Research indicates that the characteristics we are born with have much more influence on our personality and development than any experiences we may have in our life.  Which do you consider to be the major influence?
essay:
This might be the question everyone would ask himself at least once in his lifetime: "Could all my achievements be considered as the result of my built-in characteristics or me, myself, have learnt from the experiences and chosen my way?"

Obviously there is an assortment of traits that the human's child is born with; some personal factors that could act as a guiding light when reacting to the different situations that he or she might deal with. Therefore our characteristics are the main sources of our unconscious behavior in childhood. On the other hand is the environment in which we are growing up, that is significantly influenced by our parents' attitude to the life. They can treat the child leading him to strengthen his positive characteristics and weaken the negative ones or vice versa. Therefore the main structure of our personality, based on which most of our decisions would be made in future, is constructed before adulthood during a subliminal process.

Furthermore, one essential factor of the human's maturity is learning from the experiences. Most of us would happen to deal with some people who was not so talented but succeeded due to hard working and learning from his failures. While the degree to which people take their experiments into account could differ from one to another.

From my point of view, the power of personal characteristics could not be disregarded, knowing the fact that even the extent to which we learn from the experiences depends on our personal factors and the way we think. I believe that most of our developments or failures are the results of personal traits led us to whether learn from our past experiments or not.

topic: global warming is one of the biggest threats humans face in the 21st century, and sea levels are continuing to rise at alarming rates. what problems are associated with this and what are some possible solutions.
essay:
Nowadays, global warming has become a controversial topic in modern society. It is ordinarily believed that the ocean surface is continuously rising at an alarming rate. This essay will discuss the potential problems of global warming and conjure several solutions.

It is undeniable that climate change has caused severe repercussions to humanity and wildlife. It is effortlessly observable that the loss of habitats and rising sea level is emerging as a major threat. For example, in 2018, over 300,000 square meters of glaciers have vanished, which was the territory of over 1,000 polar bears. Thus, polar fauna is on the verge of being entirely annihilated owing to gradually diminishing habitable areas. Apart from it, climate change can lead to soil salinity, which poses significant adversities to the locals. To cite an instance, it is predicted that in 2100, Ca Mau and several other cities in the vicinity of the ocean would experience drastic soil salinity, which would make mentioned area unable to be utilized for agricultural purposes. Hence, the foreseeable famine is not a fictional vision anymore.

Regarding to the problems caused by global warming, it is wise to conjure several possible solutions. First action to resolve this issue is for the government to enact a law forcing industrial firms to purify exhausted fume before releasing into the atmosphere. This would decrease the annual carbon footprint, which is the main factor contributing to global warming. Secondly, authorities are able to fund scientific research to procrastinate or potentially nullify the detrimental effect of the rising ocean surface.

In conclusion, humanity and wildlife are experiencing the repercussions caused by climate change and global warming, from habitat loss to extinction and famine. However, these effects are reversible if proper actions are applied.

topic: Question: more and more young people go oversea for further studies. Some people think it is a positive development while others think it brings negative effects. Discuss both sides and give your own opinion.
essay:
Nowadays, studying oversea has become a topic of frequent discussion among the whole society. Some people think that going abroad for education brings many benefits, while others hold different views. This essay will review the pros and cons of oversea study.

Enhancing language ability is the primary benefit for youngster to study oversea. This is mainly because they have to apply foreign language on their daily life such as during university and shopping. For example, university study in oversea often contains group assignment and presentation. After three years continuously practice foreign language, oversea student will surely improve their communication skills and writing skills. Apart from the language advantage, studying oversea also provides a better opportunity for future employment. Those oversea returnees have received advanced education in developed countries, which means they have better understanding deal with foreign events. In this case, they are both welcomed by local and international companies.

However, going oversea study alone can also be seen as a challenge. Being alone in an unfamiliar country sometimes can give rise to sense of loneliness. Without friends and family being around, those oversea students could feel helpless when they meet challenge from livelihood and academic performance. Consequently, they may start to lost interest in pursuing their oversea study. In addition, studying in most developed countries have certain financial burden on an ordinary family. If youngsters are not fully prepared and have not a clear plan about their future, the needs of advanced knowledge and valuable experience will not be achieved. In that case, they have waste their parents money and they are no different with those who study in their own countries.

To conclude, although oversea studying seems very attractive in terms of enhancing language and supporting future career, it is only true for those individuals who have a clear purpose about their trip. Otherwise it is only a waste of money and time.

topic: Some people think that because children find subjects such as mathematics and philosophy difficult, they ought to be optional instead of compulsory. Ċ To what extent do you agree?
essay:
Although some people claim subjects like mathematics and philosophy should be optional to children due to their difficulty, they are essential and necessary to build a well-development adult full of knowledge and with perspectives to follow a career. With these thoughts, I completely disagree with the idea in which they ought to be optional. This essay will discuss why these themes should be practised by children and I will explain in detail my conception about this idea.

While mathematic is a science which studies numbers and how they are related to other topics, philosophy is a science responsible for the study of general and fundamental questions related to human existence some individuals claim these topics could be not compulsory owing to the difficulty to learn them. In this case, schools could promote classes more dynamic and realistic to children learn with more facility which can lead to studies closer to the reality, resulting in more facility to be learned. For example, if kids have difficulty understanding conceptions and applications about determined topics, they tend to not have an interest in learning more about them and this process can interfere in other subjects and other parts of life. The more challenging and difficult a subject, the more interactive should be teaching.

On the flip side, both themes can contribute not only to the growth of people but also to the comprehension of current issues in the world. Because of these reasons they should be learned at schools in a compulsory way and not been just optional. For instance, nowadays with the advance of globalization in a fast-paced world, people are increasingly busy all the time if they had knowledge about these sciences they could manage much better their downtime and private questions to produce beneficial results. In addition, independent of the field of knowledge, it always can be useful and applicable in a determined moment. Therefore I totally agree both sciences should not optional at schools.

In conclusion, mathematics and philosophy make part of life, and thus they must not be excluded from the educational process and I completely concur they should be compulsory instead of optional. This essay argued why these subjects should be practised by kids and I explained my point of view.

topic: Some people think that politicians have the greatest influence on the world. Other people,however, believe that scientists have the greatest influence. Discuss both of views and give your opinion.
essay:
Who is the most enormous impact people around the world? Some people state that politicians have the most significant role in the world; others believe that scientists play key role in the world. My view is that they are both vital in the world.

People who regard politicians as the greatest influence in the world take many factors into consideration. First of all, it is obvious that politicians develop the policy that one country do business with other country. This means that GDP of a country will improve, which leads to country depending on export and import of international trade. For example, Jinping Xi, premier China, signs trade contract with Australia in 2014. This behavior probably brings 1 billion dollar to China each year.

However, others hold different attitudes towards this issue. They believe that scientists have the greatest impact on the world. First and foremost, scientists introduce advanced technology which result in boosting people's living standards and helping people to discover more secret about this world. For instance, the robot that can explore dangerous places where people can not enter, such as firing house, black hole and deep sea and so on.

Personally, I agree that they both have a serious effect on the world. In terms of peace of world, politicians make great contributions to the world. Because they often go to other counties to sign some policies which cross countries and cultures to communicate, or become allies. From anther degree, scientists are overcoming global crisis, such as greenhouse that is made of discharging more carbon dioxide by transports. So scientists also make a great contribution to the world.

To sum up, my opinion is that we have hard time thinking which on is greater, they both have essential effects on the world. Politicians focus on peace and economy of world while scientists concentrate on up-to-date technology and climate of global crisis.

topic: Many people spend a lot of money on clothes, haircuts, and beauty products to enhance their appearance. Some people think that it is a good way to spend money, while others think that there is a better way to spend it. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is argued whether spending personal budget on gaining a good appearance through clothing, hairstyles and cosmetic products is beneficial or people should allocate their money in other better ways. Although expenditure on enhancing one’s physical attractiveness is worth it, I am still more convinced that it would be better if people channel their financial budget into other useful purposes.

On the one hand, some people advocate the view that it is necessary for everyone to spend money on fashion, haircuts and beauty products since having an attractive look can give people more confidence and good chances in their life. In fact, people nowadays are living in a world full of judgements and prejudices, so those with a beautiful or handsome face and a personal style of clothes and haircuts can easily leave good impressions on others. This can be exemplified by an interview that one’s outside appearance can be one of the most impressive things with recruiters. Besides, with good preparation in terms of outfits and look, candidates can express themselves in a confident and unique way, which brings them a higher possibility of being employed.

On the other hand, I hold a firm belief that people had better allocate their money for other purposes on account of several reasons. First of all, I strongly believe that when people put too much emphasis on enhancing their appearance, they are likely to be more materialistic. To be more specific, they can be obsessed and pressured by trying to appear with the perfect look. As a result, they can become fashion slaves and make impulsive purchases on clothes or cosmetics products. Instead, they can use their money for self-development through registering for a new skill course or going travelling to other countries, for example. By doing so, they can expand their knowledge, gain hands-on experiences and have great opportunities to enjoy their life, which seems to be a good value for money.

In conclusion, I cannot deny the importance of investing money in improving people’s appearance, yet I still strongly support the view that there are better ways for people to spend their budget and gain more significant benefits in terms of self-improvement.

topic: Demand for gas and oil is increasing and so finding new sources in remote and untouched areas is a necessity . Do the advantage of this is outweigh the disadvantages
essay:
Globally, there is an upward trend in the use of advanced technological equipment and machines that require hydrocarbon compounds to function. However, this has led to the search for other substitutes for these products due to an increase in requests for both crude oil and natural gases. This essay will discuss the reason why the merit outweighs the demerits.

To begin with, finding new sources for carbon-containing substances in new areas are essential in order to meet up global demands. The major advantage of this process is that it will help to generate more revenue in order to boost economies. For instance, recently some African countries were able to detect fossils in new locations. However, the new development provided job opportunities and increased their gross domestic product. And as such this was able to close the gap between demand and supply.

On the other hand, one of the major drawbacks was that most of the workers are exposed to hazards from the site which could either be from the tools they use or environmental factors. For example, recently in Nigeria, a few people were attacked by bandits during exploration meanwhile others sustained injuries from the tools they used. In addition, the soil will be prone to a lot of destruction during this time because of the large drillers used on the land. Conversely, if nothing is found plenty sums of money will be required to fix up the place to prevent drought as well as flooding.

In conclusion, funds can be gotten from fuel production. Although there are negative impacts, in the long,run the benefits still outweigh the influence on the environment. Finally, in my ,opinion I think it is necessary to look for newer sources of petroleum.

topic: Some people say that modern technology has made shopping today easier, while others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion
essay:
Whether or not technological advancement is likely to bring about benefits among shopping is an issue of interest. Some believe that they receive convenient shopping when this development was introduced, whereas others argue that they tend to obtain disadvantages by it. This essay points out the rationales behind the two contrasting viewpoints and reaches my own conclusion.

On the one hand, the emergence of online shopping tends to lead people to be easier accessible through goods, which they fancy to be owned. This is due to the fact that it is not necessary to go out and waste a lot of time in order to pick up and purchase some daily appliances since they can be ordered via an online shop store. For example, products can be shopped by scrolling on their screen, selecting into basket via apps and then, waiting for them to be delivered to their home. As a consequence, it makes life far more convenient by this development.

Moreover, some appliances such as electrical devices need to be tried out before the decision to buy is made.

In conclusion, although it is undeniable that online shopping introduces advantageous life, In-store shopping is used to be assured that the products purchased are worth the money. Therefore, the statement provided is only partially agreed upon.

topic: Nowadays men’s sports are given far more attention by society compared to women’s sports. What are the reasons for that? Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?
essay:
In recent times, female sporting activities have garnered more lesser attention than that of their male counterparts. The main reason is that, male sport is generally promoted more than females, because they earn more money and they have been around for a longer period. However, in my opinion, this is a negative development because it does not reflect gender equality.

To start with, male sports generally get more attention because men sporting activities earn more money than the opposite gender. As a result, they are advertised much more than female sport. Moreover, men sport has the advantage of a significant head start over that of women, therefore men sport has been in the public eye for a longer period. For instance, male soccer has been played publicly for more than 50 years before female started participating; in fact, the first female world cup was held not long ago in 1996. Subsequently, not many people were surprised when male football out earned women's soccer by 5.9 billion.

Furthermore, in my view, this is an occurrence to be proud of because it shows our society still has the problem of gender discrimination. This is due to the long history of systemic restriction (such as females not being allowed to participate in various activities, no freedom of movement and association) place on women. Consequently, this action has an adverse effect on female competitiveness, making them feel as if they are not up to men. For example, 80% of female athletes that stop participating in sports points to the feeling of being inferior as the reason they dropped out.

In conclusion, the major reason for male dominance in sports is the fact that it started earlier than female sports, as well as the higher level of promotion due to the fact that men bring significantly more revenue than the opposite sex. In my opinion, this is a negative development, because it shows we still have the serious problems of gender discrimination.

topic: In today's job market it is far more important to have practical skills than theoretical knowledge. In the future, job applications may not need any formal qualifications. Ċ To what extent, do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In today's world, competition in the field of study and jobs has increased tremendously. In order to get better ,jobs people need skills. Some people think that practical knowledge is more necessary than theoretical knowledge. I, somewhat, agree with this notion because if you don't have practical experience of a job you will not be able to successfully do it.

Although, theoretical knowledge is equally important in day to day life because it clears your basic fundamental of the job. Until you don't have the theoretical knowledge of the things you are doing, you won't be able to do the practical. There is much application where if we don't have theoretical knowledge you most likely to fail in the practical, for instance, if we don't know about the Bernoulli theorem, the practical application of this theorem in machine learning will be useless.

On the other hand, there are things we can learn even if we don't have written knowledge. For example, if anyone wants to learn how to drive a car, they don't need theoretical knowledge. They can learn to drive a car by just practising. Moreover, the companies are willing to take the risk for the applicants who have enough experience in doing things. The industry now does not hire by looking at someone's education qualification. But they hire people if they have enough skills and practical exposure. In addition to this, the software company ask you to provide the Github link , where the candidate posts their programming code.

In conclusion, nowadays practical knowledge is more important than theoretical knowledge. Because people with more practical experience have a better chance to excel in their careers.

topic: Large businesses have big budgets for marketing and promotion and as a result, people gravitate towards buying their products. What problem does this cause? What could be done to encourage people to buy local products?
essay:
Thanks to globalisation, big corporations have entered the local markets and try to attract customers through marketing, thus cause a major problem for small or local businesses. This essay discusses the major problems caused by this including the disappearance of local businesses gradually and the monopoly of big companies. Besides, the essay also suggests appropriate solutions to address this issue and motivate people to buy local product.

This issue causes several main problems in terms of social. Firstly, the entering of big enterprises in market threats to the existence of small businesses. A large amount of labours might lose their jobs and become social burden. For example, many supermarkets are opened in local areas and have strong marketing policies. Thus, people tend to buy products in supermarkets rather than local markets where supply local business's products and numerous factories will be threatened to be closed, as a consequence. Secondly, with huge budgets, big companies can buy several local stores and create a monopoly in the market. Customers, therefore, would have to pay more money for products. The living standard would be expensive and local resident cannot afford it.

There are some solutions which address this issue. The first resolution is that the local businessmen should improve the quality of their products to attract customers. Product quality is essential to ensure that their customers will return. In addition, individuals should play their part in making sure that they encourage local brands. For instance, rather than buying a big company's product, they should give local products a try and review them on social networks. Rating and reviews play a major role in improving the sales of a product.

In conclusion, many problems can be caused by the entering and marketing product of large companies to the development of local companies. Both local companies and local residents should take practical solutions to solve that problem.

topic: Smoking is a major cause of serious illness and death throughout the world today. In the interest of public health, governments should ban cigarettes and other tobacco products. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Recently, banning tobacco products has become a controversial issue around the world. Some people argue that these products and cigarettes should be prohibited because they are the main reason for the modern global health crisis. I agree with this argument; in this essay, I will discuss my point of view thoroughly.

The increase in tobacco consumers leads to an increase in the individual and social financial burden. Purchasing these drug products represents a financial burden on the individual and national income. Since individuals spend much money on cigarettes, for instance, they suffer to fulfil their domestic and social needs. That is why many tobacco consumers represent a burden on their governments. Smokers seek financial aid for their domestic needs and health issues, which result from smoking. Governments, therefore, should seek to ban cigarettes and legislate a law that punishes smokers by paying more taxes than other citizens.

Moreover, smoking leads to the destruction of public health. The medical treatment that smokers require is often expensive. According to the WHO, smoking is the paramount cause of diseases such as lung cancer and heart fatal diseases. These diseases need a remarkable amount of money and medical services to be cured. Consequently, with the spread of these diseases among citizens, there will be a lack of productivity and medical support for common non-smokers, who deserve governmental medical treatment. Thus, laws should prohibit smoking and exclude smokers from receiving public medical services for free.

In conclusion, in my opinion, smoking should be banned around the world and especially in developing countries. If countries succeed in legislating laws to ban this source of fatal illnesses, they will achieve high productive aims and be able to develop socially, financially and medically.

topic: The world has seen an enormous increase in flights for leisure, business and commercial purposes around the world over recent years. What do you think are the main advantages and disadvantages of such flight? Do you think flights should be taxed more?
essay:
In today's world, the flight has been being more important for any purposes such as leisure, business and commercial matters. However, there are the benefits and the drawbacks of such flights which I will discuss in this essay.

As we know that air transportation is the fastest one of any vehicles in the world. This benefit lead people prefer to use flight service for their travel, particularly for long distance. Besides the factor of efficient of time, people will not get too exhausted due to long travel. Take for instance of people who travel long distance by car, tram or bus. They will spend much time in the road, therefore they get more exhausted and lead to get stress owing to traffic jam.

On the other hand, using flight generates more pollution because the fuel needed by air plane is much more as opposed to other vehicles. This case will urge environmental problem such as global warming. Moreover, using flight more often as well could lead negative effect for human health. Furthermore, travelling by air plane has high risk for accident, in which the impact of accident itself could be more dangerous rather than the accident of road or water transportation. Hence, people should be aware of choosing flight service that they will use.

To sum up, people should be astute choosing what kind of transportation that they will use. Using flight undoubtedly is faster and more efficient. However, it has high risk upon which people should pay attention. For this case, in my personal point of view the flight service should not be taxed more, because it is one of the state assets to conduct economic matter.

topic: The Global Problem of Obesity. Obesity is now a major global epidemic. What can be done to tackle this increasingly common problem? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
In today's world, our lives have become very sedentary, in the homes and even at our work places. This is why obesity has become very rampant. Easily available fast foods is a huge factor as well as our total dependency on technology such that we can do our jobs, communicate with our loved ones and shop online in the comfort of our homes. This also means that there is a minimal amount of physical activities carried out daily. Healthy eating and more exercises will go a long way in curbing this serious issue.

Foods that contain abundance of fat are incredibly addictive. Substituting them for healthy meals feel like punishments initially but health enthusiasts say that abs are made in the kitchen, that is, foods consumed make up to 80% of what is needed to lose weight. Weight loss is difficult to achieve but taking it step by step will aid in combating obesity. Making deliberate efforts to take a walk every hour will help sedentary workers stay active all day. For example, the Fitbit app alerts users to take a break to walk 250 steps every hour.

Parents can help their children by ensuring that they play outside instead of being on computers, playing video games or watching television all day. Meanwhile, Government should understand that this epidemic is growing out of proportion and thus heavily tax fast food chains and help farmers produce fresh fruits and vegetables.

In conclusion, our sedentary lifestyles and readily availability of fast foods have greatly increased the risk of obesity, however, making bold choices to choose healthy foods and increase in physical activities will help to combat being overweight. Additionally, government giving concessions to farmers will help in ensuring that fruits and vegetables are available to all.

topic: Information technology is changing many aspects of our lives and now dominates our home, leisure and work activities. Ċ To what extent do the benefits of information technology outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Humans lifestyles are being changed by the blessings of Information technology and at present time people's homes, free time and work activities are ruled by it too. I personally believe that the benefits of the inventions of the World Wide Web outweigh the drawbacks because although too many dependencies on technologies might make a person's life sedentary, it makes the business and communications at the tip of a finger.

Smartphones, computers and different applications are putting individuals at risk of obesity. Nowadays citizens hardly go outside because they are busy playing computer games, watching Netflix, Youtube, chatting with friends on messenger. For example, in the past, shopping centres used to have lot more consumers than the present and most of the stores say that clients order them online. Therefore, these habits put individuals at the risk of being overweight and becoming attracted to diseases like diabetes, high blood pressure and heart diseases. However, this trend can easily be broken by the public. They just need to find a suitable time for physical activities and eat a balanced diet.

World Wide Web and the internet made the planet earth too small and communications become easy. Online shopping, making a business deal, having a video conference are possible by a tap on the device screen. As a result of these productivities of every aspect have improved a lot compared to the non-information technology era as well as in the future Artificial Intelligence technology will help to do daily chores. For instance, before the 1990s citizens used to send telegram messages and write letters to their long-distance living relatives and wait for another fortnight for the reply and now hotels in Japan are using Robots as receptionists. Hence, it is a blessing to have such devices for better communication and living.

In conclusion, while smartphones and electronic devices might make a person obese if that person does not do any workout and eat unhealthily, it brings business, life and lifestyle in the pocket. Thus, I am convinced that the positives of information systems exceed the negatives.

topic: Individuals can do nothing to improve the environment, only governments and large companies can make a difference to what extent do you agree or disagree.
essay:
It is widely believed that protecting the environment is beyond the capability of an individual citizen, and only huge corporations and government are able to make effective improvement on this issue. I strongly agree with this point of view, as I believe that these organisations can contribute to positive change while raising the awareness of local residents on saving our natural world.

First of all, the Government has a legal authority to impose environmental conservation law by regulating the human actions which are detrimental to our habitat. For example, in my country, the Government has been implemented the policy on banning plastic bags usage at the major local market in order to reduce the amount of this stuff on landfills. In addition, many companies are turning to manufacture environmentally friendly product releasing to market. It is undeniable that these actions can have significant changes in our habitat.

Furthermore, these organisations are influencers on triggering a consciousness of protecting the natural world on individual citizens. This is because they fund protecting environmental projects while taking advantage of social media to spread the information about global warming, climate change so that local people would have a better understanding of this matter and working together as a community. For instance, Unicef organisation has appointed the famous people to be an environmental ambassador in many countries with the purpose of propagating and working with local people to enhance our ecosystem.

In conclusion, authority or corporation can protect the world by imposing strict measurements and spreading the knowledge of environmental problem for communities. However, in my opinion, to get a better result, the responsibility of protecting the environment should be the duty of everyone, not only put the pressure on the Government.

topic: Some people think that governments should give financial support to creative artists such as painters and musicians. Others believe that creative artists should be funded by alternative sources. Discuss both views and give your own opinion
essay:
Arts enrich our lives and society. Artists create their own thought that has a significant impact on the way of life. Their creativity is appreciated and helpful for the nations. But people have different view that whether authority supports their fundings or they will go for alternative sources. I believe both government and other sources should be funded.

Governments do need to look at creative artists. Because any genuine artist aims to make some arts better for his native land. In art project a huge money needs to create, financial support is vital for them otherwise, it is impossible for them to build a new project. They require government's assistance and help. There are many works in public the place for example, in my country, sculptures and statues are erected in the centre of cross-roads. These symbolize our liberation war. So it is easy for us to practice our cultural activities. They serve to protect our culture and heritage and we are proud about them.

In addition, people express their view that financial assistance should be generated by alternative sources. The reason is likely to be that the governments spend money on public services such as general treatment, education and fabrics. These public facilities are fundamental for a country to function properly. Provision to creative artist is a waste of money. Another reason is, some artists create arts as a passion and profession. Their arts are neither rich nor famous but they continue to produce arts as a passion.

Finally, arts affect everywhere of our natural movement however, I believe apart from the flipside government funding is to be ensured to create arts.

essay:
In some countries, many more people don't encourage teenagers to work without paying in their free time. topic: Some people say that music is good way of bringing people of different cultures and ages together. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Music undoubtedly plays an indispensable role in people's lives. Some individuals attest that music is an ideal way to connect with people from various backgrounds and ages. I strongly agree with this viewpoint, and this essay will shed light on my opinion.

To begin with, every person listens to music regardless of their nationality, and since a variety of cultures are often interpreted through songs, the public will get to know more about other countries' customs. Especially in this era of globalization, music brings people in touch with diverse cultural backgrounds. For instance, more music from less-known countries has become renowned in recent years owing to the world being globalized. Moreover, artists in well-known music industry such as America are fostered to co-operate with overseas singers, which indeed popularizes their cultures to the worldwide audience.

Furthermore, music has a massive capacity to erase the generation gap between youngsters and elderly. It is prevalent to see a number of songs mixed with classical and modern instruments which suit both the youth and senior's music taste. Moreover, these artworks tend to mention every matter of life in order to attract viewers from all ages. Nowadays, there are tons of albums that are well-rounded in featuring not only political but also entertaining sides. For example, fans of ''This is America'' come from different ages because the song serves seniors with political plots and adolescents for its catchy tune and melody.

In conclusion, music is of paramount importance in having people from different groups of ethnicity and ages get along with each other due to its popularity and appropriate content. Therefore, I firmly believe that music should be promoted in every social platform.

topic: Inventors are not as important to society as doctors. Ċ To what extent do you agree with this statement? Ċ Provide reasons for your answer. Include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Invention and medical care play a crucial role in society. It is thought that the role that inventors play is not as significant as that of doctors. I entirely disagree with this view and think that they are equally important in society.

Firstly, the quality of medical care performed by doctors is largely dependent on inventions. Medical professionals utilise a variety of medical devices to provide quality care, which would not be possible if it were not for inventors' work. It is obvious, therefore, that inventors and doctors are both essential in maintaining public health. A good example is MRI, which was originally invented in a space exploration project by NASA but is making a significant contribution in the medical field, helping doctors to conduct accurate medical examinations.

Furthermore, inventions have made our lives safer in other aspects of society. Some might argue that doctors are more valuable as they directly save people's lives. Inventors, however, have equally improved citizen's safety and health. Inventions have resulted in improved infrastructure, such as roads and transport, which enabled individuals to have easier access to safer places and health-enhancing services. For this reason, inventors have a positive effect in saving individuals' lives just as doctors. In Japan, for instance, the invention of seismic isolation devices in buildings has considerably increased people's chances of survival during earthquakes.

In conclusion, I strongly disagree with the idea that the significance of doctors outweighs that of inventors from technological and safety perspectives. It is crucial that they work closely in order to create a more thriving society.

<AC8>Furthermore, inventions have made our lives safer in other aspects of society</AC8>. <AC9>Some might argue that doctors are more valuable as they directly save people's lives</AC9>. <AC10>Inventors, however, have equally improved citizen's safety and health</AC10>. <AC11>Inventions have resulted in improved infrastructure, such as roads and transport</AC11>, <AC12>which enabled individuals to have easier access to safer places and health-enhancing services</AC12>. <AC13>For this reason, inventors have a positive effect in saving individuals' lives just as doctors</AC13>. <AC14>In Japan, for instance, the invention of seismic isolation devices in buildings has considerably increased people's chances of survival during earthquakes</AC14>.

topic: The increase in mobile phone use in recent years has transformed the way we live, communicate and do business. Mobile phones can also be the cause of social or medical problems. Ċ What forms do these problems take? Do you think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages of mobile phones?
essay:
In the current century, the invention of cell phones has changed the way of life that a person used to live before in all aspects, including from maintaining the relations to dealing with trades. A growing number of people postulate that overuse of this kind of technology can lead to disastrous effect on mental and social health. Notwithstanding, this discourse delves into the both viewpoints, and subsequently, will explore, whereas the booms off-set the pitfalls, accordingly.

Admittedly, it is mandatory to need mobiles in daily lives to handle all business related problems since the occupations are not only limited to the national borders which force a society to practice modern facilities. The rationale behind this justification might be the shortage of time to finish the tasks dealt with international companies. Moreover, people do not find enough time to meet their kiths and kins in this contemporary world; hence, it is indeed to use mobiles to keep in touch. On top of that, using mobiles is beneficial to solve numerous problems created among youths while in college or workplace. To exemplify, a survey published in the New York Times has reported that 80% of the population depending on the usage of mobile phones.

However, taking a look from the flip side, could overuse of cell phone contributes to issues of psychiatric and socialization conditions, be absolutely right? Certainly, it follows that the relations of today's are more materialistic, which demand the use of social applications where people can be contacted by anybody without being loyal towards his/her partner. As a result of this, one can have more chances to get depression and a feeling of social isolation among teenagers which drive them to attempt suicide or other unfortunate occurrences. Put differently, the trend of having updated technological mobile in youngsters is nothing but just an attraction towards entertainment aspects of the relationships that either make them mature enough or mental for situations.

To conclude, having explored both slants, I reiterate that having a phone is an effective way of efficient communication and to communicate surrounding as well as far distant persons; nonetheless overuse of negative feature can definitely drive a society to specific illness. Thus, it is obvious that trump supersede the gloomy aspect.

topic: Many people think that it is better to get advice from old rather than young people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Receiving suggestions from elders instead of youngsters is considered to be the best option to tackle troubles which have opined by many individuals. I somehow agreed with this notion which I articulate in the next paragraphs.

To commence with, Recommendation from elder persons proves to be very beneficial. The necessary knowledge or experience they acquired in their lifetime will be rendered to the juniors for mitigating issues, as a result,seniors educate junior one's to be accurate in their learning skills which mean necessary traditional abilities could easily be shared with anyone to solve someone problems. For example, it is seen that many decisions have been made in a family by the instructions and guidance of the most elder person who has great knowledge or experience which ensures accuracy and efficiency.Therefore,seeking guidance from old one's will be the effective method while making decisions by further conserving time, money and efforts.

On the contrary, In the dynamic and modern world, it is very essential to show flexibility or develop a habit to change according to circumstances which may only possible by the new ideas and opinions which could be delivered by the new generation as elders thought or perception may be stubborn and obstinate which create several problems. For instance, in a recent study by the research department demonstrates that adults or young generation possess aptitudes or abilities to generate innovative ideas and to show ingenuity which will be indispensable in the large companies or organisations. Thus, to avoid superstitions, there will be a need to prosper new ways of thinking to solve matters related to financial or personal.

In conclusion, solving personal matters in a family require the suggestions of some old age pupils. Although, for professional decisions, the requirement of creative thinking must be embraced to accept changes in the modern era which could deliver by the young populace.

topic: Question : Some people say that in the modern world it is very difficult for people to have a healthy lifestyle. Others, however, say that it is easy for people to be healthy and fit if they want to be. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
These days, many people do not have a lot of times to work out in a gym or to do sport. It is very hard for them to have healthy lifestyle. However, some of them still can stay healthy although do not have enough times to do it. I believe that there are many ways to keep people's health and it depends on the people itself.

Right now, many people who have jobs which need much times to be finished so that they do not have time to exercise. They spend most of their times in the workplace and comes home late. In the morning, they need to go out for working and in the weekend they will use it to take some rests.

Although they use most of their time to work, they still can have a healthy way of life. By cycling to the workplace means that they are exercising. People also can do exercise in the workplace. For instance, they can do push up or sit up while work or they can use stairs despite the lift.

It does not matter if only little exercising like walking, running, or cycling at least they not sit in the same place for a long time. This way also help them to have better lifestyle. Unhealthy way of life can be a disaster in the future. They can suffer from many diseases after 10 to 20 years later. It is better for them to change their lifestyle.

In conclusion, do not have enough times can not be the reason for people to have bad way of life. They should do exercise each day or at least 2-3 times a week to stay healthy.
