topic: Some say that because many people are living much longer, the age at which people retire from work should be raised considerably. To what extent do you agree or disagree.
essay:
It is argued that the age when the elderly out of their performance should be extended due to citizens’ lifetime are much longer than ancient. While some individuals consider that nowadays living much longer is to each person has enough time for completing the private life schedule. I strongly agree with the first idea and shed some light on information to prove my opinion in this essay.

Firstly, the crucial reason that adults should continue to work in the current retired term stems from the fact they are experts in their jobs. For example, the common doctors were specially studied over a 10-year period before they worked in the hospital. If they retire at their 60s life, they will only contribute to society in around 30 years old. At this time, their talent what serves patients is bloomed, their experiences are useful for the young generations; so, it is a pity if they suspend their jobs to complete personal plans such as travelling around the world or taking care their grandchildren.

Secondly, when the elderly take part in the labour force, they can earn money to pay for their living cost like accommodation fee, medical care charges, etc. Thus, they are enough independent to not get government’s welfare. For instance, a healthy 65- year old man is working as a teacher, he doesn’t want to quite of job because his retirement age is coming. Alternatively, he can be willing to reject the organization’s offer that requires him to retire to effort and be paid salary every month. In addition, he can sponsor a scholarship for his grandchild’s education.

In conclusion, experiences and independence in personal finance are caused my support for the former issue. Although global citizens’ lifetimes are gradually lengthened, each individual should work as long as possible.

topic: Some people say that advertising encourages us to buy things we don’t really need. Others say that advertisements tell us about new products that may improve our lives. Ċ Which viewpoint do you agree with?
essay:
There is no doubt that advertising plays a prominent role in today's world. We see adverts on television, online, SMS and streets. While some people believe it provokes them to buy more, others argue that it is a better approach to market the customers. I would agree with the former opinion.

To begin with, there are certain reasons why people embrace advertises. Everyone is busy with their schedule and have less time to research on naive products which are available in the market. As many of them often listen to the radio or read a newspaper as part of their daily routine it's easy to catch the new items released without an extra effort. For instance, my neighbour bought a food processor which she heard about the byproduct on 98.1 FM channel while we are going on a trip. Furthermore, it also helps the manufacturers to enhance their products depending on the sales.

However, there are several grounds to say adverts motivate us to buy random and unnecessary things. First and foremost, adverts are very colourful in grabbing customers attention and it's human tendency to get captivated to something new irrespective of necessity. To illustrate, I had plans to buy iPhone and I was checking on cellphones but recent promotions on iPad and pencil had a huge influence on me and ultimately I ended up buying them instead of buying a phone which was imperative. In addition to that, kids are allured by the animations involved in promotions or some character in that play and forces parents to buy things which are expensive and out of their budget.

In conclusion, advertising in part of our everyday lives, despite the information we obtain by seeing flyers and promotions it promotes people to buy overpriced, unhealthy, unnecessary items.

topic: Some experts believe that it is better for children to begin learning a foreign language at primary school rather than secondary school. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge and experience.
essay:
Nowadays, you can find every parents looking forward to plan teaching a foreign language for their children at early ages. Some research has revealed that the earlier age for learning the second language the better ability performing like a native. Although I agree that primary school can make children a better new language learner than secondary school, there are some important points for considering.

Undoubtedly, the younger children are to learn a foreign language the more successful they will be, since the brain in very early ages is fresher and more competence to absorb new information clearly. If children in early stages begin to learn a new language, they will be more intelligent and more qualified to recruitment in international jobs.

Meanwhile all advantages above, parents should attention to their children's speaking ability which has not shaped completely yet at primary school. Some children even have problem to deal with their mother tongue, so handling with a new one may cause extra pressure on them. Moreover, which foreign language will be more applicable and attractive for the children who themselves have not have recognition ability to choose, is a difficult and vague condition for decision making.

In conclusion, although start learning a second language at primary school could be good and evil, I largely believe that its benefits can cover other fuzzy sides. In my opinion, parents should begin to teach a new language for their children as soon as possible without considering the type or application of that, because of expanding the ability of their children's brain, memory and intelligence. Simultaneously, they should be aware of their children's capabilities, too.

topic: some people think that parents shoud think children how to be good members of society. Others, however, beieve that school is the place to learn this. Discuss both these views and give your opinion.
essay:
It is said that kids should learn diverse skills from the parents that how to live in the society as well as how to make good relationship with different people in the surroundings. But many people consider about an institution can provide social skills to young ones. I believe that both are responsible for the children's behaviour regarding being good residents, and I will discuss both views in the upcoming paragraphs.

To begin with, it is argued that parents are the primary source to aware today's generation about the society. In another word, the old generation should teach their kids how to be cooperative with others, and how to work in a team to create a good environment in their surroundings, which assist them to succeed in the future. For example, this has been proven by India's political leader Dhoni that growing up in an educated family is an imperative part of a modern generation. In addition, his parents taught him social skills then he entered the political party with the help of the community who supported him by voting, as he has proven good civilian by doing influencing activities, this is because his family taught him how to behave with others and help the society to create a peaceful environment. topic: TOPIC:  HISTORY Some people think studying from the past offer no benefits to today's life, while others believe that history is valuable source of information for us. Discuss both view and give our opinion.
essay:
History is always a controversial subject for the practical application to modern life. When some people reject learning from the past, fortunately the others still believe that history can teach them precious lessons.

One the one hand, I understand why many opponents of the study of history assume it has nothing to gain from doing research that what happened in the past. In their mind, Historical knowledges are rarely used in society, so we should concentrate on science or technology that can bring relevant values to the present and future. Furthermore, History, in common parlance, is the record of past events based on different facts and perspectives, it is too difficult to guarantee of the accuracy of information obtained. Therefore, if there were new discoveries about history, it would cause tremendous upheavals for human culture.

On the other side, people who overcome conventional thinking still suppose history plays an important role in the development of mankind. It helps people have thorough insights into not only their own but also other countries 's culture and evolvement. Especially The youth need to know how their ancestors defended the nation against intruders throughout many dynasties and maintain an independent and sovereign country as currently. This would develop their patriotism and desire for peace, at the same time help young generation to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

Finally, in my opinion, History is always an essential subject should be respected because of the values that it brings. However, the teaching of History needs to close to beneficial events in order to use in reality.

topic: Many students find it difficult to concentrate or pay attention at school. What are the reasons? What could be done to solve this problem?
essay:
It is true that there have been more students having difficulty staying focused in school in recent years. This issue stems from a number of causes from which several effects will be outlined in this essay.

There are two primary reasons for why unfocused students have become commonplace. The main problem is electronic devices consumption inside classes. This is because of notifications from applications , students get distracted to check the phone for text messages and even play games when they feel bored in class. As a result, the grade of students using phones during class is lower than those who do not. Similarly, the outdated and rigid teaching method is considered a main culprit. The fact that students often learn in a one-way teaching environment causing boredom and losing attention in the class.

Some feasible solutions can be implemented to remedy this pressing issue. Firstly, teachers should be active in class. For instance, teachers can walk around the classroom while teaching, thus students will have less opportunity to use their phone or allow students to use educational learning applications. Another measure worth mentioning is that schools should apply different teaching methods to the student's curriculum. As an example, since the internet is full of high quality material related to the courses, students can do a research paper on the lesson through the internet and with the help of the teachers.

In conclusion, cell phone consumption and old teaching methods are two main reasons for why many students pay less attention to their lessons at school, however, this problem can be solved by changing the way in teaching.

topic: In many countries, schools have severe problems with student behaviour. What do you think are the causes of this? What solutions can you suggest?
essay:
Over time, student's behaviour in schools has become big issue in several parts of the world. It can be caused due to the situation surrounding students themselves like parents and daily habit. Furthermore, there are some solutions which will discuss in this essay.

There are various reasons why a student's behaviour becomes worse at school. Initially, the parents do not pay attention to their children. They are busy with their occupation, so they do not have much time to control and oversee their children. Eventually, these days, mostly the children are influenced by the internet and television. They tend to play game online or watch television all day rather than open their schoolbook. So, they do not have time to study and become lazy students. As a result, they will be indolent to study in school and do not listen their teacher's explanation, until cheat each other in examinations.

On the other hand, I believe that there are some solutions to tackle these problems which parents and teachers can do. Firstly, the parents are the main actor who play important role to overcome these issues. They should spend more time at home than at work and give more attention to their children. Lastly, the teachers should perform a specific approach, and give a particular attention in the school. It is expected that the teachers can understand the student's feeling, so the students will listen their teachers' advice. Therefore, the teachers can handle their pupils easily.

To sum up, pupils have serious problems with their behaviour at school because of the influence of their environment. Moreover, I would argue that there are some solutions to change student's behaviour to be better at school or at home.

topic: Some people say that music is a good way of bringing people of different cultures and ages together. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion.
essay:
The majority of people think that the melody plays a vital role in our modern world, which can reduce the gap of culture and generation. In my opinion, I totally agree with this point of view for many reasons and will discuss below with the subsequent examples.

On the one hand, music is likely to broaden people’s horizon to welcome various cultures all over the world. It is needless to say that each country has their own tradition that performs their culture and norms. Melodies can minimize this cultural disparity and become a good method to help individuals to have a better cooperation with other people. Moreover, we must admit that local accent in many regions is the biggest challenge in communication. However, with melodies, this obstacle can be lessened. For example, in an International music festival, which was held in Hue, provide citizens all around the world with opportunities to access nation’s culture and have a deeper understanding about it.

On the other hand, it is argued by some that there is no boundary of age when it comes to music, which gives an everlasting connection between the adolescents and the older. Music is a common ground, considered a popular pastime for almost all ages. This is also a magical psychological therapy for medical treatment. In the other words, we can say that songs and its rhythm can heal the pain and gather many people who have the same symptoms to take part in the treatment process. For instance, patients who have a trouble with their mental health and have a headache from time to time, are encouraged to enjoy meditation music classes to keep their soul balance. Most people can practice this solution and it does not require any specific ages.

In conclusion, I strongly advocate the notion that, Music has an ability to soothe the souls. When people hear it, they become ecstatic and relax.Thus, we cannot deny the importance of music in our lives and its ability to glue people from a multitude of cultural sectors and ages.

topic: Some people believe that it is good to share as much information as possible in scientific research, business and the academic world. Others believe that some information is too important or too valuable to be shared freely. Ċ State your own opinion in about 300 words. Give illustrations and examples
essay:
A number of people advocate the widespread dissemination of information in scientific studies, enterprises and academia. Others, however, claim the contrary, stating that data is so invaluable and worthwhile that it cannot be shared publicly. From my perspective, I voice approval of the former, in that I believe the act of making knowledge known to humanity would do wonders for global development in the long term.

In the first place, it is undeniable that the core value of knowledge lies in its practicality and utility, rather than the financial potentials of its owner. In other words, information proves its worth by the extent to which it could contribute to humankind, to which it would benefit people, which are also the reason why books are published. Therefore, it would be irrational if ideas are kept secret, which could risk becoming nothing but valueless. For instance, most great inventors and scientists in the past era passed down their wisdom and understanding to their predecessors through their research results, thus revolutionizing the world. Had it not been for their handing down precious knowledge, we humans would not be able to make such accomplishments as we do today.

What is more, in a world against plagiarism, information should not be feared to be imitated as grey matter's illegal steal would be harshly condemned and deprecated. This means ideas could be spread open as long as their possessors are given credit. In reality, copyright law is being strictly regulated than ever in several fields, ensuring the profits of the proprietors. For example, on Youtube, should content creators happen to use someone's brainchildren without his or her permission, they are highly likely to be banned from producing any further videos if being reported. Not only Youtube but other social networking sites are endeavouring to crack down on plagiarism.

All things considered, it would do more good than harm to disseminate information to the public for the sake of humankind's development, as unofficial reproduction would be penalized. Hence, I am supportive of the former statement, believing that knowledge is defined by its applicability.

topic: In the future, nobody will buy printed newspapers or books because they will be able to read everything they want online without paying. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
It is argued that in the coming days, no one will purchase hardcopy books or newspapers since they will have access to the softcopy materials for free. Personally, I strongly believe print materials can not be pushed out of existence as they offer a more reliable method. In this essay, I will tackle this issue and give a conclusion.

First of all,the current advancements in technology seem to have brought with it some good in this regard in that e-books and newspapers are easy to access and more durable. In other words, unlike the hardcopy materials that can easily get torn or may only be available at a distant library, the soft copies from the internet are only a click away from accessing in the comfort of a home. Take, for example, if an individual wished to read a foreign newspaper or book, rather than opt for a hardcopy that can not be readily available, one would find it easy to get a softcopy. Nonetheless, electronic books or newspapers possess a major setback in that if the device a person uses to access them gets damaged, then all information would be lost. The opposite is true with hardcopy materials.

On the other hand, printed books and newspapers offer a plus point in that they can be accessed without any reliance on an external device. To put this in perspective, there is no need to own a mobile phone or computer in order to read books because it will always be handy. For instance, in a survey conducted on the benefits of using printed copies as opposed to ebooks, it was determined that hardcopies last longer since they can be used without dependence on technology. This in itself is the primary reason printed copies will always remain in the system.

By way of conclusion, I reaffirm my initial stance that hardcopy newspapers and books offer a more reliable method of reading as compared to ebooks which often times depends on the use of a device. Therefore, in as much as a person has a choice to make on which media to use, the fact of the matter is that print media is better than soft copies.

topic: The world has seen an enormous increase in flights for leisure, business and commercial purposes around the world over recent years. What do you think are the main advantages and disadvantages of such flights? Do you think flights should be taxed more?
essay:
Sky traffic becomes more crowded today. It is happens due to many people are tended to use public flight transportation for wide range of purposes, such as business and holiday. In my opinion, even though flight would abolish the existence of land and marine conveyance, airplane is the most efficient transport in the world. More detail explanation will discuss in below.

Every airport becomes busier in this day and age, since the airfare gets cheaper. This condition has a detrimental effect on other types of public transport, such as busses for land or ships for nautical transportation. Recent research conducted by local government in Indonesia reveals that the percentages of marine passenger dropped by 13% in 2012. Land and marine transportation will be abandoned if the government not takes initiative to deal with the issue. As such, impose more tax to the aviation industry.

On the other hand, it cannot be avoidable that flight is the most efficient way to travel. It only take a few hour for reach thousands kilometers. For instance, the journey from Indonesia to Saudi Arabia which is take 9 hours in flights and its costing around $820, it has slight different prices with a large ferry, but when we consider about time, this is will not be longer discussed. Moreover, thanks to the government which gives a low tax and the competitive market among airways companies, this condition leads a cheap ticket prices for the passenger.

The aforementioned evidence reveals that the benefits of flights outweigh the drawback. In this circumstance, I agree if the government increase the tax for aviation industry. Where possible the authorities collaborate with the private parties to calculate taxes, in purpose to have a win-win solution.

Although some individuals believe sports have an essential importance in the community, others claim they are played just like leisure time. Sport, which can be not only a professional but also an amateur activity, can promote excellent benefits and I agree with the assumption where it plays a pivotal role in society. This essay will discuss both sides and I will explain my opinion in detail.

On the one hand, some individuals believe in the practice them only for spending time without importance. These people do not appreciate sports as a job in which can result in a profession for youngsters, contributing to their welfare and also for the economy of the country. For instance, these people understand them only with a funny activity and without specific rules. For this reason, they are seen as leisure and not an ability can be trained, resulting in profits.

But on the other hand, the habit of physical activities can both help with discipline and also with improvements in the health of individuals. Thus, exercises should be considered incredibly essential in society once the advantages are innumerous. In addition, the practice of exercises in a professional way helps to ameliorate the economy of the city whereas it influences and lures people to do the exercise, investing in pieces of equipment and specific sites to practice. For example, a race winner living in a small city can sway using a specific brand of sneakers and also raising money for the city. For these reasons, I agree with physical activities have a substantial impact on society.

In conclusion, physical activities can result in numerous positive points and more than simple leisure, they should be realized as a profession. This essay argued about both sides and I could explain in detail my point of view.

topic: Some people claim that not enough of the waste from home is recycled. They say that the only way to increase recycling if for government to make it a legal requirement. To what extent do you think laws are needed to make people recycle more of their waste?
essay:
A large proportion of waste from households is not recycled, and some people suggest that it is necessary to enforce laws to deal with this problem. This is a viable solution, but I do not think it is a good option.

If recycling litterß is legally required, people will possibly do it; otherwise, they can be punished. With the force of the laws, those who do not sort the misuse may be asked to do some community work or even pay the fine for their illegal activities. For example, people may make a reduction of their life quality as a consequence of paying a legal fine. Therefore, in order to maintain their common life, they may pay more attention to sorting waste in their daily life, and it can be seen as a good result of the legal requirement.

Nevertheless, the government may play an even more important role in educating to increase the proportion of recycling waste. Despite the legal power that would enforce people to obey the instructions, it may affect the regular lifestyle of citizens. However, with the increased investment in education and advertising, the population may realise that unsorted unused materials may make a big impact on the environment. As an example, children would realise the importance of recycling rubbish in their future life. Furthermore, environmental issues may affect their life in the unknown future. As a result, citizens will discover that it is necessary to recycle the rubbish to protect themselves and the next generation.

In conclusion, it is obvious that legal requirements may have related effort in recycling waste from home, but the effort of government, such as educating and promoting, is considered important to deal with this issue.

topic: Some people think that newspapers are the best way to get news. However, others believe that they can get news better through other media platforms. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In the modern technological earth, some people think that media platforms are the best sources for reading news and articles. In the mean time a few others believe that conventional newspapers are the eminent sources, when it comes to news reading. In my opinion, using technological sources is the best way to get to know the information happening around us.

Firstly, newspapers cannot cover all the topics that are being held around the world. Moreover, we are nor aware of the current sensations. For instance, when we analyse an average, ordinary newspaper, it only covers the general topics around the globe like Economics, Politics, Health, and Science. Therefore, the availability of different information is limited to an extent.

Secondly, the e-sources cover a wide range of subjects all around the world. In addition to that we are notified with the current happenings and situations taking place in different parts of the world. For example, if there is a sudden earthquake or any kind of natural disaster happening around the globe can be seen with evidence through e-sources via modern innovation techniques. Hence, it leads to a faster operation, and mitigates the time requirement for the news to arrive.

In conclusion, due to the abundance of various online platforms, people need not to rely only on newspapers anymore. Furthermore, they are not limited upon the contents, and also it eliminates the inconvenience caused while carrying newspapers where ever they go. Lastly, it doesn't depend upon the circumstances and conditions for operation.

topic: Topic Some think that the main benefit of international cooperation is in the protection of the environment, while others think that the main benefit is in the world business. Discuss both view and give your opinion
essay:
When it comes to the advantages brought by cooperation in international circumstances. People hold divergent views. Some allege that the primary value is in environmental conservation; others contend that world business is the chief beneficiary. In this essay, I am going to explore these two sides first before presenting my personal understanding.

Obviously, collaboration among countries is conducive to set up an unified organization which can implement relevant policies and enact environmental protection laws to tackle with environmental problems. Common sense tells us that environment issues --- global warming, holes in Ozone layer and water contamination---are not confined to one particular country or region, which means countries are expected to join hands together such as enforcing laws of prohibition on cutting trees and waste disposal to alleviate the aforementioned problems from a global scale. Therefore, in this respect, international cooperation brings benefits to dealing with environment problems.

However, in no circumstance, could business interest be neglected. A case in this point is Gac-Toyota, which is a Sino-Japan joint venture car manufacturer, augmenting its productivity and cutting down the production cost by cooperating with others---successfully utilizing the china's low price labor and Japan's cutting-edge technology. Hence, it is argued that cross-country cooperate brings profits in economic domain.

On the whole, it is subjective to say that the main benefit is environment conservation or world business, since the both benefit enormously from collaboration in global scale. To my way of think, it is well-advice to boost international cooperation, considering the win-win situation formed by it.

topic: In manny countries,the proportion of older people is increasing.Could this have a negative or positive impact on society?
essay:
Recent studies show that the number of old aged people compared to youth, have been increasing across many nations. Many are of the opinion that it is beneficial to the society while others think that a surge in the proportion of old age people is a setback for the growth of the society. This essay will discuss both pros and cons of having a larger amount of elders in society.

To begin with, a section of people thinks that having older people helps in building a strong character of the society. In other words, young people would imbibe great values from elders and remain close to their culture. Moreover, a larger section of society would always be satisfied and content in life. As a result, the crime rate would decrease. Thus, old age people bring stability to the community.

However, there is a plethora of advantages a greater number of youth in the society facilitates. First, young people are full of ideas and prospectives. This has led to elimination of myths already existing in religions and widened the mindset of individuals. In addition, young blood is keen technology users. This helps society remain up-to-date with the technological advancements.For example, young ones easily operate computers and cell phones, whilst, old ones. Indeed, youngsters curb orthodox thinking pre-existing in cultures and help in the overall growth of the neighbourhood.

In conclusion, although elders keep individuals close to their roots, youngsters on the other hand, aid in the development process. Hence, it is clear that a right proportion of all the age groups are needed for the proper functioning of any society.

topic: Topic: The use of mobile phone is as antisocial as smoking. Smoking is banned in certain places so mobile phone should be banned like smoking. To what extent?
essay:
Some people believe that using mobile phones is equally harmful to society as smoking and it is, therefore, also expected to be banned. From my perspective, I am in complete disagreement with this opinion as now will be discussed.

Firstly, it is prejudiced that people compare the use of mobile phones equivalently antisocial as smoking. Since phone and tobacco are two distinctively different entities, which exist for different purposes, the comparison between them is unreasonable. Tobacco has long been proving to be detrimental to not only the smoker themselves but also the health of society at large. The use of mobile phones, admittedly, has some drawbacks, but it does not dangerous or threatens the life of anybody. For example, some critics might point out that the excessive use of smartphones is attributable to myopia, or the noise of cell phones might be an annoyance to the surrounding people. These problems, however, can be easily curbed by limiting the time on screen, or turning on the silent mode when in public areas.

Secondly, while it makes sense why tobacco should be prohibited for its deadly effect, phones have numerous benefits to our life. Ever since the introduction of mobile phones, it has revolutionized the way we communicate and how we live to the point that everybody needs a phone to work or study today. Most jobs require employees to be either available by phone, for example, doctors and police officers, or to use their phones throughout the day, as is common with businessmen and lawyers. Mobile phones even become more necessary in times of pandemic such as the Covid-19 when everybody is required to work and study from home.

In conclusion, I content that mobile phones, unlike tobacco, have insignificant drawbacks to our society. In contrast, its enormous benefits make the idea of banning phones sounds far-fetched.

topic: Some people think that the best way to reduce the time spent in travelling to work is to replace parks and gardens close to the city center with apartment buildings for commuters. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?
essay:
Social mobility has become a controversial topic in contemporary lifestyles. In fact, it is believed that by replacing public decorations such as parks and gardens with blocks of flats, the time spent travelling to work can be drastically decreased. Although this statement can be viable to certain individuals, I disagree that it actually benefits our communities. Analyzing the meaningless of modifying recreational features with objects having identical sizes as well as the backfires of having dense residential areas will show this.

Firstly, demolishing parks and gardens to give rooms for residential zones which have nearly the same width and length is unreasonable to improve travelling. For example, an average size of a park equals ten thousand square feet which can be compared to a general tower of apartments. Furthermore, this means the difference between spaces of these two types is insignificant regarding the purpose of moving time reductions. To sum up, such alterations cannot show any distinction in simplifying transportations in towns.

Secondly, constructing more buildings in cities' centres can trigger even more severe traffic congestions. Indeed, more housing units in cities result in a higher number of inhabitants which surely causes an increased demand for moving. Moreover, the need can go even more dramatic during rush hours when people are going to work or home. Take Tokyo in Japan as an example, vast developments in downtown areas have made the transportations dense wasting thousands of hours every day for citizens to pass those crossroads in this aforementioned period.

In conclusion, erecting public decorations in order to raise apartment buildings seems viable but in my opinion, the drawbacks overshadow the benefits. Meaningless values in compared sizes whilst the possibility of causing even more jams can be listed as reasons.

topic: Some people want government to spend money on life on other planets. However, others think it is a waste of public money when the earth already has so many problems. Discuss both views and give you own opinion.
essay:
Science and technology have grown by leaps and bounds over the past decade. Nevertheless, scientists are still finding whether life on other planets is possible or not. However, there are predominantly two contrasting views where a section of society vehemently deems that the government has to spend more money for searching existence beyond our solar system while others emphasize that management has to work on pressing issues on earth. In my opinion, there must be a limit on outer space study expense, and other problems such as poverty are also needed to address.

Apparently, various factors make a section of people advocates that outer space study must be a priority and many reasons to substantiate it. Firstly, it brings plentiful long-run benefits like due to excess use of natural resources such as water, fossil fuel are depleting and will be extinct in near future and without these resources human existence could endanger. Therefore, an alternative is needed and other planets materials could be used for smooth living on earth. In addition, the population on earth is rapidly increasing, So, sooner or later an additional spot is needed to live. For instance : Scientist has discovered that survival on the moon is possible and there will be a place to live in coming years.

On the other hand, some believe that the government has to work on improving human living standards than studying outer zone for myriads of reasons. chiefly, world is facing major concers such as scarcity of food supplies, poverty and life threatning diseases, and a remedial action is needed to taken by management. To illustrate: nowadays, coronavirus is life threatning illness and spreading by human touch. As a result, many people are passed away because of this. So, a prompt action needed to cure from this issue.

To conclude, In my opinion, while astrophysictics study is benefical for human growth and a better future but management considerable attension is also needed on extreme issues for human favourable living.

topic: The free movement of goods across national borders has long been a controversial issue. Some people argue that it is necessary for economic growth, while others claim that it damages local industries.  Discuss both views and give your own opinion. You should write at least 250 words.
essay:
Free trade across countries has long been a polemic issue. Many people believe that it is necessary for economic development. Just the same, others argue that free trade threatens local industries, both small, medium, and large industries. In this essay, I will discuss both views and state my own position.

People who support the free trade argue each country has the advantage that distinguishes the country from each other. For example, Indonesia as a maritime country has the advantage of marine products. Tuna fish, lobster, and seaweed exported to other countries that do not have a lot of marine products. The price of Indonesia's marine products become cheaper than local prices in export destination countries. This trade provides benefits for both countries.

Meantime, opponents of free trade claim that the unrestricted movement of goods and services causes damage to local industries. Free trade cause prices of imported goods become cheaper. People prefer cheap imported goods with the same quality as domestic goods. This phenomenon led to reduced demand for domestic goods and adversely affected the local industries. This condition causes the slowdown of economic growth, increased percentage of unemployment, and declining state revenues from taxes.

In conclusion, free trade has its advantages and disadvantages for the economy of the country. It may be a factor supporting economic growth. On the other hand, if it is not controlled by the regulator, then it becomes a disaster that led to the economic slowdown. Even though almost all countries have free trade, I believe that the government of each country has set up a policy to save the economy of their country.

People who support the free trade argue <AC2>each country has the advantage that distinguishes the country from each other</AC2>. For example, <AC3>Indonesia as a maritime country has the advantage of marine products</AC3>. <AC4>Tuna fish, lobster, and seaweed exported to other countries that do not have a lot of marine products</AC4>. <AC5>The price of Indonesia's marine products become cheaper than local prices in export destination countries</AC5>. <AC6>This trade provides benefits for both countries</AC6>.

Meantime, opponents of free trade claim that <AC7>the unrestricted movement of goods and services causes damage to local industries</AC7>. <AC8>Free trade cause prices of imported goods become cheaper</AC8>. <AC9>People prefer cheap imported goods with the same quality as domestic goods</AC9>. <AC10>This phenomenon led to reduced demand for domestic goods and adversely affected the local industries</AC10>. <AC11>This condition causes the slowdown of economic growth, increased percentage of unemployment, and declining state revenues from taxes</AC11>.

On the other hand, <AC14>if it is not controlled by the regulator, then it becomes a disaster that led to the economic slowdown</AC14>. topic: In some countries it is now illegal to smoke in public places. It is only fair that people who wish to smoke should have to leave the building. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is now illegal to smoke in public areas in many nations since it brings dire effect not only to the smokers but also all people around them. While this is true to some extent, I would also argue that this measurement can reduce the negative effect of smoke to the building and in the health of passive smokers.

Smoke has become a major issue in some countries in which it is generally assumed that smokers should go out of the building if they want to smoke. Since public places public places are not deserve to be polluted with the smoke of cigarette. The New York Times reported in May 2015 that lighting cigarette produce harmful chemicals such as nicotine, carbon dioxide, and methanol in which damage the timber part of the building.

Apart from the previous discussion, another crucial effect of smoking in public areas is on health of others around the smokers. This is mainly because humans have a high chance to become passive smokers by inhaling the air polluted by smoke which results in serious health problem. For example, a recent study by Queen's University found that people who do not smoke who suffer from long-term exposure and second-hand smokers have a 20 to 30% higher risk of developing lung cancer.

The aforementioned evidence shows that such a law to prohibit individuals smoke in public places should be made to minimize the harmful effect to the surrounding. Where possible, giving a consequence to people who offend the law should be taken into consideration.

topic: Education as a Deterrent to Crime In many countries imprisonment is the most common solution to crimes. However some people believe that better education will be a more effective solution. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In many countries imprisonment is the most common solution to crimes. However, some people believe that the reduction of crime rate will be achieved more effectively through better education. I agree with this view.

On the one hand, crimes caused by lack of perceptive power to distinguish both right and wrong. On the other hand, people who couldn't control their emotion are easy committing a crime. Meanwhile, prison doesn't solve the problem to the every roots. It is just effective in dealing with offenders in the short-term. Murders, for instance, must be imprisoned for many years and such a punishment may act as a deterrent. They know that they will face loss of freedom, social isolation and separation from their loved ones if they carry out such criminal acts.

However, I believe that education has a better role to cope with crimes. Firstly, people should train power of discernment to gain knowledge about right and wrong. Every wrong acts have bad consequences. As a result, they are better prepared to avoid situations which may involve them in crime. Secondly, psychology education is an important step which helps people increase their awareness about self negative emotion may lead them to wrong behaviours. Lastly, in prison themselves, educational programmes must aim to provide prisoners with skills and qualifications to reintegrate community and find work when they are released.

I consider that imprison is not the best effective weapon to fight against crimes in the long-term, and I believe that providing better education is a more essential and durable solution to reduce the crime rate.

topic: In some countries, the number of people who visit art galleries is declining. What are the reasons for this?How can we solve this problem.
essay:
Art galleries are one way of showing one's art. In many countries around the world, craft galleries have become less point of interest therefore people coming in them are decreasing. In fact, it is now a serious concern in many countries. This essay will discuss, busy lifestyle and technology development as the main reasons and awareness among society at the early stage of life as the solution of this problem

There are various reasons why some nations are having this issue. One reason is a busy lifestyle. A person is so much engaged in earning a livelihood, it is hard to spend time visiting art displays. For instance, people spend most of their time at the workplace, doing overtime and meeting deadlines. Another reason is recent technology development. Though the younger generation has enough time, if anyone is interested in craft, it is available at one click on smart devices and visits virtually. For example, a person can get the enjoyment of art on their couch without extra effort. As this will affect the morale of people involved in creating creative work, it is vital to improving this situation.

The solution to this problem lies in the reason. The public might not have time when they start working, but it can be introduced to them at an earlier stage of life and create interest in artefacts. Government can make it compulsory for school and college students to attend at least one such gallery to get their certificate of education. For example, even the government is asking institutions to do this voluntarily. So, it is effective to introduce this to the young generation.

In conclusion, although the audience of the craft display places is decreasing due to lifestyle requirements and evaluation in technology, it can be solved by government involvement with early life introduction.

topic: Some people think that in order to solve traffic and transportation problems, people should be encouraged to live in cities rather than in suburbs or in the country side. Ċ To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is thought that by staying people in metropolitan areas than villages could solve the problems of transportation. I strongly disagree with this point of view that traffic problems can be solved by gathering people in one area.

Firstly, vacating the rural areas would be difficult for those people who has lived there since childhood. It is very tough to leave the home where you have lived for many years. Leaving that place just to solve the traffic problems would be an injustice to the inhabitants of suburbs. For instance, by moving the native peoples of suburbs will make them uncomfortable to absorb the urban community. Henceforth there shall be another way that could be solved for transportation problems.

Secondly, villagers are the true reflection of any nations culture and values. Almost all of the cultural aspects are still preserved in these areas. Wiping the village life might create big problems for next the generations that may not be able to understand the real theme of their own culture which might lead them to lose their original identity. For example, people who had gathered in one place by leaving their original houses of the village has put them in the dilemma of uncomfortable life. To keep on the cultural values forever, there should be more benefits for rural communities.

In conclusion, People who are living in the suburbs are very simple, original and peaceful that makes them difficult to live in a noisy place with diplomatic life. Also, they are symbolic of any nation's culture and its values.

topic: some people think that a good diet and exercise are not necessary for a health and long life. to what extent do you agree or disagree
essay:
A section of individuals believes that a balanced diet as well as exercises are not prerequisites for general well-being and living long. In my opinion, this is not true. This essay discusses the importance of having a scheduled exercise program and maintaining a daily healthy diet.

To start with, routine exercises contributes to a healthy weight. Being overweight has been attributed to many diseases and a short life span. For instance, many citizens in my country died of weight-related illnesses last year. Also, a study done in Hungary showed that lack of exercise is a high contributor to cardiovascular diseases in the 21st century. Having a regular exercise program would result in general well-being and increased life expectancy.

In addition, a balanced diet is another option we cannot avoid. It means having optimal proportions of all the essential nutrients that a body requires to function well. Consumption of food in excess results in obesity while under-consumption results in being underweight which is lethal in equal magnitude. Research done in my country revealed that diet-related illnesses contribute to half of the total deaths every year. Moreover, a study that was conducted in Uganda, a neighbouring country, showed that malnutrition is among the top 10 diseases among the under 5’s. Balancing different foods in their right proportions guarantees a healthy life.

To conclude, it is crystal clear that having frequent body mechanics besides consuming foods in their appropriate nutrient amounts is paramount to living longer as well as having good health. I highly recommend everyone to exercise 30 minutes daily and eat a balanced diet.

topic: Some people say that the main environmental problem of our time is the loss of particular species of plants and animals. Others say that there are more important environmental problems. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
Currently, environmental problem is the most critics in the world. Some people believe that the main problem cause of reducing species of plants and animals. However, some argue that there are more important environmental problems. In my view, I totally agree with the latter opinion.

Since we know every kind of creatures, especially plants and animals are the most important for the ecosystem. Unfortunately, in recent times, a large amount of wildlife, including trees has been destroyed for many reasons. Such as, natural disaster and human made. So, some people believe that this is the main cause of environmental problem because human cannot live alone without other species. In addition, everyone must eat to live, if we do not have animals, crops, and fruits, we cannot survive in this world.

Nevertheless, I disagree with the idea that mention above, I believe that there are many factors which cause the problems. Losing species are just only one of the problems. The key of environmental issues is human created the activities which are the impact of global warming. For example, using energy from electricity, using petrol for a car engine and using plastic or un-recycle packaging. Another example is people always drive cars and cut down the trees which increase carbon dioxide and directly affect the global warming situation.

In conclusion, there are many causes which affect the environment, but we have only one world. Thus, we should take care our global and concentrate on reserve natural resource for the best future life.

topic: Many young people are leaving their home in rural area to study or work in cities. What are the reasons? Do the advantages of this development outweigh its disadvantages?
essay:
In the contemporary world, a massive chunk of youth migrates from the countryside side to the metropolis every day. It is opined by many individuals that the rise of this migration is backed by countless options for employment and the availability of better facilities of education. In this essay, I will explain about what are the reasons behind his exodus and why I feel it is a beneficial trend.

To begin with, two main fundamental aspects are liable for the movement of young people towards the urban region. Firstly, there are fewer choice in selecting educational institution as well as a variety of subjects in the rural territory in every stage of schooling, such as,Remove the commaapplyIt appears that the comma after such as is unnecessary. Consider removing it.

show examples school, college, and university, whereas megapolis, is blessed with quality education and institutions. For example, professional degrees are almost absent in the country place as it is difficult to run many courses all along for a comparatively smaller population. Secondly, city dwellers enjoy better employment opportunities rather than people from remote areas. A young person cannot indulge in high-profile work, to exemplify, if there is no workplace around him. Therefore, all these benefits lead the rural inhabitants to shift to the towns.

While there are few negative impacts of this craze, the benefits are far more. First, when the youth move from small towns to the big city, they get widespread exposure to different educative courses or options. To cite an example, one can enrol in skilled learning in an urban place, as it is not available in a village. Second, there is more availability of multi-dimensional job sector in metros rather than the countryside. Even the employers are also interested in recruiting from the residents of that area; for instance, the convenience of communication and comfortability with the environment works as influencing factors for the job providers. Consequently, all these help to level up the standard of leaving and pursue the dream career of a person.

In conclusion, we can say that due to better employment and literacy facilities the young generation prefers to relocate from less developed to the developed places. It is pretty positive for them in terms of study and job opportunities.

topic: Now a days we can watch entertainment performances from screen and no need to watch it live.Do you agree or disagree
essay:

topic: Some people say that history has little or nothing to offer, while others say the study of the past helps the present. Discuss both the view and give your opinion.
essay:
Some parts of society believe in the past has not offered anything, while others' belief is, there is a lot to learn from the past, which, I completely agree with the second group of people due to the various aspect of benefits of history.

On the one hand, it is argued that history could not be useful because the information is outdated and could not be informative. For example, the way the ancient public solve their transportation problem could not use nowadays due to the development of the way that civilization tends to transport nowadays. Moreover, the technology has been developed, so, the thoughts structure of the past do not offer anything to help current society such as the ancient public use hand to wash their clothes, while these days each individual has an in-suite washing machine, however, the most important criteria is the culture has been changed. In this ,way the public could not follow the past path.

On the other hand, some communities believe the past provides lots of various information, which I totally agree with. In my point of view, everybody be able to learn from the past experiences, so, they have opportunity to reject the obstacles that previous civilization have done. For instance, people can learn from the ancient wars to figure out how peace could lead to saving a lot of life, further, they are able to track the route of civilisations that lead to devastation. At the moment they find out what is the reason for sabotage and they do not repeat it.

In conclusion, in spite of the fact that some groups of people deny the benefit of the past, I think it could provide various kinds of data that lead to enhancing the lifestyle of individuals.

topic: Some people say that modern children's games affect negatively the development of their skills compared to traditional games. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays, there is an increasing number of children depending on advanced technology and seeming to forget the traditional games. According to some people, playing new games is a good way for children to approach the technological age. But to my way of thinking, modern children's games bring a lot of side effects to the development of their skills compared to traditional games.

First and foremost, it is undeniable that the living standards are increasingly high and upgraded. However, people, especially children seem to wrap up in their own isolated world and have very little time to get together with their family members. Instead, they tend to spend a lot of time with technology. As a result, communication skills of children may be ignored by themselves as they almost have no time to interact with people arround them. Unfortunately, when children are addicted to games, they virtually do not care about what is happening. Therefore, children's emotional skill has no chance to expose and improve.

When it comes to social or group involvement, children, who play novel games everyday, seem to have no interest in it. When they depend on games to much, they may think that it is the only way to get recreation. Traditional games, however, often engage lots of player in their activities, Hence, some skills such as team-building, public speaking, etc. are required to control the games, Accordingly, children who play traditional games have already established those skills. Social skills are very essential for the development of children. If children just roll themselves up in their own world, it will bring about a lot of negative effects to children and discourage them to improve themselves.

Understanding bad effects of modern children's game, parents should take action to help children avoid it. In a nutshell, children should put aside advanced facilities and involve in many outdoor activities in order to develop skills that need for children's learning, working and social lives.

topic: in the past, lectures were the traditional method of teaching large numbers of students in a classroom. Nowadays new technology is increasingly being used to teach students. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this new approach in teaching? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own experience or knowledge.
essay:
In history ,professors and teachers used to teach lessons to many students with conventional measures. However ,these days new technology is becoming more common to teach pupils. From my point of view ,that trend could have both upsides and downsides.

Firstly ,teaching with technological gadgets could have some disadvantages that should be considered. For example ,in most developed countries all around the world where we can see high_quality education as well as advanced gadgets to teach ,pupils habitually are spending a lot of time in front of a laptop or a desktop pc to learn some subjects. Needless to say ,sitting on a chair for about 6 hours per day could create multiple problems such as obesity and hurting the body's bone. Additionally ,another conspicuous drawback is ,learning some tough subjects is impossible with common methods of teaching. Therefore ,it makes it clear why that issue has numerous negative side_effects that we can not ignore.

Secondly ,removing traditional means and replacing them with modern strategies can be useful as well as helpful. For instance ,to get some essential information ,pupils are not required to waste time in the libraries. They can get whatever they think is necessary on the internet by using technological things. Moreover ,children do not need to get up early every morning and go to educational centres. Attending all courses at home is possible because of accessing high tech appliances. As a result ,it becomes apparent there are multiple benefits behind each disadvantage that should be reflected on.

To summarise ,this is true that this issue has many drawbacks ,on the other hand, this can be a positive trend in today's modern world. It is predicted that to continue replacing out of date methods with modern things we will have a better educational system in the near future.

topic: Rich countries are getting richer while poor countries are getting poorer. What is the cause of this? What could be done to solve this problem?
essay:
There is no denying that the gap between the developed and the developing nations is increasing rapidly. This is an issue that calls for immediate action. Carefully considering the causes of this increasing gap though is crucial before contemplating on an effective solution.

First and foremost, an essential cause of the rising wealth inequalities is the poor administration policies that underdeveloped economies follow. Precisely, poor nations are being governed by politicians and leaders that do not invest in vital services like education. Education is one of the most valuable means for the development of an economy. The extremely low educational level of the citizens of those countries not only cannot help on the development of its economy, but also, in this way underdeveloped nations become objects of exploitation from the wealthy countries. People are not educated in order to flourish the country's economy and as a consequence, the affluent exploit the earth of those countries like the oil field the workforce and more, resulting in the even more development of the developed nations.

This situation could be overcome if rich countries offered substantial aid to the impoverished nations. As it is generally accepted that education is the key to improving the economy, developed economies could supply funds to build schools and pay teachers. This measure would result in expanding education and producing scientists so that the country will not have to depend on other wealthy ones. Particularly, by developing highly educated labour force sectors like construction or agriculture could be improved significantly.

To recapitulate, the increasing gap between the rich and the poor nations should not be ignored. It is clear that there is much that can be done to solve this problem, but the governments of all the world should work together.

topic: Some people think that children should begin their formal education at a very early age and should spend most of their time on school studies. Others believe that young children should spend most of their time playing. Compare these two views. Which view do you agree with? Why?
essay:
Modern world demands smart and healthy children as its future citizens. So the way we treat our kids, plays a crucial role in the future of that society. Some groups believe that children have to receive early education and must be engaged mostly in their homework, while others suggest more leisure activities for kids. In the following both of these stands are analyzed.

Advocates of early education refer to economical return of this program. To them, this group of children have more capability for adapting themselves to restricted schedules which are key factors of progress in a country. For example, consider Japan educational system which starts for three years olds. Eventually, it results in high-ranked economical states of this country; simply because of possessing more highly educated citizens who have begun school earlier.

On the opposite side, others believe that playing, especially in early years of human life, is crucial in building the personality of individuals. For example, in a football game, the better a child can have relationship with other playmates, the higher result the team gains. Moreover, neuroscientists showed that playing strengthens brain's function of children. Also, because a game is a kind of companionship, it makes kids better future team-workers. What is more, playing as a sport game leads children to be in shape and have a healthier life-style.

All in all, to me happy games are much more beneficial for young children. As a matter of fact, getting stuck to serious studies makes kids one-dimensional and somehow passive, while having more time for playing prepares them for their future real-world problems and relationships.

topic: Supermarkets should only sell food products from within their own country rather than imports from overseas. What are your opinions on this?
essay:
A commonly held belief is that food markets should sell domestic products only and stop importing from other countries. In this essay, I am going to elaborate on this topic and show why I am in favour of this statement.

To begin with, vegetables and fruits from within the country are fresher than imported once. Even though some people might argue that groceries from foreign regions have better quality, in my opinion,this statement is completely inadequate. It is better to consume foodstuff which has not been processed because of the easier transportation. For instance, groceries coming from overseas need to be packaged in order to be kept unspoiled. However, transportation can take a lot of time and this is why producers may include some preservatives since they remain the food's expiration. Consequently, the consumption of those groceries is sure to affect our health.

On the other hand, some foodstuff products are not available in certain seasons. For example, in the winter there is a shortage of various kinds of edible goods. Without imported food, the population of some countries become undernourished because it eats only what is available. Nevertheless, recently conducted research shows the best possible diet for humans is the "seasonal diet". This term means that people should eat only what the season can produce. As a result, foodstuff coming overseas is still not a great option since it is not naturally produced as well as damaging our health.

To conclude, I firmly believe that we should eat what a country provides throughout the year. Although there is an argument showing the quality of foreign goods, I still consider that domestic groceries can give us more nourishment because they are fresher and overall better for our bodies.

topic: People now have the freedom to work and live anywhere in the world due to the development of communication technology and transportation. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
The advent of technological inventions and various ways of transport have made individuals stay and perform from any corner of the world.Despite the fact that the transformation has a few pitfalls, overall, it has provided a lot of advantages.The aim of this essay is to outline both sides of the situation and elaborate on my opinion.

On one hand,in my opinion, there are two main benefits from the given context.Firstly, by using the internet , the public can communicate with each other even from a very long distance and can, in fact, share information with respect to their job tasks.That means an individual is not required to be present at the worksite to complete his amount of work.Secondly, as the air travel charges have decreased, if required ,individuals can arrive at any location just by booking a flight from their mobile phones.Thus, commuting is made very simple and convenient by the breakthroughs in transportation.For instance, when a Manger is required at a meeting even if he is working at a remote place, he can arrive at his service if he is informed just a few hours earlier.Therefore, people can easily be available even though they are not present at the office.

On the other hand, admittedly , there are some drawbacks to the given scenario.The foremost one is a lack of concentration at a job.That is the workplace environment cannot be recreated at the home and the duty minded attitude is not being seen with the crowd who perform at home.As a result, they procrastinate the work up to the deadlines.Besides this, the population is wasting a lot of money on transporting from worksite to their residence as per their need.Instead, the travel money could be saved if they stay at offices.For example, the amount they put on flight journeys can be saved for their future.Consequently ,this amount can be used when needed.

To conclude, the essay has discussed the good and the bad aspects related to the given situation. Also, in spite of some having disadvantages , the present scenario has made people 's lives happy and comfortable.Overall, I opine that the advantages have overruled the disadvantages.

topic: Some people think that cars are the best way to travel in a city, while others think that bicycle is better. Ċ Discuss both point of views and give your opinion
essay:
Cars are believed to be the best mode of city transport by a few individuals, while others consider bicycles to be a better option. This essay will discuss both views and argue why in my opinion, bicycles are more advantageous over cars.

Firstly, since cars are more convenient and time saving, they are favoured over bicycles. To explain it further, cars can be used in bad weather conditions, like rain, snow and light storm to name, but a few. For instance, while going to a meeting on a rainy day, a car can get the person to his destination, absolutely dry and without delay. Moreover, cars are faster than riding a bicycle and hence save a lot of precious time. For instance, a car can travel with an average speed of 60 km/h on city roads while this speed is difficult for an average person to achieve, riding a bike. Thus, convenience and time gain are the two keys, in favour of cars as a a city transport option.

Conversely, although cars have certain advantages over a bicycle, there are certain merits of using a cycle which cannot be ignored. To begin with, even though cars are faster to drive, they can easily get struck in a traffic jam unlike a cycle which can tackle through it. For an illustration, whereas a bike can be turned into small lanes or even picked and turned back, it is impossible with a car. In addition to that, with increasing pollution and decreasing parking spaces, cycles prove to be environmentally friendly and more convenient in crowded cities. Lastly, riding a bike has myriad positive health effects, provided that, your medical history allows using one. As a result, proving the advantages of using a cycle for travelling in cities.

To conclude, even though cars are faster and better options for certain situations, bicycles are evidently helpful in case of jams and positively affect human and environmental health, making them a better option for travelling. Therefore, in my opinion, bikes are better than cars to use in cities and everyone should try to use bicycles as much as possible and resort to the use of cars only when it becomes inevitable.

topic: Do mass media influence public opinion? Whoever controls the media also controls opinions and attitudes of the people and there is little can be done to rectify this. To what extend do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Under capitalism, most of the main medium is usually controlled by mega-corporations. However, there are some exclusions, especially when a country is in danger of existence, the media is seized by government thoroughly. In my opinion, people are easily affected by those media in terms of their thoughts and minds.

Nowadays, there are numerous medium, presented by different companies, describing their news on their understanding. Although the media should represent as the fourth estate in a country, each media has more or less its political affiliation. Hence, the audiences can choose the channel which they trust, or more accurately they prefer. Personally, I read the online news from the independent publishers, as they seem to be more neutral than the mainstream media to me. Either the main media or the independent ones, they are all sharing their ideas which their target audiences are willing to accept and absorb it.

In some particular cases, such as war, the government would ban the freedom of speech and publish. Back to the '70s in Taiwan, there were only 3 news channels broadcasted over the entire country due to the unstable political situation. The news contents were limited and restricted, moreover, those favored the government. Needless to say, the opinions were solely and monotonous. Taking my parents as an example, those notions, conveyed by the government at that time, are still wired deeply in their brains.

In conclusion, the influence of media is massive that almost no one can stay unaffected from it.

topic: Rich countries often give money to poorer countries, but it does not solve poverty. Therefore, developed countries should give other types of help to the poor countries rather than financial aid.To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
There is currently a large wealth disparity between countries in the world. In order to aid poor nations, their wealthy counterparts provide them with financial help but the problem of poverty there remains. There is a belief that some other ways of support should to be offered instead. This essay will expand on why I mostly agree with this idea in detail.

First and foremost, it is a morally right thing to help those in need. Provided that financial support does not work, developed nations have a moral obligation to support their less fortunate counterparts in other ways. Indeed, if someone notices a person lying on the street, a good and moral reaction would be to find a way to help that person not just give money and hope for the best. I think the same works at a larger scale with nations and while it is not easy to help a whole country but it is morally right to do so.

Besides, it is in the interest of rich countries to end poverty, particularly in adjacent countries, for their own safety. Unfortunately, poverty goes along with high crime rates, and many criminals from impoverished areas may sneak to a wealthier state to find luck. If rich countries find a way to lift their neighbors out of poverty, the threat of imported crime will decrease. This way, for instance, was chosen by the core states of the European Union as they implemented strategies to bring their newly accepted countries from Eastern Europe to a higher level.

In conclusion, developed nations should aid poor ones as it is morally right, and it is safer to have a well-off neighbor than a poor one. Therefore, I predominantly agree that if this cannot be achieved with financial suport, other soulutions need to be found.

topic: Theme: Advertising is all around us: it is an unavoidable part of everyone's life. Some people say that advertising is a positive part of our lives while others say it is negative. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. you should write at least 250 words.
essay:
Nowadays, everyone can see advertisements everywhere. Some people think that is has a positive effect in our lives whereas others believe its drawbacks outweigh. from my experience, I think that advertisements have made our life more comfortable, despite few negative aspects.

First of all, advertising inform people with new products and their price, quality and the way how to find them, on TV or on radio. Even in the Internet it is possible to search for new products following side advertisements. People do not need any more for instance, shopping around a lot of markets looking for just a small thing with wasting many hours. Secondly, many businessmen can earn big amount of money, because nowadays marketing based on advertisement. If there is no any advertising, the world economy wouldn't rise as fast as now. Finally, advertising companies may give job opportunities for unemployment society who are sitting at home and doing nothing.

On the other hand, sometimes advertisements motivate people for some products which they do not need especially women. They will run to purchase these advertised products such as cosmetics, clothes, jewelries and so forth. Therefore, alcoholic product advertisements stimulate young generation to drink or eat them which are causing teenager addictions. Lastly, some people buy good advertised medical products without doctor's permission which have a lot of side effects to human body.

In conclusion, despite some drawbacks of advertising, there are many advantages side of it which is changing our lives to positive side. I personally believe that advertisement has farther outweighed benefits than its negatives.

topic: These days, more and more people are going to another countries for significant periods of time , either to find job or to study. There are clearly benefits to doing this, but people who live abroad can also face some difficulties.
essay:
Concurrently, taking a year out to live and study abroad is being popular among young adults. For many, it's a chance of new scenery and unforgettable life changing experience. Whereas, it consists of benefits and downsides of moving abroad. In this essay, I'll draw some reasons why the number of people who go abroad has increased dramatically and examples of drawbacks of it.

To initiate, one of the most advantages of living abroad is that people have a chance to mix with new friends from different culture backgrounds and learn how to cope with various unexpected life pressures. In addition, the new life exchanging experience enables to broaden your horizon that you start think differently in your society. Moreover, studying and living abroad provides your job prospects with high guarantee career because of effective international education.

On the other hand there are some disadvantages of abroad life that you can't receive any support from your friends and family because of dilemmas such as culture shock or homesickness. Furthermore, it's difficult to start afresh from scratch that people can't immerse to alien life condition for instance climate and native folk habits. To be more specific, oversea people differ from each other because of lifestyle and climate ,hence it leads to feel more solitary . Moreover, language barrier is another major issue for all people who come from abroad, so most of students find it difficult to mix with regional language .

All things considered, the popularity of moving abroad is increasing significantly among young people because of effective study and good quality of life attractive ones. Whereas, there is some downside of broad life period because of isolation and language barrier. In my of view ,the positive side of moving abroad outcome the negative ones.
