topic: Task 2: In the past, most people lived in small villages where everyone knew everyone else. Nowadays, most people live in large cities where they only know a few people in their area. Ċ What do you think were the advantages and disadvantages of living in a small community?
essay:
Nowadays, people to live in big cities in which people have less friends. However, everyone knew more each other when they lived in small villages. This essay will suggest that excellent facilities is the biggest advantage of living in large cities and primary disadvantage is that the relationship of the inhabitants are not close. In my opinion, living in the countryside has the pros and cons.

I believe there were several benefits of lifestyle villages. Firstly, little villages made people to become closer than together. Additionally, when anyone had difficulty, they would receive a great deal of support from their friendly neighbours. Secondly, expenditure of urban lifestyle is higher than little villages. People have to spend money paying a lot of things, such as electric, water. For example, people could produce food when they live in the city; nevertheless, this could not perform cities because of crowded people and high buildings.

I think a few disadvantages when people live countryside. The first, the villages do not have adequate modern facilities as big cities; thus, people could have to face some movement problems. To illustrate, people want to come hospital or school, they would go distant roads. Finally, people would not have many opportunities to develop their career in the future. Demonstrably, large cities in which help people to look for employment easier. For instance, young people tend to live modern cities because this place is attracted by economic growing.

In conclusion, rural lifestyle has some advantages, such as neighbours would form strong bonds of friendship with each other; moreover, people would save money if they made food. However, facilities are not excellent, and less opportunities to people find jobs. In my opinion, I believe that people live in small villages have more benefits than drawbacks when they live in the big cities.

topic: Some people work for the same organisation all their working life. Others think that it is better to work for different organisations. Ċ Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
essay:
A set of public stick to a single office throughout their careers ,whereas, others believe that it is beneficial to switch to various companies while working.I am more inclined towards the latter view.This essay would outline both arguments and explain the reasons for my opinion.

To begin with, there are certain advantages if an individual does not leave a company.First thing is that by doing so ,over the years he becomes a trustworthy candidate and as a result , gets promoted to a higher position in that organization.Besides this, another reason for people sticking to the same corporation is because of the working style.For example, some persons give a lot of importance to their family and cannot work on weekends. Hence, if a company agree to this condition, they get satisfied and do not leave it under any circumstances.

Alternatively, few individuals do not like to be settled at a similar workplace.The reasons are as follows.One of the main intentions behind this opinion is to explore different job cultures.Therefore, these folks step into a lot of offices in their careers.Additionally, people's interest in various technologies may also make them look for better organizations .For instance, if a person learns a new trending language and if his workplace does not support it but he wants to get a hands-on , it is obvious that he goes to a new workplace.As I a technical person, I do switch industries based on my requirement.All the above-mentioned explanations make me support this view.

To conclude, a set of people do not like to switch their offices,whereas, others are willing to transfer to another one if required.Both these views produce valid arguments.However, I am more inclined towards the latter view due to the reasons explained above.

topic: "Failure is proof that the desire was not strong enough" To what extent do you agree or disagree? Give reasons for your answer
essay:
People who achieved incredible success in their life seem not to encounter a failure. It is claimed that they got what they need without much effort. However, this view, in my opinion is not correct. Failure is something that everyone experiences during the lifetime, but successful people are able to overcome this ordeal. Hence, it can be said that failure is an outcome of a weak desire. This essay agrees with the statement and will show reasons which support this.

To begin with, failure is an obstacle that should be gone through. It tests people's desire and purposefulness. For example, Edwin Barnes, a person whose desire was to become a partner of Thomas Edison, had nothing. He had only an aim and a desire to achieve it. Therefore, it is right to say that Barnes had a misfortune from the beginning. This may be sufficient to discourage many people from their purpose, but Barnes never gave up. This made him one of the most required people in Edison's company.

In addition, one of the most common features of failure is quitting. There are numerous examples of people who stopped on the last step in the way to success because their desire was not strong. Many successful people say that they reach success soon after they faced misfortune. Darby, the most famous insurance salesman, said that his most beneficial sales were made after people had said no. This is evidence that failure is closely linked to success.

On the whole, a strong desire is something with the help of which any aims and purposes can be attained. People should learn to get over misfortune and follow their dreams no matter what happens.

topic: Some people believe that technology has made man more social. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
Experts throughout the world have debated whether modernity improves the way humans communicate. The substantial influence of the Internet, laptops and mobile phones has sparked over people´s lifestyle in recent years because of that some believes that they socialize better than before. In my view, those networks allow for people to be close while close ones become distant.

At the outset, there are many reasons why Facebook, Twitter and Whatsapp are socializing people, but the most conspicuous stems from the fact users can be in touch with someone they met in the other part of the world. Furthermore, messages are instantly sent to anybody everywhere, so friendship would not be limited by distance anymore. For example, a German today can befriend a Brazilian despite briefly contact by travelling in Thailand. For this reason, modern technology provides social life.

Nevertheless, some drawbacks have still remained with those approaches, which can certainly overwhelm the potential of social media. However, the most one is rooted in users forgetting to have a personal relationship even though with whom is possible. For instance, home mates know each other better from Facebook posts than from face-to-face conversations, which increases lonely feelings. In this way, everybody should moderate the usage of those social media.

To summarize, it is true that modern technologies have a huge positive impact on lifestyle. Although, having addiction for those can make negative issues outreach over humanity, as same as every addictive behaviour around human beings can damage. Users must be aware of the danger caused by overusing those facilities.

topic: Immigration has a major impact on society. Ċ What are the main reasons of immigration? Ċ To what consequences can it lead?
essay:
In the present day, the number of people moving to another country has increasingly popular among individuals and this process results in a high rate of immigration, which is when a person leaves their home country in order that to start a life in a different place. This essay will discuss the major reasons for this phenomenon and are possible consequences.

First and foremost, the major reason for this personal choice is the fact that individuals are seeking better opportunities for jobs and studies. In addition, when a person takes this decision, she is looking not only for job satisfaction and a work-life balance but also for a safe place to live with their children, where there will have security and better educational systems. For example, in a metropolitan city, such as Toronto and New York, the likelihood of a person get an excellent job in a prestigious company is much higher than in a small town. The more opportunities, the better the quality of life.

Secondly, this process can result in cities completely without structures due to the substantial number of individuals moving to a specific site, in other words, urbanization can change the infrastructure of cities resulting in negative aspects. The more people living in the same place, the more the number of cars in streets which leads to increase of greenhouse gases effects; in addition, noise pollution and lack of green areas are much more present in big cities due to advance of globalization. For instance, some international research shows that metropolitan centres present more deforested areas in relation to small places since these areas are used for the construction of houses and roads. It is necessary to a strict control to balance both the advantages and the disadvantages.

In conclusion, immigration has been presented in our society as people seeking better opportunities, which is an acceptable idea but at the same time, the negative effects can endanger the world for the next generation. This essay discoursed about reasons and consequences of the immigration process.

topic: In some countries, many more people are choosing to live alone nowadays than in the past. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
essay:
In recent years it has become far more normal for people to live alone, particularly in large cities in the developed world. In my opinion, this trend is having both positive and negative consequences in equal measure.

The rise in one-person households can be seen as positive for both personal and broader economic reasons. On an individual level, people who choose to live alone may become more independent and self-reliant than those who live with family members. A young adult who lives alone, for example, will need to learn to cook, clean, pay bills and manage his or her budget, all of which are valuable life skills. From an economic perspective, the trend towards living alone will result in greater demand for housing. This is likely to benefit the construction industry, estate agents and a whole host of other companies that rely on homeowners to buy their products or services.

However, the personal and economic arguments given above can be considered from the opposite angle. Firstly, rather than the positive feeling of increased independence, people who live alone may experience feelings of loneliness, isolation and worry. They miss out on the emotional support and daily conversation that family or flatmates can provide, and they must bear all household bills and responsibilities. Secondly, from the financial point of view, a rise in demand for housing is likely to push up property prices and rents. While this may benefit some businesses, the general population, including those who live alone, will be faced with rising living costs.

In conclusion, the increase in one-person households will have both beneficial and detrimental effects on individuals and on the economy.

topic: Some people like doing work by hand. Others prefer using machines. Which do you prefer? Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer
essay:
If people want to continue working by hands why can we see a lot of inventions such as computer in our life? Beyond doubt, humans are always trying to find a way for convenient life. Therefore, throughout this long path, invention of machines has profound effects in our daily life. I personally prefer doing work by machines, in that they work as precise as possible, and they work without exhaustion.

Preciseness is the most important working features of machines. Although some old-fashioned people believe that we should not trust to the machines for all of our duties because of their flaws, machines have proven that tasks done by them are more accurate than humans' tasks. As an outstanding illustration, history shows that some striking epics, telling the story of historical events, have deteriorated because of the fact that they reproduced by hands writing and this activity often includes some mistakes.

How can we imagine a machine need a break time during a working day? Working without exhaustion is another reason motivating me to prefer working by machines instead of my hands. If I have to make ten copies of my reports which includes seventy pages with historical methods, certainly, I will resign from this company, but photocopy-machine not only does help me to create these copies without any tire but also lend me a hand to keep my job. In addition, results of a recent research carried out on MIT University, affirm that working by machines is more beneficial for companies, inasmuch as they do not need break times and they use working hours better than humans do.

In conclusion, I prefer using machines for my works. Even if machines have their own errors, they have created for working without mistakes. They can also work inexhaustible. Finally, convenient life equals to applying machines for our monotonous works.

topic: Most employers interview candidates before hiring them. Do you think this is the best way to do it? In your opinion, what is the best method for choosing employees?
essay:
In most case, an interview is usually becoming the common step that a candidate should pass before getting a job. This essay will argue that this is not the appropriate way to become the standardization in the company for selecting employees because it cannot show their true ability while I would suggest the aptitude test as the better alternative.

Recruiting workers by an interview has limitation since this method does not provided opportunity to show their preference. This is because it just tests applicant's communication ability and does not involve practical skill which leads poor performance especially for people who are not used for speaking. For example, the machine technicians will be clumsy when doing interview test since they only fix the devices and rare to socialize with the others which lead them not pass although they have better capability.

The best way to know the applicants' real skill is conducting the aptitude test by the authorities of company. This is due to the reason that this test is suitable for every person since they can show their true ability in front of the examiners. A recent poll conducted by U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics revealed that 73% of IT companies state that the aptitude test which asks candidates to make new programs is more effective rather than interviewing them.

The aforementioned evidence reveals that an interview is lack in some assessments which must be judged by the interviewer to provide best employee and an aptitude test would complete those weakness.

topic: Some people think the most effective way to reduce industrial pollution is to tax those companies cause it. What are other alternatives? Discuss both and give you opinion.
essay:
Pollution is vital problem worldwide. Developing countries are becoming industrialized that lead to increase polluted environment. In my opinion levying more duty on factories and another course of action, introducing environmental policies and controlling bodies, helps to minimize pollution.

In some countries, government body collect additional tax from companies and builds special industrial zone away from town or residents, to balance business and environment damages. In such a specialized industry area having right channel for draining waste, facilities for destroying emissions and exhaust fumes minimizes environment causes. In New York, east-coast area declared as chemical industry zone, where government has provided tunnel to drain waste water in very deep level of sea. However, sometimes companies' operator feels in-justice to paying additional taxes compare to other companies which are causes nations other way.

In addition, introducing pollution policies and monitoring institutions force company operators to follow it. For example, set limits to produce emissions and exhaust fumes, companies encourage to think for alternative production method in lesser exhaust fumes. Periodically inspection by Monitoring bodies ensures that units have installed adequate emission control equipments. Furthermore, campaigning for economical products and giving more space to green factories, will be a good replacement of polluting industries in future. Green factories aims to manufacture recyclable products and minimum wastes of natural resources.

All societies are equal responsible for increasing pollution. Penalties is somewhat right but not only the solution, are other substitutions considerable to replace harmful industries and make balance between development and environments.

topic: Nowadays it is better for young people to continue their study for master or doctoral degree rather than to work. To what extent do you agree or disagree on this statement.
essay:
Today, every seniors in the university will soon face the difficult life changing decision, whether they will choose to study more, or work. Many of them believed that it is more beneficial to take their study to the next level, rather than work. In my opinion, both options have their own advantages.

Study at the Master or Doctoral level can be quite challenging, but they would gain a precious knowledge that could benefit them in the future, such as bigger salary, easier to get job, etc. Therefore, people are willing to take several years to study harder. Yet, in my opinion, this is the best option to choose for those who already settled with their passion. For example, someone might want to attend a Master of Early Childhood program because he/she wishes to pursue a career as an early childhood educator. This can help them to strengthen and deepen the knowledge about the field, and thus mastered it.

In other hand, working also have some advantages that worth to consider. When someone decide to work, they can apply their knowledge directly in the field. It can help them to identify their ability, or in which field they're really good at. The advantage also lies in the bigger opportunity to enroll in Master or Doctoral Program. Many of these programs require at least 2-3 years' work experiences.

topic: Some people prefer to spend their lives doing the same things and avoiding change. Others, however, think that change is always a good thing. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion
essay:
In our last fifty years, the pace of change in human life has been beyond our imagination. That has been impacted by the development of technology. However, the more things are created, the more matters are destroyed. Therefore, someone wants stay unchanged, while others believe that changes are always beneficial. This essay will take a brief look in both two views.

People who want to keep their living pace stable base their argument on the price of change. In some cases, improvement in technology causes labor-saving. Telegraph was a perfect illustration. In late 1930s, well over half a million telegrams were being sent per day in the US. However, after the growth of telephone, it displaced the telegraph as the best tool for remote communication. As a result, a great deal of Morse code operators lost their jobs. As for this sample, even if people resist themselves from changing, they couldn't prevent the world from changing. Sooner or later they have to adapt or lose their things.

Nevertheless, the inevitable change does not mean that it is always for the better. People will not forget the day the United States conducted two atomic bombings against the cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki in Japan. So far, nuclear weapon still has been a terrible danger of human distinct. Moreover, invading privacy is an obvious inconvenience of digital world. With a cell phone, people can easily take private videos of others before posting them on Youtube. Worse than that, government could listen any civilian's phone calls that it regards.

In a nutshell, changing is an inescapable matter of our life. However, not any change gets a better outcome. Therefore, better preparation will help us avoid inconveniences in this life.

topic: Some people believe that it is better to spend more money to eliminate the cause of crime, while others think that the government should spend more on punishment. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In the recent times, the society is suffering from the soaring rate of crime all around the world. Some intellectuals opine to devote more fiscal resources to prevent the root of the offences, whereas others consider that the penalty for the crime must get stringent. This essay will discuss both the views of the above notion along with my opinion.

To begin with, the former view of eliminating the origins of the crime is predominantly key to decline the rate of crime. This practice will not only reduce the episodes of offences, but also eradicate it from the community. Moreover, there are many circumstances and elements are there in the society, which provoke the people toward the atrocity. The local administrations have to identify such causes of the misdeeds and try to eliminate it by using fiscal and monetary policies. For instance, in many developing countries, the exorbitant poverty and unemployment escalate the victims towards robbery, prostitution and fraud. Therefore, a practice to reduce the origin of the crime is more effective for the prosperity of the society.

However, according to the latter view, the characteristics of rewarding such culprits must be modified and the legislation should form the stringent policies to create fear in the lawbreakers. The strict punishment of the offences puts a psychological pressure of the intentions of the evildoers. As a result, the potential incidents of the crime can be reduced. For example, the gulf countries having the extreme penalties revealed the minimal crime rate in their nations. Thus, the lawmakers have to come forward to stop such illegal activities by using radical punishments.

To conclude, to build the society more civilized, the authorities must have to conduct strict actions to deter the crime rates. In my opinion, the government should use the optimistic view to fade out the roots of the offences, which will benefit the large mass of the society as well as reconsider the legislation with provisions of the strict penalties.

topic: In some countries, young people are encouraged to work or travel for a year between finishing school and starting university studies. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages for young people who decide to do this. stepping out of academic treadmill
essay:
Taking a year off before starting college is no longer a common occurrence among Western countries but is gaining popularity in other parts of the world. Delaying college studies obviously bring about tremendous benefits while on the contrary its drawbacks are notable.

On the one hand, stepping out of academic treadmill would give students certain advantages. Firstly, this helps them ameliorate a sense of academic burnout. By travelling and discovering contrasting way of life rather than their own, or pursue a passion, students can unwind, take a hard look at their habits and assess the feasibility of their goals. In addition, being exposed to divergent cultures could also broaden their horizons, aid emotional maturity prior to transitioning to college. Secondly, deepening one's professional awareness is crucial to ensure not making wrong choices. The fact that students switch their field of study several times during the course of their study not only put more strain on their supporter's pocket but also is considered a huge waste of time and effort. Knowing what suits one best is better than chasing unattainable dreams due to incompetence

On the other hand, lazing around without a thorough plan is root of potential downsides. For those who postpone the difficulties of college, being free for a whole year could result in involving in binge drinking and other self-destructive behaviors. The startling consequence may be losing their hard-earned study skills that ends up in being reluctant to dive back to school.

In conclusion, taking a gap year in terms of engaging in meaningful activities could be a huge asset while self-indulgence could backfire and trigger unpleasant experience, in the worst case not go back to school.

topic: The growth of online shopping will one day lead to all shops in towns and cities closing. Do you agree or disagree?
essay:
With the wide acknowledgement of digitalization, many markets have seen a decline in their customer base.Some experts debate that the augmenting trend of online shopping will lead to the shutting of multiple shops in towns and cities. Personally, I strongly disagree with the aforementioned notion, and the following paragraphs will expatiate my stance with lucid examples.

Firstly, although there is a surge in online shopping, people will never be able to bargain on such platforms. To elucidate, the prices are fixed for all the products available on the websites and there are no chances of negotiation. For example, the Myntra clothing website does not have an option to ask for a reduction in price even if it is paradoxically exorbitant. Therefore, the people who are frugal enough would only opt for visiting physical shops and buy any kind of product.

Secondly, whenever a product is required on an urgent basis, folks cannot wait for the delivery of any item. In other words, receiving a good from an e-commerce website always have a considerable amount of wait-time between the placement of order and delivery of it. As an instance, if a home baker requires a packet of baking powder for the preparation of a dish at home , he would not wait for the grocery website to deliver it, rather he or she can immediately buy it from a nearby shop. Hence, there are still some discernible factors to acknowledge the market as a vital part of our civilization.

To sum up, despite the inclination of a major section of the population,online shopping can never replace shops completely. These are inextricable parts of the world and will not evanesce due to the advent of the internet.

topic: Some people believe that people have the right to university education, and government should make it free no matter what their financial background. To what extent do you agree or disagree? free education will have a negative consequences
essay:
Many people argue that universities are available to everyone from all walks of life. While I believe that higher education is a human right, I disagree that governments should offer a free university education to all people.

On the one hand, higher education will bring a lot of advantages to the young. Firstly, going to universities or colleges is a huge opportunity to learn and build a solid knowledge base. This will be useful and practical for those who want to become teachers or pursue a postgraduate degree. Secondly, universities give students an open environment to develop essential skills for the future. For example, they can make friends with other students coming from other countries, exchange languages, and learn about different cultures. As a result, their communication skills will be better, and they also have a deeper understanding of the world around them.

However, I disagree with the idea that universities should be free to everyone. In Vietnam, if the government provided free university education, this would lead to low quality of education. When a student doesn't have to pay free tuition fees, he can consider learning as a hobby and show a lack of commitment. Meanwhile, people who are forced to pay for their education will attempt to achieve good results at universities because it's their investment for future. Furthermore, there are many other sectors which need the support of government funds. When tuition fees are shared, governments have extra money to provide for health care, environment, and public transportation.

In conclusion, everyone has the right to access universities or colleges. However, I believe that free education is not affordable because this will have a negative effect on students, governments, and the whole society.

essay:
In the last three decades, a growing number of civilians have purchased cars to fulfill their needs travelling from one place to another. Because of this, many cities in the world have been marked as 'one big traffic jam'. Personally, I believe this is true due to the fact that the way people buy cars are getting easier. Therefore, governments should take into consideration to deal with this problem such as increasing tax payment.

It becomes affordable for societies to get car ownership. Since they just allocate a bit amount of deposit to get new vehicle and make an installment payment later, this will lead other persons to do the same that will overflow the road. It will be getting worse if every dweller has one four-wheel vehicle as their means to travel away. Such condition point out a busy road where numerous cars make a long line in particular time such as coming-home time at afternoon and leaving-home time in the morning.

To tackle the traffic congestion problem, authorities should take a policy to reduce car driving on the road. What strategy I offer is to increase tax payment for each car belonging. Stakeholders are able to ask a far substantial of levy for each automobile that every individual has. I believe this way will stimulate car drivers to rethink driving car because they should subsidize much money for such expenditure.

To conclude, it is unavoidable that easiness having transport especially cars. It drives people to buy those modes, bringing to traffic congestion problems in many parts of the world. By increasing an amount of money payment, it expects to urge citizens not to utilize automobile thanks to high expenses anxiety.

topic: Some say that sprots play an important role in society. Others, however, think that it is nothing more than a leisure activity. Discuss both view, and give your opinion.
essay:
It is a controversial issue as to whether sports are essential to the community, or, whether it is the best method of passing time. From my perspective, different types of games play a vital role in terrains as a whole rather than an entertaining task.

To begin with, myriads of people consider games as a job, which should be done every day or at the weekend after regular works. This is because people become exhausted for maintaining daily routines. For example, in Japan, it is obligatory to each individual whether students or office workers, ought to spend time in sports clubs on Sunday and every holiday. As a result, it keeps their body active, which could, eventually, succour them to reduce corporal stress. Besides, sports provide stamina that might help minimize diseases such as heart attack, liver-related ailments et Cetra. Moreover, people spend a pleasure schedule with friends, relatives, and family during play various types of games such as cricket, football, volleyball, to name but a few. Thus, sports tasks, invariably, should be done regularly, which alleviates pressure from school life and factory works.

In contrast, these days, sports activities have become the regular phenomenon in the society that tends to achieve plenty of goals for communities such as economic growth. For instance, when a renowned sports person plays for his teams, he must gain name and fame not only for his own but also for the nation. As a result, he earns lots of money, and the company, which sponsors him, gains profits as well. Furthermore, some other industries might take a famous player as a brand ambassador for their current products, which might have brought double profit to the organization. In this way, a developing company progressing chance becomes quadrupled in the long run, which plays a pivotal role in domestic pecuniary achievement.

In conclusion, although people play sports for spending time, when they are inactive from households, or office-related activities, sports, in my opinion, are crucial for the area, because it helps in building profit to employers and employees as well, which shows the economic growth in society.

topic: Cause of educated unemployed and Solution. In many countries today there are many highly qualified graduates without employment. What factors may have caused this situation and what, in your opinion, can/should be done about it? Why do many smart people become jobless?
essay:
In almost all parts of the world, the number of qualified graduates increases significantly, but many of them have no jobs yet. Personally, this shows an indication of slowing economic growth, so the best way to overcome this problem is the government should attract more investors to start up businesses in the country.

The growing numbers of certified graduates who do not have works depict low prosperity, especially in the country's economy. If a country faces this situation, it will impact on the availability of employment. For example, according to a daily newspaper, Indonesia has around 700,000 graduations that still struggle to find jobs since the economic growth does not achieve the target due to lack of investment from other countries. This demonstrates how economic growth contributes to the unemployment of highly qualified scholars.

However, this does not mean that it cannot be tackled. The best step that should be done by the authority to reduce unemployment is by inviting many new shareholders from abroad to open multinational companies in its own state. For instance, Dubai, the largest and most populous city in the United Arab Emirates, has succeeded in making international investors invest their money, so it causes an economic improvement in this country. By that, Dubai had constructed and attracted world attention through large construction projects and sports events, in particular, the world's tallest building, the Burj Khalifa. This leads to a decrease in the number of many highly qualified graduates without employment.

To sum up, even though many people who have graduated from tertiary are still jobless, I believe that the government ought to cooperate with other investors from overseas to develop economic growth.

topic: Without capital punishment (death penalty) our lives will be less secure and crime of violence will increase. Capital punishment is essential to control violence in our society.
essay:
Nowadays, development of crime of violence causes great fears among citizens, which forces the governments to take effective actions to reduce crime of violence and guarantee security and stability in our society. Capital punishment is considered as one of the most effective measures.

Firstly, death penalty, the heaviest punishment for serious criminals, makes people think twice before committing a crime. If a person kills someone, he may pay by the rest of his life. Thus, there may have a remarkable decrease in crime rate. Secondly, lack of tough measures can lead to the fact that criminals look down on laws and tend to conduct further guilty actions. When we do not have strong measures to crime of violence, we seem to agree with is development. For example, terrorists may kill hundreds of innocent citizens and destroy happiness of thousands of families. As their victims have to suffer from great pain and loss, they never deserve being forgiven . Therefore, death penalty is necessary to punish them and give fairness to their miserable victims.

On the other hand, some people may think capital punishment is not a humane measure. In deed, we can not use light ones for those who have lost their humanity and even haven't cared about their own lives. Hence, it is essential to keep death penalty for strictness of laws, and safeness of citizens.

In conclusion, capital punishment plays an important role in controlling violence in our society. However, it should be combined with other activities such as raising awareness among citizens and encouraging people especially children to live and respect laws. Only when these things are widely applied throughout the country can we dream about a peaceful and stable life for everyone.

topic: Some people feel that entertainers (e.g. film stars, pop musicians or sports stars) are paid too much money. Ċ Do you agree or disagree? Ċ Which other types of jobs should be highly paid?
essay:
It is a belief by some section of society that people who entertain have been able to charge a hefty sum. In this essay, I will enunciate upon the ideas for my rationale and will ponder upon other professions that should have better pay.

Firstly, its an individual's niche skill through which one entertains the world. The entertainer creates his own space in the respective field with his or her unique talent. The monopoly of anything with huge demand always has a premium value. For example, Micheal Jackson, one of the richest dancers, had his own style of dancing and because of, that he was always in demand for concerts. Secondly, performers work really hard since childhood to nurture their skills and invest all their life to reach the zenith. The time and efforts they invest in to succeed in life will eventually bring in fame and wealth. So, I opine with this line of thought that talent has no boundaries and deserving should be paid enough for his efforts.

On the contrary, there are many other professions, in my opinion, that deserves more as compared to the present scenario. To begin with, the soldiers protecting the nation on the border, I feel, are deprived of the required fame and wealth. They are not paid enough salaries as compared to other industries. These people are always on the toes in a vivid situation where they can lose their life at any given point in time. Further, the workers who clean the surrounding every day are void of necessary respect and money. These are the ones who are doing odd jobs which many people will refrain from taking up. For instance, in a recent government survey, the majority of the crowd in the below poverty line are cleaners.

In conclusion, undoubtedly, the folks with unique talent should be paid as per their demand and skill. However, I opine that another section of society who risk their life and doing odd jobs also deserve equal fame and prosperity in life.

topic: Experts say older people were happier and healthier in the past because they did more exercise and spent more time with family and friends, whereas many now suffer from loneliness and health problems. What are the causes of this and what are some solutions?
essay:
In the past, old generation were more contended and fit as they used to participate in more physical pursuits and devote a considerable amount of time to loved ones. On the other hand, nowadays, the youngsters are dealing with isolation and health related issues. This essay will discuss that the excessive usage of the internet and technology is the main reason behind this problem and suggest that having more physical education classes in schools is a viable solution to this issue.

In this day and age, with the advent of modern technology, over-reliance of people on the internet and labour saving machines is the primary cause of people suffering from loneliness and health problems like obesity. In the past, most of the work was done manually, such as household chores, due to which people were more fit and healthy. Whereas today, people are spending more hours on their cell phones and social media during their free time rather than doing some exercise and playing sports. Earlier, people used to go out for shopping with their friends and spent time with them, but now, they can do online shopping in few seconds without leaving their homes. Hence, this alienation of people from their family and friends may cause depression and anxiety.

Despite this, the be all and end all solution to this issue is to have more sports and exercise in the school curriculum. If the Government incorporates more physical fitness classes in educational institutions, then students will be obliged to partake in outdoor activities and games. Moreover, at home parents should encourage their kids to play outside with their friends rather than indulging in video games. For instance, a large number of online matches take place daily and millions of teenagers around the globe participate in such tournaments. Therefore, youth should be motivated to meet and talk to their friends in person instead of online.

In conclusion, spending more hours on social media and playing online games will have a detrimental effect on the health of people. It is recommended that nations should conduct public awareness campaigns to educate citizens about the benefits of staying fit and healthy.

topic: Some people think that cars are the best way to travel in a city, while others think that bicycle is better. Discuss both points of view and give your opinion.
essay:
People use various modes of transport to travel within a city. While some believe that a car is more convenient mode to do so, others feel that a bicycle is more efficient. I think that both the modes have some advantages and drawbacks, therefore one should choose depending on the distance which need to be covered.

On the one hand, people who choose a car over a bicycle might argue that it is a faster mode of transport; hence it can help in saving a lot of time if a person needs to travel from one edge of the city to another. On the contrary, two wheelers are slower and are not fit for longer distances. For instance, one of my relatives lives around 10 kilometres away from my place. If I take a two-wheeler to reach there, it takes me around 1 hour to do so, but if I opt for a four-wheeler instead, I can reach there in approximately 30 minutes. Additionally, the cars can accommodate more people than a cycle. Therefore, if a family wants to travel together, cars are definitely a better option.

On the other hand, cycles are environmentally friendly as they do not cause any air pollution, but cars emit carbon footprints. A recent survey conducted by the transport department of India concluded that if all the cars are replaced by bicycles, the air quality could be dramatically improved. Subsequently, bicycles are more cost effective and low maintenance as compared to the cars as they do not require a fuel refill and any frequent services. For example, a person who owns a bicycle can save up to 85% of the amount that is spent by a car owner on the maintenance of his vehicle.

In conclusion, some people choose cars because they are faster mode of transport to be used in a city, other feel that bicycles are more environmentally efficient and can also save a lot of money. But I feel that both have some plus and minus; therefore for long distances cars should be used and cycles can be used for short distances.

topic: In some countries, the government pays unemployed people on a weekly basis. How does this impact individuals and the government? Do you agree or disagree with this idea?
essay:
The grant to unemployed people is paid in many countries. It definitely affects both the society and the government. In my opinion, I do not agree with the idea of giving benefits to people who do not have a job and there are many reasons for that.

Firstly, the authorities should spend the money wisely, there are more significant sectors of a country's economy which need money than people out of a job. Moreover, paying unemployed people weekly basis leads to laziness and increase an unemployment, which the government is responsible for. Although, it seems to help some people, it is definitely not fair to the others who work very hard to receive salaries. For instance, residents without a job are not going to look for it, knowing that they can get the money from the government. I think that, the benefits for people out of jobSuggestionjobsa job only discourage them from applying and developing themselves.

Another point to consider is the fact that spending money to unemployed citizens decrease the amount of funds to support different sectors of the economy such as healthcare or education. Furthermore, instead of giving money the government can fund the education of residents without a job. For example, professional courses and trainings should be organized as a method of supporting unemployed thus it is both helping residents and raising the level of the education. The health care is another crucial section of any country which should be funded by the authorities before residents who do not work.

In conclusion, paying unemployed people grants is not beneficial for society neither country's economy. It should be reconsidered and the money should be used in the healthcare or the education.

topic: Now a days increasing amount of garbage is a real concern. Why is this happening?what can be done to resolve this?
essay:
It has bee observed that humans are producing a ginormous amount of garbage- both domestic and industrial. There are many causes for the proliferation of rubbish these days. This essay looks to achieve the task by stating the possible reasons for the same along with suggesting implementable remedies to resolve the situation.

There are several reasons for an increasing dump at current pace. To begin with, the rapid growth of garbage is directly linked to the overwhelming number of population. As the number of people grows the proportion of product consumption also rise. This, in turn, inflates the waste produce. For instance, according to London media report 80% populace are using packed products, which create excessive amount of litter. Moreover, Modern Life is practising throw-away culture. As the name suggested, people are less interested in using reused commodities. Instead, they dispose old project and buy a new merchandise. This contributes towards the rubbish addition. Finally, although not a major cause, but the lack of recycling practice in the society is also a contributing factor for increasing on plastic dump.

Thankfully, there are implementable remedies available. Firstly, the government should be stricter, about waste and plastic manufacturing companies. They should put legal limits and certain rules. In addition, they can take up the initiative to encourage citizens to keep their surroundings clean. Also, there should be such a program to avoid non-biodegradable bags. For example, a bonus or reward for not asking bag in the supermarket.

To conclude, the fact that raising the amount of sewage can be attributed to valid reasons such as population blast and thrown-away culture. The remedies of it which happen to be certain regulation implementations by government and making awareness campaign to the society, if implemented with utmost honesty and with right intention the ill-effects can be mitigated to a large extent.

topic: In some countries, governments are encouraging industries and businesses to move to regional areas outside the big cities. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
the authority are pushing companies to displace their workplace to the outside of cities in several countries. even tough it can deal with pollution problem faced in the city, the disadvantage of the increasing time spent by people to the relocation point outnumbers any benefits.

It is commonly thought that the policy can decrease pollution in the urban area. This is due to the fact that the emissions coming from manufacturing do not exist in the city. For example, a current survey carried out by the Chinese government in 2010 released that the rate of pollution decreased dramatically by 30% in the town since relocation industries to the rural area. However, this policy can not fully solve the problem as the pollution is still released from private cars.

apart from the previous discussion, workers have to spend a lot of time in the way towards a company when the policy is taken . This is due to the fact that the distance between the relocation point and people's residence is quite long. For example, United states employment council released the result of survey in 2011 that showed 80% of employee require 5 hours in the journey to reach the business place since industries moved to outskirt. This means this policy add the burden not only for the workers but also for the employee when dealing with time management. Therefore, such policy gives more demerits than it benefits.

In conclusion, although the rate of pollution still exists, the drawback of this relocation makes workers spend a lot of time to the workplace. It is recommended that governments also have a big role to manage this condition with make a home for workers around industry's environment.

topic: All children should study a foreign language in school starting in the earliest grades. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
With the development of globalization which foreign languages becomes important to communicate with other people in different countries, some people argue that children in the earliest grades have to learn a foreign language. I strongly believe that this has both positive and detrimental effects.

I would argue that globalization influences people to learn foreign language, English language specially. Result shows that about 1,500,000,000 people in the world speak in English, and around 1,000,000,000 people are studying it. Moreover, almost all of international conferences and international competitions are held in English language, Olympiad for example. Although this can help people to communicate with foreigners, traditional language is abandoned.

Based on that data, many parents more concerned with foreign languages than traditional languages. If this kind of case continue, it will make the traditional languages extinct. To illustrate, Mapia, Tandia, Bonerif and Saponi were kind of traditional languages that vanished in Papua. As a result, people in the future may not know about their traditional languages, and it will become a big problem for a country as traditional languages are a country cultures.

However, learn about foreign languages specially English will help people to challenge the development of globalization. For instance, Asian Free Trade Agreement (AFTA) will be applied soon, and all of Asian countries will compete to dominate the trade's competition. Thus, English competence is needed to assist people to contend with the other countries.

To sum up, it seems to me that learn a foreign language is important, and it can leg up people to vie global competition. In order to achieve that a foreign language should be learned by children in the earliest grades. Although, there is possibility that traditional language will be abandoned. In my opinion the stakeholder should look carefully at traditional languages besides foreign languages.

abstractive_summary: Learning foreign languages in the earliest grades presents both benefits and challenges in an increasingly globalized world. With about 1.5 billion English speakers and widespread use in international forums like the Olympiad, English has become essential for global communication and competitiveness, especially with initiatives like the Asian Free Trade Agreement. Mastery of foreign languages offers advantages in global competition, making early language education valuable. However, growing emphasis on foreign languages risks neglecting traditional ones, as seen in the extinction of languages like Mapia and Tandia in Papua, threatening cultural heritage. While early foreign language learning is important, stakeholders must carefully support both foreign and traditional languages to preserve cultural identity.

Studying a foreign language improves long-term academic performance across subjects.
Young children acquire pronunciation and grammar more naturally than older learners.
Multilingual education fosters greater cultural awareness and empathy.
Global communication skills are essential in an interconnected world.
Introducing languages early maximizes language proficiency by adulthood.

Young children need to master native language skills before adding another.
Not all students benefit equally from early foreign language instruction.
Schools may lack qualified teachers for early foreign language programs.
Curriculum space is limited and must prioritize core subjects.
Early language requirements may increase pressure on young learners.

topic: Wealthy nations should assist poorer countries with humanitarian relief during natural disasters. Do you agree and disagree? poor nations should be assisted by rich
essay:
Due to the humanitarian consideration, those well-off countries should have obligation to help poor nations in order to walk through the dilemma of natural disasters. This essay agrees with this statement because the first aid is not developed well to save the people's lives and the financial condition is weak to rebuild in poor countries.

Poor nations do not have enough resources to save people who are suffering in natural disasters. It is clear that emergency service is utmost essential towards natural disasters and the golden time of saving victims is just 3 days. If wealthy countries come and give a helping hands to poor nations, it can speed up the time of searching the missing which increase the survival rate. Moreover, the injured patients can also receive proper treatments to avoid further viral infection which may cause a big outbreak of serious diseases in that region. For example, the earthquake happened in China in 2008 caused thousands of people death. With the help of other countries, first aiders and immediate food packages had been sent and saved a lot of people's lives.

Rebuilding the countries is impossible with insufficient financial reserve. Many infrastructures are collapsed during the tragedy inevitably, they are needed to be reconstructed as soon as possible so as to resume residents' normal living and to increase the productivity of the countries. Without any help of developed countries, the poor one can only rebuild the country in an extremely slow speed and suffering continues even though citizens are physically recovered. For instance, South Korea donates and helps the government of Cambodia in protecting and fixing their heritage sites as they are too poor to do so.

In conclusion, poor nations should be assisted by rich countries regarding the humanitarian relief so that massive death can be avoided and reconstruction of the countries can also be facilitated during natural disasters.

structured_summary:
Major claim:
  Well-off countries have an obligation to assist poor nations during natural disasters due to humanitarian considerations.

Claim 1:
  Poor nations lack sufficient resources to save lives during natural disasters.
  Premise: Emergency services are critically important in responding to natural disasters.
  Premise: The window of time in which victims can be saved is limited to approximately three days.
  Premise: International assistance from wealthy countries can accelerate search and rescue operations, increasing survival rates.
  Counterargument: None
  Rebuttal: None

Claim 2:
  Timely medical treatment from external aid prevents outbreaks of serious diseases.
  Premise: Injured individuals can receive proper medical care with external support.
  Premise: Without treatment, injuries may lead to widespread disease outbreaks in affected regions.
  Premise: The 2008 earthquake in China resulted in massive casualties, but international aid delivered emergency responders and supplies that saved many lives.
  Counterargument: None
  Rebuttal: None

Claim 3:
  Poor countries cannot rebuild quickly without sufficient financial resources.
  Premise: Many infrastructures are destroyed during natural disasters and must be rebuilt promptly to restore normal life.
  Premise: Reconstructing infrastructure is essential for restoring national productivity.
  Premise: In the absence of support from developed countries, reconstruction in poor nations proceeds extremely slowly.
  Premise: Suffering persists even after physical recovery if reconstruction is delayed.
  Premise: South Korea has provided aid to Cambodia to protect and restore heritage sites because Cambodia lacks the financial means to do so independently.
  Counterargument: Rebuilding could be done independently by poor countries given enough time.
  Rebuttal: None
abstractive_summary: Wealthy nations have a moral duty to assist poorer countries during natural disasters, as these nations often lack the resources to respond effectively. Immediate search and rescue operations are crucial, with survival chances dropping significantly after just three days, making international aid essential to save lives. External medical support also prevents injuries from escalating into widespread disease outbreaks, as seen after the 2008 earthquake in China, where foreign assistance played a vital role. Additionally, poor countries struggle to rebuild critical infrastructure without financial help, prolonging suffering and hindering economic recovery, as demonstrated by South Korea’s aid to Cambodia. While some argue that poor nations could eventually rebuild on their own, the delay exacerbates long-term hardship, reinforcing the need for timely international support.

pro_keypoints: Wealthy nations have a moral obligation to aid those in urgent humanitarian need.
Global solidarity strengthens international cooperation and fosters mutual trust.
Assisting poorer countries reduces long-term global instability and humanitarian crises.
Disaster relief can prevent the spread of disease and cross-border emergencies.
Support during disasters promotes equitable access to life-saving resources.
con_keypoints: Wealthy nations may face domestic pressure to prioritize their own citizens' needs.
Aid can create dependency, reducing incentives for self-sufficiency in recipient nations.
Mismanagement and corruption may prevent aid from reaching intended beneficiaries.
Relief efforts can be exploited for geopolitical influence or strategic advantage.
Uncoordinated assistance may overwhelm local systems and disrupt recovery efforts.

topic: Some people say that the clothes people wear are the most important indication of what they are like. Others, however, say that people should not be judged by the clothes they wear. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.  Writing Task 2, Unit 8D, Page 52
essay:
Some people think that the clothes, which is worn by them, is the most essential factors to impress someone else. Others think that it is not true because people cannot judge by what they wear. In my opinion, it depends on the situation that the clothes has its particular function to make others feel admire.

With regards to some people who agree with the notion of the importance of clothes worn, they generally believe that it can make a fresh look or smart one, particularly in a workplace. For instance, according to the result of survey reveals that people, who want to get interview in a company, tend to wear dress smartly with bright shirt, nice tie and formal suit. As a result, their appearance look more diligent and more confident. Therefore, it is necessary to choose clothes carefully for some people in certain occasion.

On the other hand, some society think that others cannot judge someone' appeal through their clothes. It is because not everybody has the same economical issue and affords to buy branded clothes or nice clothing. For example, people who have limited finance only use casual clothes which is affordable, but it does not mean that they are not a smart person. As a result, their dress look cannot describe much information about their mind or behave.

In conclusion, the notion of clothes worn is important to impress other people is true, especially for some people who want to attend formal activity. However, it does not valid for everyone who wear simple dress as their appearance. (260 words)

topic: Creative artists should always be given the freedom to express their own ideas (in words, pictures, music or film) in whichever way they wish. There should be no government restrictions on what they do. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?
essay:
I concede that it is good for artists to express their creative ideas in many different ways they like. However, I do not think it is useful to let them do freely without any concern of the government.

We are living in liberty and democracy, so not only artist but also everyone has its' truly right to do what it wants. Creative artists, in particular, can feel respected when they have freedom to show their ideas to the world. They may feel people believe in them and always wait to see their new ideas such as words, pictures, music or film. In addition, this feeling can give them motivation which makes them create more wonderful productions.

Nevertheless, it will be too risk for the government to have no restrictions on what artists do. Some violent and erotic paintings may be drawn everywhere in the streets like walls, park benches and even in the schools. It can be worse. For example, an artist goes to a museum, and he suddenly has a new idea about his new picture. He may draw his thought on some cultural heritages. He ignores the rules of the museum because he is free to express his idea in any way. Those things will destroy the beauty of civilized streets, the solemnity of buildings and galleries. The worst thing is that children can be affected badly by some abstract paintings which they are not old enough to understand.

In conclusion, it is essential to make creative artists feel free to product more new creation to the life. The core here is that artists should aware of using their freedom cleverly and the governments should always care the actions of their citizens.

topic: Some people decide to start their own business instead of working for a company or organisation. Do the advantages for people working for their own business outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
Competition of finding a proper job is extremely hard in this globalising era. For this reason, many people decide to become enterpreneurs. Although starting a new business is highly risky, I believe that this decision brings more benefits.

The main drawback of enterpreneurship is high risk of bankruptcy. When people decide to start their own company, they should prepare themselves for the worst bankrupt which can happen to their business. A young business is fragile, especially as regard the financial issues and the trust of society. If the inventor of a new business cannot gains attention of the customers, him/her business will easily sink due to a sharp drop in its economical status. Meanwhile, a bankrupted enterpreneur still has an obligation to pay salary of their workers which make them need a huge debt to fulfill it. However, compared to the advantages of owning a business, I believe that those risks is minuscule.

Undoubtedly, a new business is highly advantageous not only for the enterpreneurs, but also society, even government. From personal point of view, owning a company can widen a businessman's relationships, even overseas, as they will unconciously do more public communication in order to widespread their business. Self-employed people also do not have to wait to be paid as they work for themselves, the income is all theirs. When the company's economical status balloon, the money earn by the owner increase as well. For other people, enterpreneur is significant because by establishing a new business, they will help others who are unemployed to earn money. This case will indirectly leads to the plunge of unemployment rate in a nation.

In conclusion, although it is true that be involved in enterpreneurship has a drawbak if people cannot handle some problems with finance and customers, the advantages are much more bigger. In my view, people should learn from business experts first before they decide to start their own business.

topic: Some people prefer to spend their lives doing the same things and avoiding changes. Others, However, think that change is always a good thing. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
During our life, people face numerous challenges and have to make important decisions. There are the ones who believe that it is more beneficial to live always performing the same role and executing the same activities. On the other hand, there are others who prefer challenges and changes. In my way of thinking, whilst I feel that both perspectives might have positive points, I prefer to take some risks in order to improve some aspects of my life.

There are some who argue that they prefer to spend a life doing the same things. While having the same profession, or working on the same company for an undetermined period of time, one seldom surpass their comfort zone. For instance, that person knows what kind of emotion to expect from that job, and what exactly they are supposed to act. Moreover, those also enjoy spending their free time executing activities which they know what type of award or pleasure will come from doing them. It can be positive for some who prefer stability instead of adventure. Furthermore, they might predict what the future will look like. As far as I am concerned, that type of routine might be utterly monotonous.

Conversely, there are others who advocate that changes are beneficial. In my perspective challenges might lead us to improve our behaviour, as also as learn how to cope with several unexpected situations. By leaving our comfort zone, we are exposing ourselves to numerous stimuli, which might reveal our curiosity, as well as lead us to discover new talents and vocations. To illustrate this idea, the example of workers who frequently change their job can be given. These switches lead them to try different areas of interest, therefore, they might find what they really enjoy doing. Additionally, explorers who travel the world, experience several distinct beliefs and customs, might have their creativity more stimulated and also became open-minded.

In conclusion, while I feel that both views have effective arguments, I believe that changes can always be beneficial. When someone tries novel things, explores unknown places or applies for a different job, several opportunities became available, enabling them to fulfil their potential.

topic: Each year, the crime rate increases. What are the causes of crime and what could be done to prevent this rise in criminal activity?
essay:
Criminal record has actually increased in recent years. This has affected people on many levels, often generating fear and leading to victimization and over-reaction. This essay accounts for the reasons why crime occurs such as economic factor and unemployment. Some measurements like CCTV, job vacancy and the involvement of police officer are also clearly stated to cope with this matter.

As a matter of fact, criminal act is caused by two main significant factors. The predominant factor resulting in the crime initiation is economic situation. To exemplify, a poor father may not be able to deliver his children in school and lack of education may lead to juvenile crime. Another cause of the problem is mass idleness. According to Bureau of Labor Statistics, 6 percent of people at the age of 16 years old and over are included unemployment. Consequently, owing to these reasons, it is inevitable that crime statistics are continuously increasing.

As far as I am concerned, there are potential strategies to fight the criminal activity. Firstly, Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) can be used as a crime prevention method. A study reported that CCTV was used in fifteen housing complexes for elderly residents in Manchester, England and this declined in burglary attempts of 79 percent across all complexes. Also, the provision of employment opportunities need to be improved by new work fields. Finally, police force has to be an important part in society in terms of reducing the crime rate. There should be an increase in the number of police officers in order to control over the offenders.

The aforementioned evidence reveals that although the crime is a serious problem, there are remedial measures which can be taken to diminish it. It is imperative that if the above mentioned measurements are taken into account, the root causes of the crimes can be decreased significantly.

topic: Happiness is considered very important in life. Why is it difficult to define? What factors are important in achieving happiness?
essay:
We always hear many people decide an objective to their life is to be success, which success actually brings an important key of life that is happiness. However, people are difficult to explain the meaning of happiness is. In contrary, they know the aspects to attain the happiness. Further, this essay will discuss the topics.

People ambitious are to be bliss, but when they are asked about happiness, they are dazed to explain it. This because many aspects can make people happy, even it is out of their expectation such as an unexpected simple thing. For instance, a beggar asks a woman's money, but a woman just gives him a piece of bread she has.  Then, the beggar is gratitude and smile instead of it is out of his expectation. Therefore, cheerfulness is being hard to give a meaning, because it can be from a little thing that surprises us, but makes us to be grateful and have a good feeling.

Besides, there is an objective to achieve happy things and it is influenced by some factors. In my view, one of them is attaining success. As an example, an IELTS catcher has learnt IELTS in formal course for three months. However, he has not achieved his score target. So, he forced himself to learn more over six months in his home before taking a real test. He finally got 6.5 of score then he was very happy and being grateful, even his aim was seven. It proves that having a good production of effort makes someone is happy.

In conclusion, cheerfulness is the important thing that people aim in the life. It can be source from a simple thing which people are hard to elucidate. Moreover, accomplishing a successful thing can give people a happy life. 297w

topic: do you believe that professional athletes make good role models for young people? support your opinion with reasons and examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
Sport is an indispensable activity for human beings around the world. They are leisure strenuousness but also an occupation for a specific group of people which called an athlete. In my opinion, I have confidence in expert sportspeople that make duty prototypes for juniors.

Proficient athletes gain an enormous observation from young people everywhere in the world. Many teenagers or even children would like to follow their favorite players. When a child plays a sport, most of them have their preferred sportsperson desire themselves to be as good as their icon. Playing sport is not all about improving health, some sports even teach us solidarity means they train ourself to work under a team and play fair. Besides, professional athletes also represent the consequence of hard work to their followers. They are great living examples for industrious practice yields success. Many of them even receive high incomes from advertisements, being models, or running their own business. Because of their reputation, they effortlessly obtain attention without paying much amount for marketing.

Nevertheless, pro-players are not always good role, especially teenage athletes. Being financially comfortable as a juvenile makes them think that they can do what they wish for since penurious days. Great earning at a young age is a double-edged sword. Some of them concentrate on doing something to upgrade their property or helping unlucky circumstances. Some only spend their money extravagantly for partying overnight or under arrest because of rebellious behaviors.

To sum up, professional athletes may become good role models for young people as long as they focus on doing meaningful, and become ideal for the young to imitate.

topic: Increasing the price of petrol is the best way to solve growing traffic and pollution problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree? What other measures do you think might be effective.
essay:
Nowadays, there has been an upward trend in traffic and pollution issues. Many individuals feel that the solution to the current environment is to raise petrol costs. In my opinion, though this would have a beneficial effect, I disagree with this extent.

On the one hand, there are many drawbacks and advantages of high-cost fuels that can be explained for a variety of reasons. First and foremost, more expensive fuel costs would encourage many citizens to transport by either public transportation or walking. To illustrate, if the cost of petrol is high, then various individuals would prefer to commute by public transportation on a daily basis, which can reduce producing toxic gases. However, numerous average households that are struggling with paying bills and debt might prefer to stay home rather than take a short trip as an enjoyable experience.

On the other hand, a wide range of measures that do not target the less wealthy elements of society would have a stronger impact. The solution might be effective for the middle class rather than the upper class. This means that wealthy people who have solid financial backing won’t be bothered since they have too many expenses to spend. To begin with, to tackle the problem of traffic congestion, the authorities should invest more in renewable energy sources such as solar energy, as well as road maintenance and construction.

In conclusion, though expensive fuels can be advantageous, concentrating on using renewable energy sources and improving roads can be a wise choice. Therefore, citizens should learn how to commute by public transport more than in their own vehicles.

topic: Some people get into debt by buying things they don’t need and can’t afford. What are the reasons for this behavior? What action can be taken to prevent people from having this problem?
essay:
We live in a materialistic world that so many people buy things that are not necessary for them, and they even can not pay for them, so they have to borrow funds from someone else. There are many motives behind this kind of behaviour, and of course, there are many steps that can be taken to solve it.

There are different factors to blame for the consumerism which puts individuals in debt. Firstly, people from the dawn of time dreamed about having something, which was not anything vital for them but a guilty pleasure. Because of this, buying those things at any price give the owner a satisfying feeling. Secondly, advertisements and salespersons can be persuasive and encourage the customers to buy something, that might block their logical sense, as a result, leave them with a huge unpayable bill. This behaviour will cause individuals to fell into debts that they can not even afford to pay back, hence they will face bigger problems, for example, they have to drop out of school and work instead to earn that money and stay out of jail.

On the other hand, fortunately, there are practical and useful actions that can stop this issue from happening. In this way, it will not be easy to access the money, therefore they will only use it if it is really essential, and also they will have savings for the future.

In conclusion, although the problem of buying unnecessary stuff and needing a loan in order to pay for them is a serious issue, there are practical solutions for it and it can be solved.

topic: Some people think that it is necessary to travel abroad to learn about countries, but others think that it is not necessary to travel abroad because all the information can be seen on TV and the Internet. Discuss both views and give your opinion
essay:
While some individuals believe that travelling to foreign nations in order to enhance knowledge is essential, others consider that it is not significant due to the vast availability of the media resources which provide ample information regarding their customs and traditions.This essay intends to delve into both sides of the argument in depth.I, however, think that it is appropriate to travel abroad despite the involvement of huge amount of money.

To commence with, a vast majority of people would argue that an individual must go to the other countries.This is probably because they will interact with the local people personally, which in turn, ultimately results in the exchange of their culture and beliefs, and moreover, mutual interaction will help them in the establishment of a healthy relationship with the citizens of those nations.In the modern era, for instance, an enormous number of people are travelling to abroad as a tourist, such as educational, religious, business, and many more, which is contributing in the exchange of their cultural norms.In short, the advocates of this perspective are right in thinking so.

In contrast, the opponents claim that there is no need to travel to distinct places because lots of digital sources are providing plenty of knowledge about the different parts of the world.Since these days, there are numerous satellite channels, which are capable enough to entertain individuals, and one can enjoy within the vicinity of their comfort zone, and furthermore, it would save a lot of capital that is generally spent on the booking of air tickets, and for staying in hotels, and other expenses.In the 21st century, for example, we are equipped with the internet facilities and we can Google anything for the expansion of horizons.Thus, it would not be wrong to say that modern devices have reduced the need to travel.

In conclusion, although the society is divided on the view of travelling to other nations, there are some who regard it as a necessity, whereas another section of the community opposes the same due to easy accessibility of various resources.I personally think that these equipments cannot replace the fun involved in the itinerary of the foreign countries.
